                                                           "jaras_hu", "megye_sk", "megye_hu")),
                              ("districts", settlements_hu, ("okres_sk",)),
                              ("obce", settlements_hu, ("obec_sk",))):
        if frame is None:
            continue
        for c in cols:
            if c in frame.columns:
                out[part] |= {key(v) for v in frame[c].dropna().astype(str)}
        out[part].discard("")
    return out


def _later_indexes(g: Gazetteer, places: pd.DataFrame, foreign_names) -> None:
    """0.6.0: the foreign okres names, the later okresy (:data:`LATER_OKRES_1910`), the later towns,
    the timeline tokens, and the printed forms of the register's **unanchored** municipality rows
    (cross-references left out) by okres — D2's obec placeholders (T2)."""
    if isinstance(foreign_names, dict):               # foreign_name_keys(): a Czech namesake obec is no okres
        names = set(foreign_names.get("districts", ())) | (set(foreign_names.get("obce", ())) - set(g.global_any))
    else:
        names = set(foreign_names or ())
    g.foreign_okres = names | {key(n) for n in FOREIGN_OKRES}
    g.foreign_okres -= set(g.okres_by_name)           # a Czech-lands okres or court name is never foreign
    for name, targets in LATER_OKRES_1910.items():
        ids: set = set()
        for tname in targets:
            if tname.startswith("@"):
                v, sid = decide(_czech(g.global_any.get(key(tname[1:]), ()), g), _reg_status(g))
                if v == "ok" and _okres_any(sid, g) is not None:
                    ids.add(_okres_any(sid, g))
            else:
                ids |= set(g.okres_by_name.get(key(tname), ()))
        if ids:
            g.later_okres[key(name)] = ids
    for name, targets in OKRES_NAME_ALIASES.items():      # 0.7.0 (F6)
        ids = set().union(*(g.okres_by_name.get(key(t), set()) for t in targets))
        if ids:
            g.okres_alias[key(name)] = ids
    g.later_town = {k: s for k, s in LATER_TOWN_1910.items() if s in g.status}
    g.timeline_tokens = set().union(*g.timeline.values()) if g.timeline else set()
    for name in LATER_OKRES_1910:                         # 0.9.0 (E9): a later okres over 2+ 1910 okresy
        tok = _timeline_token(key(name), g)
        if tok and len(timeline_okresy(tok, g)) > 1:
            g.later_token[key(name)] = tok
    rows = places[places["settlement_id"].isna() & places["okres_id"].notna()
                  & places["place_level"].eq("municipality")]
    for cell, oid in zip(rows["printed_name"], rows["okres_id"]):
        if _XREF_RE.search(str(cell)):
            continue
        for f in pn.cell_forms(cell):
            k = key(f)
            if k:
                g.unanchored_munis.setdefault(k, set()).add(int(oid))


def _hu_indexes(g: Gazetteer, settlements_hu: pd.DataFrame | None,
                districts_hu: pd.DataFrame | None = None) -> None:
    """0.8.0 (A6): ``hu_obce``, the key of every Slovak obec name of ``settlements_hu_1910`` — those a
    Czech-lands settlement also carries included (``foreign_okres`` drops them): the namesakes of an
    inferred okres that lie in Upper Hungary. 0.9.0 (E2): ``hu_county``, the 1910 counties each district
    name (``districts_hu_1910``: Slovak, Magyar, modern and járás names), each obec name
    (``settlements_hu_1910`` through its ``zupa_sk``, :data:`ZUPA_COUNTY`) and each Subcarpathian okres
    (:data:`FOREIGN_OKRES_COUNTY`) answers to."""
    if settlements_hu is not None and "obec_sk" in settlements_hu.columns:
        g.hu_obce = {k for k in (key(v) for v in settlements_hu["obec_sk"].dropna().astype(str)) if k}
    county: dict = {}
    if districts_hu is not None and "megye_hu" in districts_hu.columns:
        for c in ("name_sk", "name_sk_alt", "name_sk_modern", "name_hu", "jaras_hu"):
            if c in districts_hu.columns:
                for v, m in zip(districts_hu[c], districts_hu["megye_hu"]):
                    if isinstance(v, str) and isinstance(m, str) and key(v):
                        county.setdefault(key(v), set()).add(m)
    if settlements_hu is not None and {"obec_sk", "zupa_sk"} <= set(settlements_hu.columns):
        for v, z in zip(settlements_hu["obec_sk"], settlements_hu["zupa_sk"]):
            if isinstance(v, str) and ZUPA_COUNTY.get(z) and key(v):
                county.setdefault(key(v), set()).add(ZUPA_COUNTY[z])
    for k, m in FOREIGN_OKRES_COUNTY.items():
        county.setdefault(k, set()).add(m)
    g.hu_county = county


def municipality_keys(municipalities: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, str]:
    """``{settlement_id: "edition|court_key|muni_seq"}`` of ``register_municipalities``.

    A ``register_key`` column (``edition|court_key|muni_seq``) is used as is; else ``court_key``;
    else the court id as text, which is the register's ``court_key`` (they differ on one unresolved
    de-bohemia row of ``register_places``, which holds no municipality). Rows without a
    ``settlement_id`` key nothing. Raises if a settlement holds two keys."""
    m = municipalities[municipalities["settlement_id"].notna()]
    if not len(m):
        return {}
    if "register_key" in m.columns:
        keys = m["register_key"].astype(str).map(lambda k: "|".join(k.split("|")[:3]))
    elif {"edition", "muni_seq"} <= set(m.columns) and ("court_key" in m.columns or "court_id" in m.columns):
        court = m["court_key"] if "court_key" in m.columns else m["court_id"]
        court = court.astype(object).map(lambda c: c if isinstance(c, str) else
                                         "" if pd.isna(c) else str(int(c)))
        keys = m["edition"].astype(str) + "|" + court + "|" + m["muni_seq"].astype("int64").astype(str)
    else:
        return {}
    out: dict[str, str] = {}
    for sid, k in zip(m["settlement_id"].astype(str), keys):
        if out.setdefault(sid, k) != k:
            raise ValueError(f"register_municipalities: {sid} under two keys {out[sid]} / {k}")
    return out


def _municipality_columns(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    import pyarrow.parquet as pq
    have = set(pq.read_schema(path).names)
    return [c for c in ("settlement_id", "edition", "court_key", "court_id", "muni_seq", "register_key")
            if c in have]


def load_gazetteer(final_dir: Path = FINAL, overrides: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
                   heals: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
                   rulings: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
                   include_unconfirmed: bool = False) -> Gazetteer:
    """The gazetteer from ``data/final`` (read only), the anchor overrides **and** the anchor rulings
    (``reference/places/anchor_rulings.csv``: anchor / replace / unanchor) applied in memory through
    :func:`utils.recheck.anchor_overrides.apply`. Only the rulings the author confirmed
    (``ruled_by = author``) apply unless ``include_unconfirmed=True``, which adds the ``evidence``
    ones (passed through to :func:`anchor_overrides.apply`). Pass ``rulings=`` an empty frame to
    measure the state before the rulings.

    *heals* (:func:`place_names.heal_frame`) may be passed in; building it takes about a minute.
    It reads the register's names, so it should come from the same rulings mode.
    """
    from utils.recheck import anchor_overrides as ao
    final_dir = Path(final_dir)
    settlements = pd.read_parquet(final_dir / "geo" / "settlements_1910.parquet")
    places = pd.read_parquet(final_dir / "register_rechecked" / "register_places.parquet")
    overrides = ao.load_overrides() if overrides is None else overrides
    rulings = ao.load_rulings() if rulings is None else rulings
    places = ao.apply(places, overrides, rulings, include_unconfirmed=include_unconfirmed)
    if heals is None:
        heals = pn.heal_frame(settlements, pn.official_names(final_dir / "geo"),
                              pn.register_names(places))
    muni_path = final_dir / "register_rechecked" / "register_municipalities.parquet"
    hu = [final_dir / "geo" / f for f in ("districts_hu_1910.parquet", "settlements_hu_1910.parquet")]
    hu_frames = [pd.read_parquet(f) if f.exists() else None for f in hu]
    foreign = foreign_name_keys(*hu_frames)                                                    # 0.6.0
    g = build_gazetteer(
        settlements, places, pd.read_parquet(final_dir / "geo" / "districts_1910.parquet"),
        pd.read_csv(final_dir / "geo" / "settlement_aliases_1910.csv"),
        pd.read_parquet(muni_path, columns=_municipality_columns(muni_path)), heals,
        foreign_names=foreign)
    _hu_indexes(g, hu_frames[1], hu_frames[0])                                    # 0.8.0 (A6), 0.9.0 (E2)
    geo = final_dir / "geo" / "settlements_1910_geo.parquet"                       # 0.11.0 (H1)
    if not geo.exists():           # 0.12.0 (I5): a required input, as the others — H1 must not turn off silently
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"birth_settlement needs {geo} (data/final/geo/settlements_1910_geo.parquet: "
                                "each 1910 settlement's modern municipality, H1's evidence)")
    import pyarrow.parquet as pq
    geo_cols = [c for c in ("settlement_id", "obec_name", "obec_kod", "okres_name")          # okres_name: 0.14.0 (K1)
                if c in set(pq.read_schema(geo).names)]
    modern_obec_index(g, pd.read_parquet(geo, columns=geo_cols))
    adjacency = final_dir / "geo" / "ruian_obce_adjacency.parquet"                # 0.13.0 (J1)
    if not adjacency.exists():     # as I5: J1's home evidence must not turn off silently
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"birth_settlement needs {adjacency} (data/final/geo/ruian_obce_adjacency.parquet: "
                                "which modern municipalities border, J1's home evidence)")
    obec_neighbours_index(g, pd.read_parquet(adjacency, columns=["obec_kod", "neighbour_kod"]))
    g.rulings_refused = [str(x) for x in places.attrs.get("anchor_rulings_refused", [])]
    g.rulings_unconfirmed = list(places.attrs.get("anchor_rulings_unconfirmed", []))
    g.rulings_applied = [tuple(k) for k in places.attrs.get("anchor_rulings_applied", [])]
    g.include_unconfirmed = bool(include_unconfirmed)
    return g


def modern_obec_index(g: Gazetteer, geo: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    """H1 (0.11.0): :attr:`Gazetteer.modern_obec` — each 1910 settlement's modern municipality (RÚIAN
    ``obec_name`` of ``data/final/geo/settlements_1910_geo.parquet``, keyed by ``settlement_id``) as a :func:`key`;
    a settlement with no RÚIAN match is left out. Read only as G1's last evidence (:func:`right_under_left`,
    :func:`left_in_right_modern`)."""
    for sid, name in zip(geo["settlement_id"], geo["obec_name"]):
        if isinstance(sid, str) and isinstance(name, str) and key(name):
            g.modern_obec[sid] = key(name)
    if "obec_kod" in geo.columns:         # 0.13.0 (J1): the modern obec's RÚIAN code, for adjacency
        for sid, kod in zip(geo["settlement_id"], geo["obec_kod"]):
            if isinstance(sid, str) and kod is not None and not pd.isna(kod):
                g.modern_obec_kod[sid] = int(kod)
    if "okres_name" in geo.columns:       # 0.14.0 (K1): the modern okres, for a ČSÚ alias row's viz_okres
        for sid, name in zip(geo["settlement_id"], geo["okres_name"]):
            if isinstance(sid, str) and isinstance(name, str) and okres_token(name):
                g.modern_okres[sid] = okres_token(name)


def obec_neighbours_index(g: Gazetteer, adjacency: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    """J1 (0.13.0): :attr:`Gazetteer.obec_neighbours` — the modern municipalities (RÚIAN ``obec_kod``) each borders,
    from ``data/final/geo/ruian_obce_adjacency.parquet``, both ways. Read only by :func:`home_namesake`'s last step."""
    for a, b in zip(adjacency["obec_kod"], adjacency["neighbour_kod"]):
        if pd.notna(a) and pd.notna(b):
            g.obec_neighbours.setdefault(int(a), set()).add(int(b))
            g.obec_neighbours.setdefault(int(b), set()).add(int(a))


def _modern_is(sid, k: str, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """H1: the modern municipality of *sid* is the name key *k* (also space-free)."""
    mk = g.modern_obec.get(sid)
    return bool(mk) and bool(k) and (mk == k or nospace(mk) == nospace(k))


# ── decisions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def decide(ids, status_of) -> tuple[str, object]:
    """D-144 on a set of ids: ``("ok", sid)`` / ``("ambiguous", sorted ids)`` / ``("none", None)``.

    *status_of* maps a sid to its status; ``"obec"`` is the independent municipality.
    """
    ids = set(ids or ())
    if not ids:
        return "none", None
    if len(ids) == 1:
        return "ok", next(iter(ids))
    obce = [s for s in ids if status_of(s) == "obec"]
    if len(obce) == 1:
        return "ok", obce[0]
    return "ambiguous", tuple(sorted(ids))


def _reg_status(g: Gazetteer):
    return lambda s: "obec" if s in g.reg_municipal else g.status.get(s, "")


def _lex_status(g: Gazetteer):
    return lambda s: g.status.get(s, "")


def numbered_guard(k: str, oid, verdict: str, val, g: Gazetteer) -> tuple[str, object]:
    """A key without a Roman numeral that reached a settlement the register prints with one, while
    the register prints 2+ numbered siblings of that base in the okres, is ambiguous across them
    (0.3.0): the German cell *Großaupa I, Velká Úpa* prints the bare *Velká Úpa* beside the
    numbered name, and 0.2.0 sent every bare *Velká Úpa* to ``velka-upa-i:1``."""
    if verdict != "ok" or _KEY_NUMERAL_RE.match(k):
        return verdict, val
    sibs = g.numbered.get((k, oid)) or g.numbered.get((nospace(k), oid)) or {}
    if val in sibs and len(sibs) > 1:
        return "ambiguous", tuple(sorted(sibs))
    return verdict, val


def _court_of(sid: str, g: Gazetteer):
    """The settlement's 1910 court: its register owner row's, else its polygon court."""
    return (g.owner.get(sid) or {}).get("court_id") or g.court_polygon.get(sid)


def seat_rule(k: str, oid, ids, g: Gazetteer):
    """The seat rule (0.4.0, the author): a name that is the okres's own name town (*k* among the
    okres's names), answered by several settlements, is the one in the okres's **seat court** —
    and, if the seat court holds several, the one whose headword is the name. ``None`` when that
    does not leave exactly one (*Podbořany*, okres Podbořany: ``podborany:1`` of court Podbořany,
    not ``podboranky:1`` of court Jesenice, whose 1910 name was also *Podbořany*)."""
    if oid is None or k not in g.okres_names.get(oid, set()) or oid not in g.seat_court:
        return None
    seat = [s for s in ids if _court_of(s, g) == g.seat_court[oid]]
    if len(seat) > 1:
        seat = [s for s in seat if key(g.cs_name.get(s)) == k]
    if len(seat) != 1:
        return None
    # 0.4.1: the seat answers only through another of its names (German *Plan* for Planá) while a
    # non-seat candidate's own Czech headword is the written key (*Pláň*, plan:3): refuse
    if key(g.cs_name.get(seat[0])) != k and any(key(g.cs_name.get(s)) == k
                                                for s in ids if s != seat[0]):
        return None
    return seat[0]


def _lookup(k: str, oid: int, g: Gazetteer, alt: bool = False) -> tuple[str, str, object]:
    """Register then lexikon on one key inside one okres: ``(verdict, tier, value)``. A D-144 tie on
    the okres's own name goes to the seat (:func:`seat_rule`, tier ``p1_okres_seat``)."""
    tables = [(g.reg, _reg_status(g), "p1_register"), (g.lex, _lex_status(g), "p1_lexikon")]
    if alt:
        tables.append((g.reg_alt, _reg_status(g), "p2_register_alt"))
    for table, status_of, tier in tables:
        verdict, val = decide(table.get((k, oid)), status_of)
        if verdict == "ambiguous":                   # D-144 could not decide: the seat may
            seat = seat_rule(k, oid, val, g)
            if seat is not None:
                return "ok", "p1_okres_seat", seat
        if verdict != "none":
            verdict, val = numbered_guard(k, oid, verdict, val, g)
            return verdict, tier, val
    return "none", "", None


# ── P3: Prague ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def prague_shape(text: str) -> tuple[str, object, str] | None:
    """``(kind, number, name)`` for a Prague-shaped string, else ``None``.

    ``kind``: ``roman`` (``Praha XI.-Žižkov`` → 11, ``Žižkov``), ``arabic`` (``Praha 2``, post-1949),
    ``named`` (``Praha-Smíchov``, ``Smíchov, Praha``), ``city`` (``Praha``, ``Hlavní město Praha``).
    """
    if _NEAR_PRAHA_RE.search(text):
        return None
    text = _CAPITAL_RE.sub("", text)
    m = _PRAHA_RE.match(text)
    if not m:
        tail = _PRAHA_TAIL_RE.match(text)
        return ("named", None, tail.group(1).strip(" ,-–")) if tail and tail.group(1).strip() else None
    rest = m.group(1).strip(" ,-–.")
    if not rest:
        return "city", None, ""
    a = _ARABIC_RE.match(rest)
    if a:
        return "arabic", int(a.group(1)), ""
    r = _ROMAN_RE.match(rest)
    if r and r.group(1) in _ROMAN and (not r.group(2) or rest[len(r.group(1)):][:1] in ".-–, "):
        return "roman", _ROMAN[r.group(1)], r.group(2).strip(" ,-–.")
    return "named", None, rest


def _pool_ids(k: str, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    return set(g.prague.get(k) or g.prague.get(nospace(k)) or ())


def _prague_pool(name: str, g: Gazetteer) -> tuple[str, object, tuple]:
    """A name in the agglomeration: ``(verdict, value, tie)``. A Prague quarter first (the Libeň
    trap: *Libeň* written under Praha is quarter VIII, ``liben:2``, not the village ``liben:3`` of
    okres Vinohrady); then a settlement that joined Prague in 1922 (a clerk who wrote "Praha" wrote
    the 1922 city: two *Záběhlice* lie in the ring, one joined); then D-144. *tie* holds the ids a
    preference chose among (empty when there was one), for the rulings queue. ``Nusle-Pankrác``:
    the right piece if the left is its parent **or the right piece's okres** (``Smíchov -
    Lipenec`` is Lipence of okres Smíchov, 0.3.0), else the left piece."""
    k = key(name)
    ids = _pool_ids(k, g)
    if not ids and re.search(r"[-–]", name):
        left, right = [key(x) for x in re.split(r"\s*[-–]\s*", name, maxsplit=1)]
        r_v, r_val, r_tie = _prague_pool(right, g) if right else ("none", None, ())
        if r_v == "ok" and (g.parent_key.get(r_val) == left
                            or left in g.okres_names.get(g.okres_of.get(r_val), set())):
            return r_v, r_val, r_tie
        # 0.4.0: "Praha-Kozojedy" — an unknown X never falls back to the left piece Praha
        if not left or _PRAHA_PIECE_RE.match(left):
            return "none", None, ()
        return _prague_pool(left, g)
    for preferred in ([s for s in ids if s in g.quarter_sids], [s for s in ids if s in g.greater_prague]):
        if len(preferred) == 1:
            return "ok", preferred[0], (tuple(sorted(ids)) if len(ids) > 1 else ())
    v, val = decide(ids, _lex_status(g))
    return v, val, (tuple(sorted(ids)) if v == "ok" and len(ids) > 1 else ())


def _p3_tier(val, g: Gazetteer) -> str:
    return "p3_prague_quarter" if val in g.quarter_sids else "p3_prague_suburb"


def p3_prague(text: str, oid, g: Gazetteer, alts=()) -> tuple[str, str, object, object, tuple]:
    """``(verdict, tier, value, quarter number, tie)`` for the Prague forms; verdict ``none`` = not
    Prague; *tie* = the ids a pool preference chose among (:func:`_prague_pool`).

    A 1923 district number with a name (``Praha VIII.-Troja``) is read by the name: post-1922
    Praha VIII was Libeň *and* the joined Troja, Kobylisy, Bohnice, Střížkov. The number alone
    (``Praha II.``) names a 1910 quarter only for I–VIII. A bare city reading with an alternate
    that is not itself a Prague form (``Praha? Hrubý Jeseník``) is refused
    ``praha_city_with_alternate``: the clerk did not know which. A bare name in an agglomeration
    okres that resolves to a quarter (*Libeň*, okres Praha) is ``p3_prague_quarter`` (0.3.0).
    """
    shape = prague_shape(text)
    if shape is None:
        if oid is not None and oid in PRAGUE_AGGLOMERATION:
            v, val, tie = _prague_pool(text, g)
            return v, _p3_tier(val, g), val, None, tie
        return "none", "", None, None, ()
    kind, num, name = shape
    if kind == "city":
        if any(prague_shape(a) is None for a in alts):
            return "refused", "p3_prague", "praha_city_with_alternate", None, ()
        return "ok", "p3_prague_city", PRAHA_SID, None, ()
    if kind == "arabic":
        return "refused", "p3_prague", "praha_post1949_number", num, ()
    v, val, tie = _prague_pool(name, g) if name else ("none", None, ())
    if v == "none" and kind == "named":
        v, val, tie = _prague_pool(text, g)
    if v == "ok":
        return v, _p3_tier(val, g), val, num, tie
    if v == "ambiguous":
        return v, "p3_prague_suburb", val, num, ()
    if kind == "roman" and num in g.quarters:
        return "ok", "p3_prague_quarter", g.quarters[num], num, ()
    if not name:
        return "refused", "p3_prague", "praha_district_unnamed", num, ()
    return "none", "p3_prague_suburb", None, num, ()


# ── P2: variants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def _variant_tables(k: str, oid: int, g: Gazetteer) -> tuple[str, str, object]:
    """The space-free index, then a ČSÚ ``viz`` alias whose target sits in the record's 1910 okres."""
    v, val = decide(g.nospace.get((nospace(k), oid)), _reg_status(g))
    if v != "none":
        v, val = numbered_guard(k, oid, v, val, g)
        return v, "p2_nospace", val
    ids = {s for t in g.alias.get(k, set()) for s in g.lex.get((t, oid), set())}
    if _on("K1"):                    # 0.14.0 (K1): the alias row's modern okres must agree, or no namesake compete
        ids = {s for s in ids if alias_in_okres(k, s, oid, g)}
    v, val = decide(ids, _lex_status(g))
    if v != "none":
        return v, "p2_alias", val
    return "none", "", None


def alias_in_okres(k: str, sid: str, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """K1 (0.14.0): settlement *sid* of okres *oid*, reached through a ČSÚ ``viz`` alias of the key *k*, is the
    alias's target — a row of the alias names a modern okres (``viz_okres``) that is in *sid*'s ``okres_all``
    timeline or is its modern okres (:attr:`Gazetteer.modern_okres`), or names none; or else the okres holds no
    other namesake of *k* (:func:`bare_namesakes`). *LHOTA viz Lhotka (Benešov / Ústí n. O.)* does not reach
    ``lhotky:4`` of okres Náchod (1910 *Lhotka*, timeline Nové Město|Náchod), where Lhota pod Hořičkami, Lhota za
    Červeným Kostelcem and Řešetova Lhota lie; *TĚŠICE viz Tršice (Olomouc)* reaches ``trsice:2`` (timeline
    Hranice|Olomouc).

    0.15.0 (L2): where the row's okres disagrees, the fallback holds only where the written name is a spelling of one
    of the target's own names (:func:`alias_spelling`): *ŠUMVALD viz Podlesí (Opava)* does not reach ``podlesi:14`` of
    okres Šumperk (1910 Krumperky). L3: the namesakes counted are :func:`alias_rivals`'s."""
    if alias_okres_agrees(k, sid, oid, g):
        return True
    if alias_rivals(k, sid, oid, g):
        return False
    return not _on("L2") or alias_spelling(k, sid, g)


def alias_rivals(k: str, sid: str, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """K1 (0.14.0): the namesakes of *k* in okres *oid* (:func:`bare_namesakes`) other than the alias target *sid* that
    stand against it. 0.15.0 (L3): not a namesake in the target's own 1910 municipality (:func:`_muni_of`: a register
    part of *sid*, or a part of the municipality *sid* is a part of) — the municipality is certain whichever of them
    the record meant: Dolní Bezděkov is a part of Horní Bezděkov; Malý Oujezd and Velký Oujezd (okres Mladá Boleslav)
    are both parts of Bratronice. So only obce, and the parts of **other** municipalities, are rivals: Stará Huť 2. díl
    (a part of Sudějov) stands against the alias's Stará Huť (a part of Lošiny), and the osada Žlebská Lhotka against
    *LHOTKA viz Lhota (Blansko)*'s Sovoluská Lhota (okres Čáslav). A namesake whose municipality is unknown is a
    rival."""
    names = bare_namesakes(k, oid, g) - {sid}
    if not _on("L3"):
        return names
    own = _muni_of(sid, g)
    return {s for s in names if own is None or _muni_of(s, g) != own}


def _muni_of(sid, g: Gazetteer):
    """L3 (0.15.0): the 1910 municipality of settlement *sid* — its owner register row's municipality
    (:attr:`Gazetteer.owner` ``muni_sid``), else ``None``."""
    return (g.owner.get(sid) or {}).get("muni_sid")


#: L2 (0.15.0): how close (:class:`difflib.SequenceMatcher` ratio, space-free) the written name must be to one of an
#: alias target's own names for the "no other namesake" fallback to take it where the alias row names another okres
ALIAS_SPELLING_RATIO = 0.6


def alias_spelling(k: str, sid: str, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """L2 (0.15.0): the written key *k* is a spelling of one of settlement *sid*'s own names — its lexicon names, the
    forms of every register row holding it, its 1910 name and its owner row's printed forms — at a
    :class:`difflib.SequenceMatcher` ratio of at least :data:`ALIAS_SPELLING_RATIO` (*Bezděkov* / Horní Bezděkov
    0.76), or *k* is qualified and its head is one of them (*Újezd u Průhonic* / Újezd). *Šumvald* / Podlesí,
    Krumperky, Grumberg (0.27) is not."""
    own = (g.forms_of.get(sid, set()) | g.pool_forms.get(sid, set()) | g.forms_1910.get(sid, set())
           | ((g.owner.get(sid) or {}).get("printed_forms") or set()))
    if not own or not k:
        return False
    head = strip_qualifier(k)
    if head != k and nospace(head) in own:
        return True
    nk = nospace(k)
    return any(difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, nk, f).ratio() >= ALIAS_SPELLING_RATIO for f in own)


def alias_other_okres(k: str, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """L2 (0.15.0): a ``viz`` alias of the bare key *k* reached settlements of okres *oid*, and every one of them was set
    aside only because its row names another okres and *k* spells none of its names (:func:`alias_in_okres`,
    :func:`alias_spelling`) — no namesake stood against it. Where no later tier matched, :func:`_first_verdict`
    refuses the record ``alias_other_okres`` instead of ``unmatched``."""
    if oid is None or not k or strip_qualifier(k) != k:
        return False
    reached = {s for t in g.alias.get(k, set()) for s in g.lex.get((t, oid), set())}
    return bool(reached) and all(not alias_okres_agrees(k, s, oid, g) and not alias_rivals(k, s, oid, g)
                                 and not alias_spelling(k, s, g) for s in reached)


def alias_okres_agrees(k: str, sid: str, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """K1 (0.14.0): a ``viz`` row of the alias key *k* that reaches settlement *sid* of okres *oid* names a modern okres
    in *sid*'s ``okres_all`` timeline or *sid*'s modern okres (:attr:`Gazetteer.modern_okres`), or names none."""
    okresy = {o for (t, o) in g.alias_okres.get(k, ()) if sid in g.lex.get((t, oid), ())}
    return "" in okresy or bool(okresy & (g.timeline.get(sid, set()) | {g.modern_okres.get(sid)}))


def alias_namesake_refusal(k: str, oid, g: Gazetteer, home=None):
    """K1 (0.14.0): where every settlement a ``viz`` alias of the bare key *k* reached in okres *oid* was set aside
    (:func:`alias_in_okres`) and no later tier matched, the namesakes of *k* in the okres (:func:`bare_namesakes`)
    answer as J1's do: the one the home picks (:func:`home_namesake`), tier ``p2_qualifier``, else the refusal
    ``ambiguous:p2_bare_namesakes`` listing them (up to 12, as P4's ``ambiguous:p4_in_okres``) — not ``unmatched``.
    ``None`` when the alias reached nothing or kept something, or *k* has no namesake there.

    0.15.0 (L3): the namesakes leave out those in a set-aside target's own 1910 municipality (:func:`_muni_of`), the
    target itself kept; which namesakes stand against a target at all is :func:`alias_rivals`'s count, through
    :func:`alias_in_okres`. L6:
    the refusal lists the set-aside target(s) beside the namesakes, so it names both readings — *Lhotka* | Čáslav
    lists ``sovoluska-lhota:1`` (the alias's *Lhota*) and ``zlebska-lhotka:1``, not a single candidate."""
    if oid is None or not k or strip_qualifier(k) != k:
        return None
    reached = {s for t in g.alias.get(k, set()) for s in g.lex.get((t, oid), set())}
    if not reached or any(alias_in_okres(k, s, oid, g) for s in reached):
        return None
    names = bare_namesakes(k, oid, g)
    if _on("L3"):
        munis = {_muni_of(s, g) for s in reached} - {None}
        names = {s for s in names if s in reached or _muni_of(s, g) not in munis}
    if not names:
        return None
    pick = home_namesake(home, k, names, oid, g)
    if pick is not None:
        return "ok", "p2_qualifier", pick
    listed = names | reached if _on("L6") else names
    return "ambiguous", "p2_bare_namesakes", tuple(sorted(listed)[:12])


def _lookup_any(k: str, oid: int, g: Gazetteer) -> tuple[str, str, object]:
    """P1, the de-bohemia forms, then the space-free and alias tables — for one split piece."""
    res = _lookup(k, oid, g, alt=True)
    return res if res[0] != "none" else _variant_tables(k, oid, g)


def _parent_ok(left: str, right_sid: str, oid: int, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """The left piece of ``left-right`` is the right piece's parent, municipality or okres seat."""
    if left in g.okres_names.get(oid, set()) or left == g.parent_key.get(right_sid):
        return True
    v, _t, left_sid = _lookup_any(left, oid, g)
    owner = g.owner.get(right_sid, {})
    return v == "ok" and left_sid in {owner.get("muni_sid"), right_sid}


def _piece_lookup(k: str, oid: int, g: Gazetteer) -> tuple[str, str, object]:
    """:func:`_lookup_any` for a **piece** of a string: never ``praha:1`` (0.4.0 — *Tejnka,
    Praha-Břevnov* is not the city of Prague)."""
    res = _lookup_any(k, oid, g)
    return ("none", "", None) if res[0] == "ok" and res[2] == PRAHA_SID else res


def p2_split(text: str, oid: int, g: Gazetteer, uncertain: bool, vua: bool = False) -> tuple[str, str, object]:
    """``parent-part``: the right piece if the left is its parent; else the left piece alone.

    A VÚA reading off an uncertain candidate list whose piece is a big city or a land
    (``Bratrouchov-Brno``, ``Bělá-Čechy``) is refused ``city_on_hamlet``. No piece resolves to
    ``praha:1`` (0.4.0, :func:`_piece_lookup`).

    0.9.0: E4 — in VÚA's ``Obec-Část`` form (*vua*: a VÚA cell or candidate; :func:`_obec_cast`;
    csol.cz's *Zaháj -Litomyšl* and *Rájec-Jestřebí* name a place and its town, or a town) whose two pieces are **distinct** 1910 settlements of the
    okres, the left not the right's parent and the right no okres name, the right piece is taken: the part VÚA names was its own
    1910 obec (*Kralupy nad Vltavou-Míkovice* → ``mikovice:1``; *Nelahozeves-Hleďsebe*, which the register
    prints *Hleďsebe … viz Kralupy*, so that Hleďsebe answers only through Kralupy: refused ambiguous); where the
    register files the right piece
    under the left, the left is its parent and the right is taken as before. E11 — a comma piece after
    the first that is an okres name or a big city (:attr:`Gazetteer.city_pieces`) locates the place and is
    no piece of it (*Stupno - Břasy, Plzeň* is not ``plzen:1``; *Svatobořice, Kyjov* is Svatobořice; a
    court name stays a piece: *Litoměřice, Úštěk* is Úštěk).

    0.10.0: G1 — in a VÚA string (*vua*), of the right piece's namesakes in the okres the one under the left piece
    (:func:`right_under_left`) is taken, also where D-144 picked another or none (*Střechov-Dubovka* →
    ``dubovka:2``); in the E4 shape with 2+ namesakes, none under the left, a D-144 pick that is a part of another
    municipality is refused ambiguous. G3 — only a big city or the record's own okres is a locator
    (:func:`okres_locator`).

    0.11.0: H1 — where no namesake lies under the left piece in 1910, the modern municipality decides
    (:func:`right_under_left`: *Jesenice-Martinice* → ``martinice:6``; :func:`left_in_right_modern`, the reversed
    order: *Mezná-Hřensko* → ``mezna:1``), and D-144's obec pick no longer stands against it.
    """
    pieces = [p for p in re.split(r"\s*[-–/]\s*|\s*,\s*", text) if p.strip()]
    if len(pieces) < 2:
        return "none", "", None
    if uncertain and any(key(p) in g.city_pieces for p in pieces):
        return "refused", "p2_split", "city_on_hamlet"
    if _on("E11") and "," in text:
        first, *rest = [p for p in re.split(r"\s*,\s*", text) if p.strip()] or [text]
        if _on("G3"):        # 0.10.0: only the record's own okres (its town) or a big city locates the place
            rest = [p for p in rest if not okres_locator(p, oid, g)]
        else:
            rest = [p for p in rest if not (key(p) in _okres_name_keys(g) or key(p) in g.city_pieces)]
        pieces = [p for p in re.split(r"\s*[-–/]\s*|\s*,\s*", ", ".join([first, *rest])) if p.strip()]
        if len(pieces) == 1:                    # the place and its okres: the place alone
            v, _t, sid = _piece_lookup(key(pieces[0]), oid, g)
            return (v, "p2_split_left", sid) if v != "none" else ("none", "", None)
        if len(pieces) < 2:
            return "none", "", None
    keys = [key(p) for p in pieces]
    if len(pieces) == 2:
        left, right = keys
        v, _t, sid = _piece_lookup(right, oid, g)
        if v == "ok" and _parent_ok(left, sid, oid, g):
            return "ok", "p2_split_right", sid
        lv, _t, lsid = _piece_lookup(left, oid, g)
        if _on("G1") and vua and v in ("ok", "ambiguous"):
            # 0.10.0 (G1): VÚA's Obec-Část names the part *under* the obec — of the right piece's namesakes
            # in the okres, the one whose 1910 parent (or register owner) is the left piece
            under = right_under_left(left, right, oid, g, lsid if lv == "ok" else None)
            if len(under) == 1:
                return "ok", "p2_split_right", next(iter(under))
            if _on("H1") and v == "ok" and not under and _obec_cast_shape(text, right, g):
                # 0.11.0 (H1): the part first, its modern municipality second — no namesake of either piece lies
                # under the other in 1910, and the left piece names a settlement of the okres whose modern obec is
                # the right piece (Mezná-Hřensko: mezna:1)
                lefts = obec_cast_namesakes(left, oid, g) - {sid}
                rev = (set() if any(under_left(s, right, sid, g) for s in lefts)
                       else left_in_right_modern(left, right, oid, g, sid))
                if len(rev) == 1:
                    return "ok", "p2_split_left", next(iter(rev))
        if v == "ambiguous":
            return v, "p2_split_right", sid
        if _on("E4") and vua and v == "ok" and lv == "ok" and lsid != sid and _obec_cast(text, left, right, lsid, sid, g):
            namesakes = obec_cast_namesakes(right, oid, g) - {lsid}
            modern_other = {s for s in namesakes - {sid} if _modern_is(s, left, g)} if _on("H1") else set()
            if _on("G1") and len(namesakes) >= 2 and (g.status.get(sid) != "obec" or modern_other):
                # G1: the right piece has namesakes in the okres, none lies under the left, and D-144's pick is a
                # part of another municipality: which part VÚA meant is open (0.9.0 took the pick). A pick that was
                # its own 1910 obec stands — 0.11.0 (H1) only where no modern municipality names another namesake
                # under the left piece (Jesenice-Martinice: martinice:6 by H1, not D-144's martinice:1)
                return "ambiguous", "p2_split_right", tuple(sorted(namesakes))
            names = _name_forms(sid, g) | g.forms_1910.get(sid, set())
            if not any(difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, f, n).ratio() >= OBEC_CAST_NAME_RATIO
                       for f in form_set([right]) for n in names):
                # the part VÚA names answers only through another settlement (a 'viz' row, an alias): neither
                # piece is preferable (Nelahozeves-Hleďsebe, which the register prints 'viz Kralupy')
                return "ambiguous", "p2_split_right", tuple(sorted({lsid, sid}))
            return "ok", "p2_split_right", sid
        return (lv, "p2_split_left", lsid) if lv != "none" else ("none", "", None)
    found = [_piece_lookup(k, oid, g) for k in keys]
    oks = {val for v, _t, val in found if v == "ok"}
    return ("ok", "p2_split_pieces", next(iter(oks))) if len(oks) == 1 else ("none", "", None)


def _obec_cast(text: str, left: str, right: str, lsid, sid, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """E4 (0.9.0): ``left-right`` is VÚA's ``Obec-Část`` — a hyphen with no space either side, the right
    piece neither an okres or court name nor a big city (*Chyňava-Unhošť*, *Vesec-Sobotka*: a place and the
    town it lies by), and the left no part of the right (*Svatá-Černín*, *Švihov-Krupín*: the part first,
    its municipality second — the left is the place)."""
    if not _obec_cast_shape(text, right, g):
        return False
    return (g.owner.get(lsid) or {}).get("muni_sid") != sid and g.parent_key.get(lsid) != right


def _obec_cast_shape(text: str, right: str, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """E4's string shape (:func:`_obec_cast`, 0.11.0: shared with H1's reversed order): ``left-right``, a hyphen
    with no space either side, the right piece neither an okres or court name nor a big city."""
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[^,/\s–-][^,/–-]*[^,/\s–-]-[^,/\s–-][^,/–-]*", text.strip()):
        return False
    return not (right in g.okres_by_name or nospace(right) in g.okres_by_name or right in g.city_pieces)


def okres_locator(piece: str, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """G3 (0.10.0): a comma piece after the first is the place's okres locator, not a piece of it, when it is a
    big city (:attr:`Gazetteer.city_pieces`) or names the record's **own** okres *oid* and does not resolve to a
    settlement of that okres other than its town (one in the okres's seat court): *Stupno - Břasy, Plzeň* is not
    ``plzen:1``; *Jablunkov, Piosek, Písek* | Český Těšín keeps *Písek* (``pisek:2``, Piosek of okres Těšín —
    0.9.0 dropped any piece naming any okres, here the Bohemian okres Písek)."""
    k = key(piece)
    if k in g.city_pieces:
        return True
    if oid is None or k not in g.okres_names.get(oid, set()):
        return False
    v, _t, sid = _piece_lookup(k, oid, g)
    return v == "none" or (v == "ok" and _court_of(sid, g) == g.seat_court.get(oid))


def obec_cast_namesakes(right: str, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """G1 (0.10.0): every settlement of okres *oid* answering to the key *right* — a lexikon or register name
    (:attr:`Gazetteer.okres_keys`), also space-free — never ``praha:1``."""
    if oid is None or not right:
        return set()
    ids = set(g.okres_keys.get(oid, {}).get(right, ())) | set(g.nospace.get((nospace(right), oid), ()))
    return ids - {PRAHA_SID}


def _parent_forms(pk: str) -> set:
    """The space-free forms a 1910 parent key names: each name of ``X t. Y`` and each leading run of its words
    (*Franzenthal-Ulgersdorf* → ``franzenthal``, ``franzenthalulgersdorf``) — a compound obec named by its first
    member."""
    out = set()
    for p in re.split(r"\s+t\s+", pk or ""):
        words = p.split()
        out |= {"".join(words[:i]) for i in range(1, len(words) + 1)}
    out.discard("")
    return out


def under_left(sid: str, left: str, lsid, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """G1 (0.10.0): settlement *sid* lies under the left piece of ``left-right`` — its register owner is the
    left piece's settlement *lsid*, or its 1910 parent (:func:`_parent_forms`) is the left key or a name of *lsid*
    (*Frymburk-Damětice*: ``dametice:1``, parent *Frimburk* = the 1910 name of ``frymburk:2``), or it shares
    *lsid*'s 1910 parent (two osady of one obec: *Travná-Kameničky*, both of Rohozná)."""
    if lsid is not None and sid != lsid and (g.owner.get(sid) or {}).get("muni_sid") == lsid:
        return True
    pk = g.parent_key.get(sid) or ""
    if not pk:
        return False
    parents = _parent_forms(pk)
    lefts = {nospace(left)} | ((_name_forms(lsid, g) | g.forms_1910.get(lsid, set())) if lsid else set())
    if parents & lefts:
        return True
    return bool(lsid) and bool(g.parent_key.get(lsid)) and _parent_forms(g.parent_key.get(lsid)) == parents


def right_under_left(left: str, right: str, oid, g: Gazetteer, lsid=None, modern: bool = True) -> set:
    """G1 (0.10.0): the namesakes of the right piece in the okres (:func:`obec_cast_namesakes`) that lie under
    the left piece (:func:`under_left`): *Střechov-Dubovka* → {``dubovka:2``} (osada of Střechov), not D-144's
    ``dubovka:1`` (a part of Neveklov).

    0.11.0 (H1): where none lies under it in 1910, those whose **modern** municipality is the left piece
    (:attr:`Gazetteer.modern_obec`; *modern* = False skips this): *Jesenice-Martinice* → {``martinice:6``}, osada
    of Nedrahovice in 1910 and a part of Jesenice today, not D-144's ``martinice:1`` (a part of Votice)."""
    names = obec_cast_namesakes(right, oid, g) - {lsid}
    under = {s for s in names if under_left(s, left, lsid, g)}
    if not under and modern and _on("H1"):
        under = {s for s in names if _modern_is(s, left, g)}
    return under


def left_in_right_modern(left: str, right: str, oid, g: Gazetteer, sid=None) -> set:
    """H1 (0.11.0): VÚA's *Část-Obec* written the other way round — the namesakes of the **left** piece in the
    okres whose modern municipality (:attr:`Gazetteer.modern_obec`) is the right piece, other than the right
    piece's own settlement *sid*: *Mezná-Hřensko* → {``mezna:1``} (its own 1910 obec, a part of Hřensko today;
    Hřensko was never under Mezná), *Polanka-Chotoviny* → {``polanka:6``} (osada of Beranova Lhota)."""
    return {s for s in obec_cast_namesakes(left, oid, g) - {sid} if _modern_is(s, right, g)}


def _okres_name_keys(g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """Every okres and okres-seat name key (:attr:`Gazetteer.okres_names`), memoised (0.9.0, E4/E11)."""
    cache = g.__dict__.get("_okres_name_keys")
    if cache is None:
        cache = g.__dict__["_okres_name_keys"] = set().union(*g.okres_names.values()) if g.okres_names else set()
    return cache


def p2_qualifier(k: str, oid: int, g: Gazetteer, home=None) -> tuple[str, str, object]:
    """A ``u/nad/pod/na/v/ve/při`` qualifier on **one** side only: the record's stripped against the
    exact names, or the bare record against the stripped *qualified* names. Two different
    qualifiers (``Oldřichov v Hájích`` vs ``Oldřichov na Hranicích``) never meet — also when the
    register prints the candidate bare but its headword carries another qualifier
    (``Kostomlaty pod Milešovkou`` is not ``Kostomlaty`` = *Kostomlaty pod Řípem*).

    Since 0.3.0 such a meeting is a refusal, ``("refused", "p2_qualifier", "qualifier_conflict")``,
    not ``none``: the okres holds the same head under another qualifier, so a later tier (P4's
    qualifier strip) must not hand the record to a namesake elsewhere — *Lhota u Červeného
    Kostelce*, okres Náchod, holds *Lhota za Červeným Kostelcem* and is not ``lhota:15`` of
    okres Nové Město. :func:`_first_verdict` still lets P4 take the name **exactly as written**.

    0.5.0 (D4a): ``head_in_okres`` links when the okres holds **exactly one** settlement with the
    bare key and no qualified form of it — *Klášter nad Jizerou* | Mnichovo Hradiště is
    ``klaster-hradiste-nad-jizerou:1`` (1910 *Klášter*), the record's qualifier being the modern
    one; tier ``p2_qualifier``, so the link is flagged through ``settlement_piece_tier``.

    0.12.0 (I2): the stripped head links only where the name **as written** is no other 1910 settlement outside the
    okres (:func:`qualified_elsewhere`) — else ``qualifier_conflict``, unless the soldier's *home* municipality lies in
    the okres (:func:`home_muni_in_okres`): *Lipník nad Bečvou (čp. 286)* | Moravský Krumlov is refused (the okres's
    ``lipnik:2`` had 95 houses; ``lipnik-nad-becvou:1`` is okres Hranice), *Police nad Metují* | Zábřeh with home
    Drozdov (okres Zábřeh) keeps ``police:1``.

    0.13.0 (J1): the bare record's pick stands only where it is the okres's one candidate among **all** the name's
    namesakes there (:func:`bare_namesake_verdict`); else ``ambiguous:p2_bare_namesakes``, unless the home picks.

    0.14.0 (K2): first, a qualified record written abbreviated in the okres (:func:`qualifier_abbreviated`). 0.14.0
    (K1): where D-144 cannot decide among the qualified forms of the bare record, the home may pick one of the name's
    namesakes (:func:`home_namesake`), as J1 lets it where D-144 could."""
    stripped = strip_qualifier(k)
    if stripped != k and _on("K2"):      # 0.14.0 (K2): an abbreviated name of one settlement of the okres
        abbreviated = qualifier_abbreviated(k, oid, g)
        if abbreviated is not None:
            return "ok", "p2_qualifier", abbreviated
    if stripped != k:
        v, _t, val = _lookup(stripped, oid, g)
        if v == "ok":
            head = key(g.cs_name.get(val))
            if strip_qualifier(head) != head and head != k:
                # 0.4.0: a qualified form of the head in the okres, or only the bare head printed
                if g.qualifier.get((stripped, oid)):
                    return "refused", "p2_qualifier", "qualifier_conflict"
                if bare_ids(stripped, oid, g) != {val}:
                    return "refused", "p2_qualifier", "head_in_okres"
            if (_on("I2") and head != k and qualified_elsewhere(k, oid, g, val)
                    and not home_muni_in_okres(home, oid, g)):
                return "refused", "p2_qualifier", "qualifier_conflict"
    else:
        v, val = decide(g.qualifier.get((k, oid)), _reg_status(g))
        if v == "ok" and _on("J1"):
            return bare_namesake_verdict(k, oid, val, g, home)
        if v == "ambiguous" and _on("K1"):       # 0.14.0 (K1): the home may pick among the namesakes here too
            pick = home_namesake(home, k, bare_namesakes(k, oid, g) | set(val), oid, g)
            if pick is not None:
                return "ok", "p2_qualifier", pick
    return (v, "p2_qualifier", val) if v != "none" else ("none", "", None)


def _variant_home_needed(m, german, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """K1 (0.14.0): the record's bare written name may reach :func:`bare_variant_verdict` — an alias key, or written
    with an alternate, or with a VÚA German form — so its home municipality is read (:func:`home_namesake`)."""
    if not isinstance(m, str):
        return False
    clean, alts = clean_birthplace(m)
    if not clean:
        return False
    k = key(clean)
    if strip_qualifier(k) != k:
        return False
    return bool(alts) or k in g.alias or isinstance(german, str)


def _qualified_heads(g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """J1 (0.13.0): every bare head some qualified settlement name carries (the keys of :attr:`Gazetteer.qualifier`),
    memoised — the bare names :func:`p2_qualifier`'s bare-record branch can reach, which read the home."""
    heads = g.__dict__.get("_qualified_heads")
    if heads is None:
        heads = g.__dict__["_qualified_heads"] = {kk for (kk, _o) in g.qualifier}
    return heads


def bare_namesakes(k: str, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """J1 (0.13.0): every settlement of okres *oid* with a name (lexikon or register, either edition:
    :attr:`Gazetteer.okres_keys`) whose **head** — the name without its ``u/nad/pod`` qualifier — holds the bare key
    *k* as a whole word: for *Lhota* in okres Strakonice *Lhota u Dubu* and *Lhota pod Kůstrým*, and as well
    *Horažďovická Lhota*, *Střelskohoštická Lhota* and *Kapsova Lhota*; not *Loukov u Bystřice pod Hostýnem* for
    *Bystřice* (the word is in its qualifier). Never ``praha:1``."""
    if oid is None or not k:
        return set()
    pat = re.compile(rf"(?<!\S){re.escape(k)}(?!\S)")
    out: set = set()
    for kk, sids in g.okres_keys.get(oid, {}).items():
        if pat.search(strip_qualifier(kk)):
            out |= set(sids)
    return out - {PRAHA_SID}


def bare_namesake_verdict(k: str, oid, val, g: Gazetteer, home=None) -> tuple[str, str, object]:
    """J1 (0.13.0): the bare record's qualifier-tier pick *val* (D-144 on the qualified forms of *k* in okres *oid*)
    against every namesake of *k* there (:func:`bare_namesakes`). The candidates are *val* and every obec among
    them; one candidate keeps ``("ok", "p2_qualifier", val)``. Several: the settlement the soldier's home picks
    among the namesakes (:func:`home_namesake`), tier ``p2_qualifier``; else ``("ambiguous", "p2_bare_namesakes",
    candidates)``. *Lhota* | Strakonice was ``dubska-lhota:1`` (*Lhota u Dubu*, the one qualified obec) although
    *Horažďovická Lhota* and *Střelskohoštická Lhota* are obce of the okres too: refused, or with home *Horažďovice*
    ``horazdovicka-lhota:1``."""
    names = bare_namesakes(k, oid, g)
    status = _reg_status(g)
    cands = {s for s in names if status(s) == "obec"} | {val}
    if len(cands) <= 1:
        return "ok", "p2_qualifier", val
    pick = home_namesake(home, k, names | {val}, oid, g)
    if pick is not None:
        return "ok", "p2_qualifier", pick
    return "ambiguous", "p2_bare_namesakes", tuple(sorted(cands))


def bare_variant_verdict(k: str, oid, v: str, tier: str, val, g: Gazetteer, home=None) -> tuple[str, str, object]:
    """K1 (0.14.0): J1 on the variant tiers. A **bare** written key *k* that ``p2_alternate``, ``p2_german`` or
    ``p2_alias`` sent to a settlement *val* none of whose names is *k* goes through :func:`bare_namesake_verdict`:
    the pick stands (at its own *tier*) where it is the okres's one candidate among the name's namesakes; else the
    home may pick one of them, the pick included (tier ``p2_qualifier``, flagged uncertain), or the record is refused
    ``ambiguous:p2_bare_namesakes``. *Lhota* | Náchod is not
    the alias's ``lhotky:4`` (1910 *Lhotka*): the okres holds three obce named Lhota. An alternate or German form
    that names one of those namesakes itself (*Lhota (Lhota pod Hořičkami)*) is the record's own answer and stands;
    an alias is the authority's general pointer, so even one whose row agrees with the okres meets the namesakes
    (*Těšice* | Hranice: *TĚŠICE viz Tršice (Olomouc)*, while Dolní and Horní Těšice are obce of the okres) — unless
    every candidate obec is a 1910 piece of the alias settlement's own modern municipality (:func:`_one_modern_obec`:
    *Javorník* | Frývaldov, *JAVORNÍK viz Město Javorník (Šumperk)*, beside Ves Javorník: both today's Javorník).
    Anything else is returned unchanged.

    0.15.0 (L1): *val*'s names are its **full** names (:func:`full_name_forms`), not the single words
    :attr:`Gazetteer.pool_forms` holds (*Lhota* is no name of Chocenická Lhota); a 1910 town of the written name stands
    over its namesake villages (:func:`town_over_village`: *Libavá* → ``mesto-libava:1``). L3: an alias target taken
    where its row names another okres while the okres holds namesakes :func:`alias_rivals` does not count (those in
    the target's own 1910 municipality) is J1's one candidate — tier ``p2_qualifier``, flagged uncertain (*Bezděkov* | Kladno →
    ``horni-bezdekov:2``, beside its part Dolní Bezděkov)."""
    if v != "ok" or not _on("K1") or not k or strip_qualifier(k) != k or val is None:
        return v, tier, val
    names = full_name_forms(val, g) if _on("L1") else _name_forms(val, g) | g.forms_1910.get(val, set())
    if form_set({k}) & names:
        return v, tier, val
    if tier in ("p2_alternate", "p2_german") and val in bare_namesakes(k, oid, g):
        return v, tier, val
    if _on("L1") and town_over_village(k, oid, val, g):
        return v, tier, val
    if tier == "p2_alias" and alias_okres_agrees(k, val, oid, g) and _one_modern_obec(k, oid, val, g):
        return v, tier, val
    status = _reg_status(g)
    if len({s for s in bare_namesakes(k, oid, g) if status(s) == "obec"} | {val}) <= 1:
        if (_on("L3") and tier == "p2_alias" and not alias_okres_agrees(k, val, oid, g)
                and bare_namesakes(k, oid, g) - {val}):
            return "ok", "p2_qualifier", val     # 0.15.0 (L3): J1's one candidate among namesakes it does not count
        return v, tier, val                  # the okres's one candidate: the pick stands at its own tier
    return bare_namesake_verdict(k, oid, val, g, home)


def full_name_forms(sid, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """L1 (0.15.0): the :func:`form_set` forms of settlement *sid*'s **full** names — its lexicon names
    (:attr:`Gazetteer.forms_of`), its 1910 name (:attr:`Gazetteer.forms_1910`) and the printed forms of its owner
    register row — without the single words :func:`printed_split` cuts a two-word printed form into
    (:attr:`Gazetteer.pool_forms`)."""
    return (g.forms_of.get(sid, set()) | g.forms_1910.get(sid, set())
            | ((g.owner.get(sid) or {}).get("printed_forms") or set()))


#: L1 (0.15.0): the words a 1910 town's name adds to the place's own (as :func:`key` writes them)
TOWN_WORDS = frozenset({"mesto", "mestys", "mestecko", "stadt", "markt"})


def _town_heads(sid, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """L1 (0.15.0): settlement *sid*'s names (its lexicon name, the printed keys of its owner row) without a word of
    :data:`TOWN_WORDS`, space-free, where a name carries one (*MĚSTO LIBAVÁ*, *Libavá Město*, *Stadt Liebau* →
    ``libava``, ``liebau``); empty for a name with none."""
    names = [key(g.cs_name.get(sid))] + list((g.owner.get(sid) or {}).get("printed_keys") or ())
    out = set()
    for n in names:
        words = (n or "").split()
        if any(w in TOWN_WORDS for w in words):
            rest = [w for w in words if w not in TOWN_WORDS]
            if rest:
                out.add(nospace(" ".join(rest)))
    return out


def is_town(sid, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """L1 (0.15.0): settlement *sid* was a 1910 town — a statutory city (:attr:`Gazetteer.statutory_sids`) or a name
    that carries *Město* / *Městys* / *Městečko* / *Stadt* / *Markt* (:func:`_town_heads`)."""
    return sid in g.statutory_sids or bool(_town_heads(sid, g))


def town_over_village(k: str, oid, val, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """L1 (0.15.0): the pick *val* is a 1910 town whose name is the written bare key *k* with a town word
    (:func:`_town_heads`), and no other obec of *k*'s namesakes in okres *oid* is a town (:func:`is_town`): the town
    is the natural reading of the bare name (*Libavá* | Moravský Beroun → ``mesto-libava:1``, Město Libavá, over Stará
    Libavá). A statutory city of the name itself never gets here: its own name is the written one."""
    if nospace(k) not in _town_heads(val, g):
        return False
    status = _reg_status(g)
    return not any(is_town(s, g) for s in bare_namesakes(k, oid, g) - {val} if status(s) == "obec")


def _one_modern_obec(k: str, oid, val, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """K1 (0.14.0): every obec among the namesakes of *k* in okres *oid* (:func:`bare_namesakes`), and *val*, lie in
    one modern municipality (:attr:`Gazetteer.modern_obec`, all known): Město and Ves Javorník are both Javorník."""
    status = _reg_status(g)
    cands = {s for s in bare_namesakes(k, oid, g) if status(s) == "obec"} | {val}
    modern = {g.modern_obec.get(s) for s in cands}
    return len(modern) == 1 and None not in modern and "" not in modern


#: K1 (0.14.0): a parenthesised alternate that is a qualifier — a preposition and its object (*u Č.Kostelce*), as keys
_LOCATOR_ALT_RE = re.compile(r"^(?:u|nad|pod|na|v|ve|pri|za|pred|mezi)\s+\S")


def locator_alternates(clean: str, alts, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> tuple[str, tuple]:
    """K1 (0.14.0): a bare name's parenthesised alternates that say **where** it lies rather than give another name
    of it. The first that is a qualifier — a preposition and its object (:data:`_LOCATOR_ALT_RE`; one, with no comma,
    dash or slash: *(nad Vltavou - u Borovan???)* and *(u Litomyšle?, u Jarošova?)* name two places) — becomes the
    name's qualifier where the bare name is no settlement of the okres (P1), or the located name is another one than
    the bare name's (exactly, or abbreviated: :func:`qualifier_abbreviated`): *Lhota (u Č.Kostelce)* is read *Lhota u
    Č.Kostelce*; *Kámen (u Habrů)* stays *Kámen*, whose P1 settlement it is. Else one that names the record's own
    okres or one of its courts (:attr:`Gazetteer.okres_by_name`) is dropped where the okres holds a namesake of the
    name (:func:`bare_namesakes`): *Jeseník (Nymburk)* | Poděbrady (court Nymburk) is a Jeseník of the okres, not
    the court town. A qualified name, or a record with no okres, is returned unchanged."""
    k = key(clean) if clean else ""
    if not alts or not k or oid is None or strip_qualifier(k) != k:
        return clean, tuple(alts)
    for a in alts:
        if _LOCATOR_ALT_RE.match(key(a)) and not re.search(r"[,;/–-]", a):
            joined, rest = f"{clean} {a}", tuple(x for x in alts if x is not a)
            v1, _t, s1 = _lookup(k, oid, g)
            if v1 == "none":                     # the bare name is no settlement of the okres: the locator's reading
                return joined, rest
            vj, _t, sj = _lookup(key(joined), oid, g)
            sj = sj if vj == "ok" else (qualifier_abbreviated(key(joined), oid, g) if _on("K2") else None)
            if sj is not None and sj != s1:      # the bare name is one settlement, the located name another
                return joined, rest
            return clean, tuple(alts)
    if not bare_namesakes(k, oid, g):
        return clean, tuple(alts)
    return clean, tuple(a for a in alts if oid not in (g.okres_by_name.get(key(a), set())
                                                       | g.okres_by_name.get(nospace(key(a)), set())))


def home_namesake(home, k: str, ids, oid, g: Gazetteer):
    """J1 (0.13.0): the one settlement of *ids* (namesakes of the written bare key *k* in okres *oid*) the soldier's
    home municipality (the first of *home*'s values, its first comma piece and each hyphen piece of it) points to,
    else ``None``. A home key equal to *k* is a copy of the birthplace, no evidence. First, those the home **names**
    (a name of the settlement or its 1910 name), **parents** (its 1910 parent), **owns** (its register municipality
    is the home's settlement in the okres) or **shares a modern municipality** with (its modern obec is the home, or
    the modern obec of the home's settlement): exactly one is the pick, several none. Where none, those whose modern
    municipality is the home settlement's or **borders** it (RÚIAN adjacency, :attr:`Gazetteer.obec_neighbours`):
    exactly one is the pick. *Lhota* | Strakonice, home *Horažďovice* → ``horazdovicka-lhota:1`` (modern obec
    Horažďovice); home *Sedlo* → ``strelskohosticka-lhota:1`` (Sedlo and it are both of modern Střelské Hoštice);
    home *Úlehle-Švejcarova Lhota* → ``svejcarova-lhota:1``; home *Lhota* → nothing. A home whose first comma piece
    copies the written name is read at its **second** piece, the municipality the part lies in: *Újezd* | Kladno,
    home *Újezd, Dubí* → ``ujezd-pod-kladnem:1`` (its 1910 parent Dubí). 0.14.0 (K4): the home is also read without
    its qualifier, and its hyphen pieces so: home *Trojanovice pod Radhoštěm* is *Trojanovice* (``trojanovice:1``),
    whose modern municipality borders Kunčice pod Ondřejníkem and not Baška."""
    hm = (tuple(home or ()) + (None,))[0]
    if oid is None or not isinstance(hm, str) or not ids:
        return None
    pieces = hm.split(",")
    hname = clean_birthplace(pieces[0])[0]
    if hname and key(hname) == k and len(pieces) > 1:      # 'Újezd, Dubí': the part, then its municipality
        hname = clean_birthplace(pieces[1])[0]
    if not hname:
        return None
    hkeys = {key(hname)} | {key(x) for x in re.split(r"\s*[-–]\s*", hname) if x.strip()}
    if _on("K4"):                    # 0.14.0 (K4): the home without its qualifier ('Trojanovice pod Radhoštěm')
        hkeys |= {strip_qualifier(h) for h in hkeys}
    hkeys = {h for h in hkeys if h and h != k}
    if not hkeys:
        return None
    hsids = set()
    for h in hkeys:
        v, _t, hs = _lookup_any(h, oid, g)
        if v == "ok":
            hsids.add(hs)
    hforms = {nospace(h) for h in hkeys}
    home_modern = {g.modern_obec.get(s) for s in hsids} - {None, ""}
    strong = set()
    for s in ids:
        own = (g.owner.get(s) or {}).get("muni_sid")
        if (s in hsids or hforms & (_name_forms(s, g) | g.forms_1910.get(s, set()))
                or hforms & _parent_forms(g.parent_key.get(s) or "") or (own is not None and own in hsids)
                or any(_modern_is(s, h, g) for h in hkeys) or g.modern_obec.get(s) in home_modern):
            strong.add(s)
    if strong:
        return next(iter(strong)) if len(strong) == 1 else None
    home_kod = {g.modern_obec_kod.get(s) for s in hsids} - {None}
    near = {s for s in ids if g.modern_obec_kod.get(s) is not None
            and any(g.modern_obec_kod[s] == h or g.modern_obec_kod[s] in g.obec_neighbours.get(h, ()) for h in home_kod)}
    return next(iter(near)) if len(near) == 1 else None


def _register_okresy(k: str, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """The 1910 okresy whose register (either edition) prints a settlement under the key *k*, memoised (0.12.0)."""
    idx = g.__dict__.get("_register_okresy")
    if idx is None:
        idx = {}
        for table in (g.reg, g.reg_alt):
            for (kk, o), sids in table.items():
                if sids and o is not None:
                    idx.setdefault(kk, set()).add(o)
        g.__dict__["_register_okresy"] = idx
    return idx.get(k, set())


def qualified_elsewhere(k: str, oid, g: Gazetteer, val=None) -> bool:
    """I2 (0.12.0): the qualified key *k* exactly as written names a 1910 settlement outside okres *oid* — a lexikon
    name (:attr:`Gazetteer.global_name`; *val*, the stripped head's settlement, left out) or a register name. Then
    the qualifier is the record's evidence of **which** place, and stripping it to a namesake in *oid* is a guess.

    0.13.0 (J2): also the name **abbreviated** (:func:`abbreviated_names`: *ujezd u sv krize* is *Újezd u Svatého
    Kříže*, okres Rokycany)."""
    if oid is None or not k:
        return False
    for kk in [k] + (sorted(abbreviated_names(k, g)) if _on("J2") else []):
        if any(s != val and _okres_any(s, g) not in (None, oid) for s in g.global_name.get(kk, ())):
            return True
        if _register_okresy(kk, g) - {oid}:
            return True
    return False


def _qualified_name_index(g: Gazetteer) -> dict:
    """J2 (0.13.0): every qualified name key (lexikon names, register forms of either edition) by its head and word
    count, memoised: ``{(head, n words): {key}}``."""
    idx = g.__dict__.get("_qualified_name_index")
    if idx is None:
        idx = {}
        keys = set(g.global_name) | {kk for table in (g.reg, g.reg_alt) for (kk, _o) in table}
        for kk in keys:
            head = strip_qualifier(kk)
            if head != kk:
                idx.setdefault((head, len(kk.split())), set()).add(kk)
        g.__dict__["_qualified_name_index"] = idx
    return idx


def abbreviated_names(k: str, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """J2 (0.13.0): the qualified names (:func:`_qualified_name_index`) the qualified key *k* writes abbreviated —
    the same head and number of words, the qualifier's preposition the same, and every other word equal to the
    name's or a shorter beginning of it, at least one shorter: *ujezd u sv krize* → {``ujezd u svateho krize``}
    (the key has lost the abbreviation's dot; the rule ``records_geo.praha_rural_all_czech`` applies to *Král.
    Vinohrady*). A misspelt preposition (*Ronov na Doubravou*) is no abbreviation (J3's)."""
    head = strip_qualifier(k)
    if head == k:
        return set()
    words = k.split()
    n_head = len(head.split())
    out = set()
    for kk in _qualified_name_index(g).get((head, len(words)), ()):
        name = kk.split()
        if kk == k or name[n_head] != words[n_head]:
            continue
        pairs = list(zip(words[n_head + 1:], name[n_head + 1:]))
        if (all(a == b or (len(a) < len(b) and b.startswith(a)) for a, b in pairs)
                and any(a != b for a, b in pairs)):
            out.add(kk)
    return out


def qualifier_abbreviated(k: str, oid, g: Gazetteer):
    """K2 (0.14.0): the one settlement of okres *oid* with a qualified name (lexikon or register, either edition:
    :attr:`Gazetteer.okres_keys`) the qualified key *k* writes abbreviated — the same head and number of words,
    every word after the preposition equal to the name's or a shorter beginning of it — and either some word
    shorter or the prepositions different where *k* writes ``u`` (*near*, which locates by any of them):
    *ujezd u sv krize* | Rokycany → ``ujezd-u-svateho-krize:1``, *tyniste nad orl* | Rychnov →
    ``tyniste-nad-orlici:1``, *lhota u c kostelce* | Náchod → ``lhota-za-cervenym-kostelcem:1``. ``None`` when *k*
    has no qualifier, is itself a name of the okres, or no settlement or several answer.

    0.15.0 (L7): K3's guard — also ``None`` where *k* as written is a settlement anywhere
    (:attr:`Gazetteer.global_name`, :attr:`Gazetteer.global_any`) or its abbreviated reading
    (:func:`abbreviated_names`) names a settlement outside the okres: a name the record wrote exactly, or the
    shortening of another okres's place, is not read into this okres."""
    head = strip_qualifier(k)
    if oid is None or not k or head == k:
        return None
    names = g.okres_keys.get(oid, {})
    if names.get(k):
        return None
    if _on("L7") and (g.global_name.get(k) or g.global_any.get(k)
                      or any(_okres_any(s, g) not in (None, oid) for kk in abbreviated_names(k, g)
                             for s in g.global_any.get(kk, ()))):
        return None
    words = k.split()
    n_head = len(head.split())
    found: set = set()
    for kk, sids in names.items():
        name = kk.split()
        if len(name) != len(words) or name[:n_head] != words[:n_head] or strip_qualifier(kk) != head:
            continue
        same_prep = name[n_head] == words[n_head]
        if not same_prep and words[n_head] != "u":
            continue
        pairs = list(zip(words[n_head + 1:], name[n_head + 1:]))
        if not pairs or not all(a == b or (len(a) < len(b) and b.startswith(a)) for a, b in pairs):
            continue
        if same_prep and all(a == b for a, b in pairs):
            continue
        found |= set(sids)
    found.discard(PRAHA_SID)
    return next(iter(found)) if len(found) == 1 else None


def abbreviated_settlement(k: str, g: Gazetteer):
    """K2 (0.14.0): the one 1910 settlement (:attr:`Gazetteer.global_any`) the qualified key *k* names written
    abbreviated (:func:`abbreviated_names`), else ``None`` — the unresolved-okres path's reading of a name the
    1910 settlements do not hold as written (*brandys nad l* → ``brandys-nad-labem:1``)."""
    ids = {s for kk in abbreviated_names(k, g) for s in g.global_any.get(kk, ())} - {PRAHA_SID}
    return next(iter(ids)) if len(ids) == 1 else None


#: J3 (0.13.0): how far (Levenshtein, on the key) a misspelt qualified name may be from its namesake in the okres
QUALIFIER_FUZZY_DISTANCE = 2
#: K3 (0.14.0): ... or this share of the written qualifier's length (the preposition and its object), if larger
QUALIFIER_FUZZY_SHARE = 0.25


def _levenshtein(a: str, b: str) -> int:
    """Edit distance (insertions, deletions, substitutions) between two strings (J3)."""
    prev = list(range(len(b) + 1))
    for i, ca in enumerate(a, 1):
        cur = [i]
        for j, cb in enumerate(b, 1):
            cur.append(min(prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j - 1] + (ca != cb)))
        prev = cur
    return prev[-1]


def qualifier_fuzzy_bound(k: str, head: str) -> int:
    """K3 (0.14.0): how far a misspelt qualified key *k* (of head *head*) may be from its namesake —
    :data:`QUALIFIER_FUZZY_DISTANCE`, or a quarter (:data:`QUALIFIER_FUZZY_SHARE`) of the written qualifier's length
    (the preposition and its object, spaces included), rounded up, if that is more: *na morave* (9) → 3, *nad
    perstynem* (13) → 4, *pod lipcany* (11) → 3. With K3 off, :data:`QUALIFIER_FUZZY_DISTANCE` (0.13.0)."""
    if not _on("K3"):
        return QUALIFIER_FUZZY_DISTANCE
    qualifier = k[len(head):].strip()
    return max(QUALIFIER_FUZZY_DISTANCE, math.ceil(QUALIFIER_FUZZY_SHARE * len(qualifier)))


def qualifier_fuzzy(k: str, oid, g: Gazetteer):
    """J3 (0.13.0): the one settlement of okres *oid* with a qualified name (lexikon or register,
    :attr:`Gazetteer.okres_keys`) of the same head as the qualified key *k* and within
    :func:`qualifier_fuzzy_bound` of it (0.13.0: :data:`QUALIFIER_FUZZY_DISTANCE`) — a misspelt qualifier (*bystrice nad perstejnem* →
    ``bystrice-nad-pernstejnem:1``, *ronov na doubravou* → ``ronov-nad-doubravou:1``, *frydlant nad ostarvici* →
    ``frydlant-nad-ostravici:1``); ``None`` when *k* has no qualifier, when *k* as written (or abbreviated, J2) names
    a settlement anywhere, or when no settlement or several are that close."""
    head = strip_qualifier(k)
    if oid is None or not k or head == k or g.global_name.get(k) or _register_okresy(k, g):
        return None
    if _on("J2") and abbreviated_names(k, g):
        return None
    close: set = set()
    bound = qualifier_fuzzy_bound(k, head)
    for kk, sids in g.okres_keys.get(oid, {}).items():
        if kk != k and kk != head and strip_qualifier(kk) == head \
                and _levenshtein(k, kk) <= bound:
            close |= set(sids)
    close.discard(PRAHA_SID)
    return next(iter(close)) if len(close) == 1 else None


#: L5 (0.15.0): Czech case endings (unaccented, as :func:`key` writes them) a qualifier's object word may carry, the
#: longest first: *Červeného* / *Červeným*, *Kostelce* / *Kostelcem*, *Macochou* / *Macochy*, *Nákla* / *Náklo*
_CASE_ENDINGS = ("ovi", "ymi", "ami", "emi", "eho", "emu", "ych", "ich", "ach", "ech", "ou", "em", "ym", "im", "om",
                 "a", "e", "i", "o", "u", "y")
#: L5 (0.15.0): the shortest common beginning two object stems must share (besides the brief's "shorter stem less
#: three"), so that short stems (*Brod* / *Brn*, *Hrad* / *Hrab*) do not meet
STEM_MIN_PREFIX = 4


def word_stem(word: str) -> str:
    """L5 (0.15.0): *word* without one Czech case ending (:data:`_CASE_ENDINGS`), keeping at least three letters."""
    for e in _CASE_ENDINGS:
        if word.endswith(e) and len(word) - len(e) >= 3:
            return word[:-len(e)]
    return word


def stem_agrees(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
    """L5 (0.15.0): two object words (keys) name the same thing in different grammatical cases — equal, or their stems
    (:func:`word_stem`) equal, or sharing a beginning at least the shorter stem's length less three and at least
    :data:`STEM_MIN_PREFIX` letters: *cerveneho* / *cervenym*, *kostelce* / *kostelcem*, *macochou* / *macochy*,
    *nakla* / *naklo*; not *brodem* / *brnem*, *c* / *cervenym* (an abbreviation is K2's)."""
    if a == b:
        return True
    sa, sb = word_stem(a), word_stem(b)
    if sa == sb:
        return True
    common = next((i for i, (x, y) in enumerate(zip(sa, sb)) if x != y), min(len(sa), len(sb)))
    return common >= max(STEM_MIN_PREFIX, min(len(sa), len(sb)) - 3)


def _object_words(kk: str, head: str) -> list[str]:
    """The words of qualified key *kk* (of head *head*) after its preposition — the qualifier's object."""
    return kk.split()[len(head.split()) + 1:]


def qualifier_stem(k: str, oid, g: Gazetteer):
    """L5 (0.15.0): the one settlement of okres *oid* with a qualified name (:attr:`Gazetteer.okres_keys`) of the same
    head as the qualified key *k* whose qualifier's object words agree with *k*'s word by word (:func:`stem_agrees`),
    whatever the prepositions: *lhota u cerveneho kostelce* | Náchod → ``lhota-za-cervenym-kostelcem:1``, *ostrov n
    macochou* | Boskovice → ``ostrov-u-macochy:1``. ``None`` as :func:`qualifier_fuzzy` (no qualifier, the name as
    written or abbreviated a settlement anywhere), or when no settlement or several agree."""
    head = strip_qualifier(k)
    if oid is None or not k or head == k or g.global_name.get(k) or _register_okresy(k, g):
        return None
    if _on("J2") and abbreviated_names(k, g):
        return None
    written = _object_words(k, head)
    if not written:
        return None
    found: set = set()
    for kk, sids in g.okres_keys.get(oid, {}).items():
        if kk == k or kk == head or strip_qualifier(kk) != head:
            continue
        obj = _object_words(kk, head)
        if len(obj) == len(written) and all(stem_agrees(a, b) for a, b in zip(written, obj)):
            found |= set(sids)
    found.discard(PRAHA_SID)
    return next(iter(found)) if len(found) == 1 else None


def object_settlement_keys(obj: str, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """L4 (0.15.0): the name keys of okres *oid* (:attr:`Gazetteer.okres_keys`) whose head the locator object *obj*
    writes in another case, word by word (:func:`stem_agrees`): *nakla* → {``naklo``}; *obj* itself if a name."""
    words = obj.split()
    if not words:
        return set()
    out = {obj} if g.okres_keys.get(oid, {}).get(obj) else set()
    for kk in g.okres_keys.get(oid, {}):
        hw = strip_qualifier(kk).split()
        if len(hw) == len(words) and all(stem_agrees(a, b) for a, b in zip(words, hw)):
            out.add(kk)
    return out


def _qualified_names_of(sid, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """L4 (0.15.0): settlement *sid*'s qualified name keys (lexicon names and its owner row's printed keys)."""
    idx = g.__dict__.get("_names_by_sid")
    if idx is None:
        idx = {}
        for kk, sids in g.global_name.items():
            for s in sids:
                idx.setdefault(s, set()).add(kk)
        g.__dict__["_names_by_sid"] = idx
    names = set(idx.get(sid, set())) | set((g.owner.get(sid) or {}).get("printed_keys") or ())
    return {n for n in names if strip_qualifier(n) != n}


def locator_object_verdict(clean: str, alts, oid, g: Gazetteer):
    """L4 (0.15.0): a bare name with a locator alternate (:data:`_LOCATOR_ALT_RE`, one, no comma, dash or slash) that
    :func:`locator_alternates` left unjoined because the joined name is no settlement (exactly or abbreviated) while
    the bare name is a P1 settlement of okres *oid*. The locator's object (*u Nákla* → *Nákla*) names the settlements
    of the okres it writes in another case (:func:`object_settlement_keys`), each read as :func:`home_namesake` reads
    a home over P1's ids and the name's namesakes (:func:`bare_ids`, :func:`bare_namesakes`). One pick other than
    P1's: ``("ok", "p2_qualifier", pick)`` (flagged uncertain) — *Lhota (u Nákla)* | Litovel →
    ``lhota-nad-moravou:1`` (modern municipality Náklo), not P1's ``lhota-u-konice:1``. No single pick, while P1's
    pick has a qualified name and none of them has the written object (:func:`stem_agrees`): ``("ambiguous",
    "p2_bare_namesakes", ids)``. Else ``None`` (P1 stands)."""
    k = key(clean) if clean else ""
    if not alts or not k or oid is None or strip_qualifier(k) != k:
        return None
    loc = next((a for a in alts if _LOCATOR_ALT_RE.match(key(a)) and not re.search(r"[,;/–-]", a)), None)
    if loc is None:
        return None
    v1, _t, s1 = _lookup(k, oid, g)
    if v1 != "ok":
        return None
    joined = key(f"{clean} {loc}")
    vj, _t, _sj = _lookup(joined, oid, g)
    if vj != "none" or (_on("K2") and qualifier_abbreviated(joined, oid, g) is not None):
        return None
    obj = " ".join(key(loc).split()[1:])
    ids = bare_ids(k, oid, g) | bare_namesakes(k, oid, g) | {s1}
    picks = {home_namesake((h,), k, ids, oid, g) for h in {obj} | object_settlement_keys(obj, oid, g)} - {None}
    if len(picks) == 1:
        pick = next(iter(picks))
        return None if pick == s1 else ("ok", "p2_qualifier", pick)
    own = _qualified_names_of(s1, g)
    if own and not any(len(_object_words(n, strip_qualifier(n))) == len(obj.split())
                       and all(stem_agrees(a, b) for a, b in zip(obj.split(), _object_words(n, strip_qualifier(n))))
                       for n in own):
        return "ambiguous", "p2_bare_namesakes", tuple(sorted(ids)[:12])
    return None


def home_muni_in_okres(home, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """I2 (0.12.0): the soldier's home municipality (the first of *home*'s values, its first comma piece) names a
    settlement of okres *oid* as written (P1, the de-bohemia forms, the space-free and alias tables; no qualifier
    strip): the soldier lived in the okres the birthplace string names, so its stripped head stands."""
    hm = (tuple(home or ()) + (None,))[0]
    if oid is None or not isinstance(hm, str):
        return False
    hname = clean_birthplace(hm.split(",")[0])[0]
    return bool(hname) and _lookup_any(key(hname), oid, g)[0] != "none"


def bare_ids(bare: str, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """Every settlement of okres *oid* answering to the key *bare* in the register (both editions)
    or the lexikon (0.5.0, D4a)."""
    out: set = set()
    for table in (g.reg, g.reg_alt, g.lex):
        out |= set(table.get((bare, oid)) or ())
    return out


def _okres_holds_head(bare: str, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """The okres holds a settlement whose name, without its qualifier, is *bare*."""
    return oid is not None and bool(g.qualifier.get((bare, oid)) or g.lex.get((bare, oid))
                                    or g.reg.get((bare, oid)) or g.reg_alt.get((bare, oid)))


# ── P4: the okres timeline ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def p4_timeline(k: str, stated: str, oid, g: Gazetteer, exact_only: bool = False) -> tuple[str, str, object]:
    """Exactly one settlement of the name, elsewhere, whose ``okres_all`` holds the stated okres.

    Also for a record with no 1910 okres at all (``Kunratice u Prahy``, okres ``Praha venkov``, a
    1928 unit): the stated okres in the timeline is the gate that keeps a foreign homonym out. The
    name is tried as written, then — only when no settlement anywhere carries the qualified name —
    without its ``u/nad/pod`` qualifier (``Kamýk nad Vltavou`` exists, so it never becomes *Kamýk*)
    — and, since 0.3.0, never when the record's own okres holds a settlement of that bare head
    (``qualifier_conflict``: *Lhota pod Lipčany*, okres Hradec Králové, holds *Lhota pod Libčany*;
    the record is not ``lhota:6`` of okres Dvůr Králové). *exact_only* skips the strip.
    """
    stated = nospace(stated or "")              # timeline tokens are space-free (0.2.0)
    if not stated:
        return "none", "", None
    forms = [k] if (g.global_name.get(k) or exact_only) else list(dict.fromkeys([k, strip_qualifier(k)]))
    for kk in forms:
        if kk != k and _okres_holds_head(kk, oid, g):
            # 0.4.0: a qualified form of the head in the okres, or the bare head itself
            why = "qualifier_conflict" if g.qualifier.get((kk, oid)) else "head_in_okres"
            return "refused", "p4_okres_timeline", why
        ids = {s for s in g.global_name.get(kk, set())
               if stated in g.timeline.get(s, set()) and g.okres_of.get(s) not in (None, oid)}
        if len(ids) == 1:
            inside = names_inside(k, oid, g)
            if inside:                          # 0.4.0: the okres holds the name in a longer one
                return "ambiguous", "p4_in_okres", tuple(sorted(inside))
            return "ok", "p4_okres_timeline", next(iter(ids))
        if ids:
