    named = {x for x in lands if x != "foreign"}
    if not named or land not in (301, 302, 303):
        return False
    return not any(x == land or {x, land} <= {302, 303} for x in named)


def d2_decide(k: str, g: Gazetteer) -> tuple[str, object]:
    """D-144 across all okresy for an inferred okres (0.6.0, T2): ``("ok", sid)`` or
    ``("ambiguous", ids)``. One settlement of the name (``global_any``) and no unanchored register
    municipality printing it → that one. Else exactly one namesake may be an obec (a register
    municipality row, a lexikon obec, or — for refusing only — a namesake of unknown 1910 status),
    and it wins only when it **is** an obec (register municipality or lexikon obec: legion *Dolní
    Lhotka*, whose one possible obec has no 1910 status, is refused) and no unanchored municipality
    row printing the name lies elsewhere (*Chudeřice*, *Milíčov*: the register prints a second 1910
    municipality it did not anchor; a row in the winner's own okres, where the winner has no anchored
    municipality row, is taken to be the winner's)."""
    ids = set(g.global_any.get(k, ()))         # every namesake, as 0.5.0 (Prague's Nové Město included)
    ph = set(g.unanchored_munis.get(k, ()))
    if len(ids) == 1 and not ph:
        return "ok", next(iter(ids))
    maybe = [s for s in ids if s in g.reg_municipal or g.status.get(s, "") in ("obec", "")]
    if len(maybe) != 1:
        return "ambiguous", tuple(sorted(ids))
    one = maybe[0]
    known = one in g.reg_municipal or g.status.get(one) == "obec"
    others = {o for o in ph if not (o == _okres_any(one, g) and one not in g.reg_municipal)}
    if not known or others:
        return "ambiguous", tuple(sorted(ids))
    return "ok", one


def foreign_token(text, exclude=()) -> str | None:
    """The first word or piece of *text* naming a land, country or district outside the Czech lands
    (:data:`FOREIGN_WORDS`, :data:`FOREIGN_DISTRICTS`), else ``None`` (0.6.0, T1/T2). The text is cut
    at ``, ; ( ) /``; the first piece (the place name as written) and every piece whose key is one of
    *exclude* (the record's own name: the Pardubice village *Uhersko*) are skipped."""
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
        return None
    skip = {key(e) for e in exclude if isinstance(e, str)}
    pieces = [key(x) for x in re.split(r"[,;()/]+", text)]
    for k in pieces[1:]:
        if not k or k in skip:
            continue
        if k in FOREIGN_DISTRICTS:
            return k
        hit = next((w for w in k.split() if w in FOREIGN_WORDS), None)
        if hit:
            return hit
    return None


def okres_names_in(text) -> list[str]:
    """Every okres a text names after an okres word, misspellings included (``okes Náchod``,
    ``okrr. most``, ``okres, Horšovský Týn``), in order (0.6.0)."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []
    t = _OKRES_WORD_RE.sub("okres ", text)
    return [m.strip(" -–.") for m in _OKRES_NAME_RE.findall(t) if m.strip(" -–.")]


def _bare_qualifiers(text) -> list[str]:
    """The comma pieces after the name, outside parentheses, with no okres word: ``Libouň, Benešov``
    → ``Benešov`` (0.6.0)."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []
    top = re.sub(r"\([^()]*\)", " ", text)
    out = []
    for piece in re.split(r"[,;]", top)[1:]:
        piece = re.sub(r"[?+]|\s[-–]\s*$", " ", piece).strip(" -–.")
        if piece and not _OKRES_WORD_RE.search(piece) and not _TITLE_PIECE_RE.match(key(piece)):
            out.append(piece)
    return out


def _okres_fits(name: str, sid, g: Gazetteer, exact_only: bool = False) -> str | None:
    """``None`` when okres *name* is the settlement's: its 1910 okres (the lexikon's or its register
    row's, a court of it included), or a token of its ``okres_all`` timeline; ``"foreign"`` for an
    okres outside the Czech lands; ``"conflict"`` for another okres; ``"unknown"`` for a name no
    okres answers to — no evidence either way (0.7.0, F6: an unresolvable okres string such as
    *Brmo* or *Preha venkov* no longer refuses the link; with F6 off and not *exact_only*, 0.6.0's
    ``"conflict"``)."""
    tok = okres_token(name)
    timeline = g.timeline.get(sid, set())
    if not tok or tok in timeline:
        return None
    home = {_okres_any(sid, g), g.okres_of.get(sid)} - {None}
    kind, ids = resolve_okres(name, None, None, g, fuzzy=not exact_only, timeline=not exact_only)
    if kind == "foreign":
        return "foreign"
    if kind in ("czech", "later"):
        if ids & home:
            return None
        # the Prague agglomeration: "Nebušice, Praha" is P3's (a ring settlement or a Praha* timeline)
        if ids & PRAGUE_AGGLOMERATION and (home & PRAGUE_AGGLOMERATION or any(t.startswith("praha") for t in timeline)):
            return None
        return "conflict"
    if kind == "timeline":
        if ids in timeline:
            return None
        # 0.9.0 (E9): Praha-venkov is no longer the city okres; it fits a settlement of the agglomeration or
        # one whose timeline names a Prague okres, as the city okres did in 0.8.0
        if _on("E9") and str(ids).startswith("praha") and (home & PRAGUE_AGGLOMERATION
                                                         or any(t.startswith("praha") for t in timeline)):
            return None
        return "conflict"
    return "unknown" if (exact_only or _on("F6")) else "conflict"


def raw_okres_refusal(raw, clean, sid, g: Gazetteer) -> str | None:
    """The refusal of :func:`raw_okres_verdict` (its first element)."""
    return raw_okres_verdict(raw, clean, sid, g)[0]


def raw_okres_verdict(raw, clean, sid, g: Gazetteer) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, tuple]:
    """T2 (0.6.0) on the record's own text for an okres inferred from the name, as ``(refusal,
    detail, written okres ids)``: ``okres_from_name_foreign`` when it names a land, country or
    district outside the Czech lands (*Jaroslav, Halič*; *Ludwigsthal, Regen, Bavorsko*; *Steinbach,
    Gmünd*) or an okres of the Hungarian frame (*Súlovice, orkes Topoľčany*); ``okres_from_name_conflict``
    when an okres word (``okres``, ``okr``, ``okes``, ``ores``, ``okrr`` …) names an okres that is not
    the settlement's 1910 okres nor in its timeline, or a bare comma piece resolves **exactly** to a
    Czech-lands okres or court that is not the settlement's (*X, Kolín*).

    0.7.0: F4 a land word against the settlement's land (:func:`lands_named`, :func:`land_conflict`:
    ``okres_from_name_land_conflict``; Upper / Prussian Silesia foreign); F6 an okres string that
    resolves to nothing is no evidence; A3 a conflict on a key that answers to exactly one Czech-lands
    settlement (and no unanchored register municipality elsewhere) is ``okres_from_name_conflict_unique``;
    F5 when the cell gives okres **alternatives** in parentheses (:func:`paren_okres_alternatives`),
    every okres it names is an alternative: one that does not fit the settlement and holds another
    namesake of the key (:func:`holds_namesake`) → ``okres_from_name_ambiguous``; else the link stands
    when one alternative fits it, and is a conflict when none does."""
    if foreign_token(raw, exclude=(clean,)):
        return "okres_from_name_foreign", "foreign_word", ()
    if _on("F4"):
        lands = lands_named(raw)
        if "foreign" in lands:
            return "okres_from_name_foreign", "land_foreign", ()
        if land_conflict(lands, _land_of(sid, g)):
            return "okres_from_name_land_conflict", "land_word", ()
    k = key(clean) if clean else ""
    alts = paren_okres_alternatives(raw, g) if _on("F5") else []
    named = [(n, False) for n in okres_names_in(raw)] + [(n, True) for n in _bare_qualifiers(raw)]
    fits, conflicts = [], []
    for name, exact in named:
        fit = _okres_fits(name, sid, g, exact_only=exact)
        if fit == "foreign":
            return "okres_from_name_foreign", "okres_foreign", ()
        if fit == "conflict":
            if not alts:
                return _written_conflict(k, sid, g, name, exact)
            conflicts.append((name, exact))
        elif fit is None and okres_token(name):
            fits.append(name)
    if not alts:
        return None, None, ()
    for name, exact in [*conflicts, *((a, False) for a in alts)]:
        if _okres_fits(name, sid, g, exact_only=exact) == "conflict" and holds_namesake(name, k, sid, g):
            return "okres_from_name_ambiguous", "okres_alternative", tuple(sorted(_written_ids(name, g, exact)))
    fits += [a for a in alts if _okres_fits(a, sid, g) is None]
    if conflicts and not fits:
        return _written_conflict(k, sid, g, *conflicts[0])
    return None, None, ()


def _written_ids(name, g: Gazetteer, exact: bool = False) -> set:
    kind, ids = resolve_okres(name, None, None, g, fuzzy=not exact, timeline=not exact)
    return set(ids) if kind in ("czech", "later") else set()


def unique_czech(k: str, sid, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """A3 (0.7.0): the key answers to exactly one Czech-lands 1910 settlement, *sid*, and no unanchored
    register municipality prints it in another okres. 0.8.0 (D-e): the Czech-lands settlements are
    counted as F1 counts them (:func:`_czech_1910`: the unplaced rows too — *Libavá*, whose two Moravian
    namesakes have no 1910 okres)."""
    pick = _czech_1910 if _on("De") else _czech
    return (bool(k) and pick(g.global_any.get(k, ()), g) == {sid}
            and not set(g.unanchored_munis.get(k, ())) - {_okres_any(sid, g)})


def written_holds_near(k: str, sid, okresy, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """D-e (0.8.0): one of the written *okresy* holds a settlement whose name is within
    :data:`UNIQUE_NEAR_RATIO` (space-free) of the key *k* or of a name of the link *sid* (*Bernatice,
    okr. Frývaldov*: Bernartice; *Dobrová, okr. Fryštát*: Doubrava, the link's own name)."""
    mine = {nospace(k)} | {f for f in g.forms_of.get(sid, set()) | g.pool_forms.get(sid, set()) if f}
    sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher()
    for o in okresy or ():
        for name in g.okres_keys.get(o, {}):
            sm.set_seq2(nospace(name))
            for m in mine:
                sm.set_seq1(m)
                if sm.real_quick_ratio() >= UNIQUE_NEAR_RATIO and sm.ratio() >= UNIQUE_NEAR_RATIO:
                    return True
    return False


def _written_conflict(k: str, sid, g: Gazetteer, name, exact: bool) -> tuple[str, str, tuple]:
    """``okres_from_name_conflict`` (or, A3, ``_conflict_unique``) on the okres string *name*; 0.8.0
    (D-e): never ``_unique`` when the written okres holds a near spelling (:func:`written_holds_near`)."""
    written = _written_ids(name, g, exact)
    unique = _on("A3") and unique_czech(k, sid, g)
    if unique and _on("De") and written_holds_near(k, sid, written, g):
        return "okres_from_name_conflict", "bare_okres_near" if exact else "okres_word_near", tuple(sorted(written))
    why = "okres_from_name_conflict_unique" if unique else "okres_from_name_conflict"
    return why, "bare_okres" if exact else "okres_word", tuple(sorted(written))


def paren_okres_alternatives(raw, g: Gazetteer) -> list[str]:
    """F5 (0.7.0): the okres names inside a top-level parenthesis that follows an okres word —
    VÚA's alternatives (*Domoradice, okr. Vysoké Mýto? (Český Krumlov?)* → ``Český Krumlov``;
    *Javornice, okr. Lomnice nad Popelkou? (Rychnov nad Kněžnou?, Vodňany?)*) — each piece with its
    okres word, ``?`` and ``+`` dropped, kept when it names a Czech-lands okres, court or later okres
    (a German exonym in parentheses, *Zetschin*, is no alternative)."""
    if not isinstance(raw, str):
        return []
    m = _OKRES_WORD_RE.search(raw)
    if not m:
        return []
    out = []
    for grp in re.finditer(r"\(([^()]*)\)", raw):
        if grp.start() < m.start():
            continue
        for piece in re.split(r"[,;]", grp.group(1)):
            p = re.sub(r"[?+]", " ", _OKRES_WORD_RE.sub(" ", piece)).strip(" -–.")
            p = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", p)
            if p and resolve_okres(p, None, None, g)[0] in ("czech", "later", "timeline"):
                out.append(p)
    return list(dict.fromkeys(out))


def holds_namesake(name, k: str, sid, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """F5 (0.7.0): okres string *name* holds a Czech-lands settlement of the key *k* other than *sid*
    — in its 1910 okres, or with the okres in its ``okres_all`` timeline (*Český Krumlov* holds
    ``domoradice:1``; *Strakonice* ``krty:2``)."""
    kind, ids = resolve_okres(name, None, None, g)
    if kind not in ("czech", "later", "timeline") or not k:
        return False
    tok = okres_token(name)
    for s in _czech_1910(set(g.global_any.get(k, ())) - {sid}, g):
        tl = g.timeline.get(s, set())
        if (kind in ("czech", "later") and _okres_any(s, g) in ids) or tok in tl or (kind == "timeline" and ids in tl):
            return True
    return False


def home_conflict(k: str, sid, home, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """T2 (0.6.0): the soldier's home place holds **another** settlement of the name *k*: a namesake
    other than *sid* lies in the home okres (``home_okres_id``, or the okres of the home municipality
    where D-144 across okresy settles it) or is a part of the home municipality (its 1910 parent) —
    legion 105562 *Bukovka* (home *Starý Bozděchov*, the parent of ``bukovka:1``), 130497 *Střížkov*
    (home okres Benešov holds ``strizkov:1``), 130334 *Hodkov* (home okres Sedlčany). A home okres
    that holds only the linked settlement is no conflict, nor is the linked settlement's own okres:
    there the home **corroborates** the inferred okres, and the choice inside it stays D-144's or the
    seat rule's (*Podbořany*, home Podbořany: ``podborany:1``, not ``podboranky:1`` of the same okres)."""
    hm, ho = (tuple(home) + (None, None))[:2]
    okresy = {int(ho)} if ho is not None else set()
    hclean = clean_birthplace(hm)[0] if isinstance(hm, str) else None
    hk = key(hclean) if hclean else ""
    if hk and hk != k:
        v, s = decide(_czech(g.global_any.get(hk, ()), g), _reg_status(g))
        if v == "ok" and _okres_any(s, g) is not None:
            okresy.add(_okres_any(s, g))
    okresy.discard(_okres_any(sid, g))
    part_of_home = bool(hk) and hk != k and g.parent_key.get(sid) == hk
    for s in set(g.global_any.get(k, ())) - {sid}:
        if _okres_any(s, g) in okresy or (hk and hk != k and not part_of_home and g.parent_key.get(s) == hk):
            return True
    return False


def _obec_or_unknown(g: Gazetteer):
    """D2's status (0.5.0): ``obec`` for a register municipality row, a lexikon obec, and a settlement
    whose 1910 status is not given (1,957 lexikon rows lack the 1910 clause — towns among them, *Velké
    Hamry*), which may be an obec or a town; else its status. Since 0.6.0 :func:`d2_decide` decides
    (unknown status refuses, never wins); kept for callers of 0.5.0."""
    return lambda s: "obec" if (s in g.reg_municipal or not g.status.get(s) or g.status.get(s) == "obec") \
        else g.status.get(s)


def okres_inferred_ok(clean, oid, g: Gazetteer, sid=None) -> bool:
    """:func:`okres_inferred_refusal` is ``None`` (kept for callers of 0.4.x; *sid* defaults to the
    one settlement D-144 across okresy gives, :func:`d2_decide` since 0.6.0)."""
    if sid is None:
        _v, sid = d2_decide(key(clean) if clean else "", g)
    return okres_inferred_refusal(clean, sid, oid, g) is None


_RURAL_WORD_RE = re.compile(r"\s+(?:venkov|vonkov|okoli|land|umgebung)$")


def candidate_okresy(okres, stated, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """The okres ids one VÚA candidate reading's okres string may name (:func:`resolve_okres`: a
    backbone or later okres; ``set()`` for a timeline-only, foreign or unresolved string)."""
    kind, ids = resolve_okres(okres, stated, oid, g)
    return set(ids) if kind in ("czech", "later") else set()


def candidate_okres(okres, text=None, g: Gazetteer | None = None) -> str | None:
    """The okres a candidate reading names (0.6.0, T1): the **last** ``okres X`` of its own *text*
    after the okres word's typos are normalised (``okrese``/``okrs``/``okes``/``ores``/``okrr`` …:
    *Rokytnice nad Jizerou-Horní Rokytnice, okrese Jilemnice*; *Bedřichovice, okres
    Čestín-Bedřichovice, okres Sedlčany*), else the parsed *okres*, else (with *g*) the first bare
    comma piece that is exactly a Czech-lands okres or court name (*Loket, Ledeč nad Sázavou*;
    *Nučice, Český Brod*); ``na Nisou`` → ``nad Nisou`` and a ``/…/`` tail dropped (*Planá
    /Karolinenhof/*)."""
    names = okres_names_in(re.sub(r"/[^/]*/", " ", text)) if isinstance(text, str) else []
    out = names[-1] if names else okres
    if not isinstance(out, str) and g is not None and isinstance(text, str):
        out = next((q for q in _bare_qualifiers(text)
                    if resolve_okres(q, None, None, g, fuzzy=False, timeline=False)[0] == "czech"), None)
    if not isinstance(out, str):
        return None
    out = re.sub(r"/[^/]*/", " ", out)
    out = re.sub(r"(?<![^\W\d_])na(\s+Nisou)(?![^\W\d_])", r"nad\1", out, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    out = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", out).strip(" -–.?+")
    return out or None


def _timeline_token(k: str, g: Gazetteer) -> str | None:
    """The ``okres_all`` token an okres string names: as written (space-free), else the one token it
    starts (*Kralupy* → ``kralupynadvltavou``); ``None`` when there is none or several."""
    tok = nospace(k)
    if not tok:
        return None
    if tok in g.timeline_tokens:
        return tok
    longer = [t for t in g.timeline_tokens if t.startswith(tok)]
    return longer[0] if len(longer) == 1 else None


def timeline_seat_okresy(tok, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """E9 (0.9.0): the 1910 okresy at the core of a later okres — for one of :data:`LATER_OKRES_1910` the
    okresy it names (the town's: Slaný for *Kralupy*; Frýdek and Místek for *Frýdek-Místek*), for the
    capital's countryside the four ring okresy of 1910 (Karlín, Královské Vinohrady, Smíchov, Žižkov),
    which *Praha-venkov* was formed from."""
    if str(tok).startswith("praha"):
        return set(PRAGUE_AGGLOMERATION) - {PRAHA_OKRES_ID}
    return {o for k, t in g.later_token.items() if t == tok for o in g.later_okres.get(k, ())}


def timeline_okresy(tok, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """E9 (0.9.0): the 1910 okresy of the settlements whose ``okres_all`` timeline holds the token *tok*
    (*kralupynadvltavou*: Slaný, Smíchov, Mělník); memoised on the gazetteer."""
    cache = g.__dict__.setdefault("_timeline_okresy_cache", {})
    if tok not in cache:
        cache[tok] = {o for s, tl in g.timeline.items() if tok in tl for o in [_okres_any(s, g)] if o is not None}
    return cache[tok]


def resolve_okres(okres, stated, oid, g: Gazetteer, fuzzy: bool = True,
                  timeline: bool = True) -> tuple[str, object]:
    """What an okres string names (0.6.0, T1): ``("czech", ids)`` — the record's own okres string, or
    a backbone okres or court name (a city/rural twin gives both members) as written or without
    ``venkov``/``okolí``; ``("later", ids)`` — a post-1910 okres of :data:`LATER_OKRES_1910`;
    ``("timeline", token)`` — any other later okres the lexikon timeline carries; ``("czech", ids)``
    — the first hyphen piece (*Teplice-Šanov*); ``("foreign", set())`` — a Slovak, Hungarian,
    Subcarpathian or Hlučín name (:attr:`Gazetteer.foreign_okres`); ``("czech", ids)`` — a close
    match (difflib >= :data:`OKRES_FUZZY_CUTOFF`) to backbone names of one okres (*Nové Město na
    Morava*); else ``("none", set())``.

    0.7.0 (F6): a form of :data:`OKRES_NAME_ALIASES` resolves (*Zábřeh na Moravě*, *Rokytnice*), a
    Lower Austrian district (:data:`FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_LOWER_AUSTRIA`) is foreign, and the close match
    is :func:`close_okres` (the best okres when it clearly beats the runner-up; no key of 4 letters or
    fewer).

    0.9.0: E7 — a Prussian-Silesian town (:data:`FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_PRUSSIA`: *Ratibor*), a name of the
    Hungarian frame written as such (*Holíč*) and *Uherská X* where *X* close-spells a foreign name
    (*Uherská Skalice* = Skalica) are foreign before any later-okres timeline prefix or close Czech spelling
    (*Holíč* is not Holice, *Uherská Skalice* not Česká Skalice); E9 — a later okres of
    :data:`LATER_OKRES_1910` whose settlements the lexikon timeline puts in several 1910 okresy (*Kralupy*:
    Slaný, Smíchov, Mělník) and the capital's countryside (*Praha-venkov*, *Praha-západ*) are
    ``("timeline", token)``, never one okres and never the city okres Praha. :func:`okres_resolution` also
    says how the string resolved (E10)."""
    return okres_resolution(okres, stated, oid, g, fuzzy=fuzzy, timeline=timeline)[:2]


def okres_resolution(okres, stated, oid, g: Gazetteer, fuzzy: bool = True,
                     timeline: bool = True) -> tuple[str, object, str | None]:
    """:func:`resolve_okres` with how the string resolved (0.9.0, E10): ``stated`` (the record's own
    okres), ``exact`` (a backbone okres or court name, ``venkov``/``okolí`` dropped), ``later``, ``alias``,
    ``hyphen`` (the first hyphen piece), ``fuzzy`` (:func:`close_okres` or 0.6.0's close match), or the
    kind itself for ``foreign`` / ``timeline`` / ``none``."""
    if not isinstance(okres, str) or not key(okres):
        return "none", set(), "none"
    if stated is not None and oid is not None and okres_token(okres) == okres_token(stated):
        return "czech", {oid}, "stated"
    k = key(okres)
    rural = _RURAL_WORD_RE.sub("", k).strip()
    if _on("E9") and _PRAHA_RURAL_RE.match(k):               # Praha-venkov is no city okres
        tok = _timeline_token(k, g) if timeline else None
        return ("timeline", tok, "timeline") if tok else ("none", set(), "none")
    for kk in dict.fromkeys([k, rural]):
        ids = g.okres_by_name.get(kk) or g.okres_by_name.get(nospace(kk))
        if ids:
            return "czech", set(ids), "exact"
        if g.later_okres.get(kk):
            tok = g.later_token.get(kk) if _on("E9") else None
            if tok and timeline:                             # E9: a later okres over several 1910 okresy
                return "timeline", tok, "timeline"
            return "later", set(g.later_okres[kk]), "later"
        if _on("F6") and g.okres_alias.get(kk):
            return "czech", set(g.okres_alias[kk]), "alias"
    if k in _FOREIGN_OKRES_KEYS or rural in _FOREIGN_OKRES_KEYS:   # Hlučín before its later timeline
        return "foreign", set(), "foreign"
    if _on("F6") and (k in FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_LOWER_AUSTRIA or rural in FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_LOWER_AUSTRIA):
        return "foreign", set(), "foreign"
    if _on("E7") and _foreign_by_name(k, rural, g, okres):
        return "foreign", set(), "foreign"
    if timeline:
        tok = _timeline_token(rural, g)
        if tok:
            return "timeline", tok, "timeline"
    first = key(re.split(r"\s*[-–]\s*", str(okres))[0])
    ids = g.okres_by_name.get(first) or g.okres_by_name.get(nospace(first))
    if ids:
        return "czech", set(ids), "hyphen"
    if k in g.foreign_okres or rural in g.foreign_okres:
        return "foreign", set(), "foreign"
    if fuzzy and rural and _on("F6"):
        kind, ids = close_okres(rural, g)
        return kind, ids, ("fuzzy" if kind == "czech" else kind)
    if fuzzy and rural:
        close = difflib.get_close_matches(rural, [n for n in g.okres_by_name if " " in n or len(n) > 3],
                                          n=5, cutoff=OKRES_FUZZY_CUTOFF)
        ids = {o for n in close for o in g.okres_by_name[n]}
        if close and len({frozenset(g.okres_by_name[n]) for n in close}) == 1:
            return "czech", ids, "fuzzy"
    return "none", set(), "none"


def _foreign_by_name(k: str, rural: str, g: Gazetteer, okres=None) -> bool:
    """E7 (0.9.0): the okres string is a Prussian-Silesian town (:data:`FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_PRUSSIA`), a name
    of the Hungarian frame as written (:attr:`Gazetteer.foreign_okres`: *Holíč*, *Skalica*) that is not
    itself an okres_all token, or *Uherská X* with *X* within :data:`UHERSKY_REST_RATIO` of a foreign
    name (*Uherská Skalice*; :func:`uhersky_rest`)."""
    if k in FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_PRUSSIA or rural in FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_PRUSSIA:
        return True
    if (k in g.foreign_okres or rural in g.foreign_okres) and nospace(rural) not in g.timeline_tokens:
        return True
    rest = uhersky_rest(k, g, okres)
    if rest:
        near = _closest_foreign(rest, g)
        return bool(near and near[0] >= UHERSKY_REST_RATIO)
    return False


#: G5 (0.10.0): *Uherská X* written out (the abbreviation *Uh.* is the Moravian forms, never Hungary)
_UHERSKY_FULL_RE = re.compile(r"^uhersk[aeyi]\s+(\S.*)$")


def uhersky_rest(k: str, g: Gazetteer, okres=None) -> str | None:
    """The *X* of an okres string *Uherská X* that may name Hungary (E7), else ``None``.

    0.9.0 tested the whole key, *Uh.* included, against the Moravian *Uhersk…* okres names. 0.10.0 (G5): only the
    **first** comma piece of the string (*okres*), only written out — *Uh.* abbreviates the Moravian forms
    (*Uh. Brod* is Uherský Brod) — and only when that piece's first two words are not within
    :data:`UHERSKY_REST_RATIO` of a Moravian *Uhersk…* okres name (*Uherský Brod, Bratislava*, *Uherský Brod Nové
    Mesto nad Váhom* are Uherský Brod; *Uherské Headiště* a typo of Uherské Hradiště)."""
    moravian = [n for n in g.okres_by_name if n.startswith("uhersk")]
    if not _on("G5"):
        m = _UHERSKY_RE.match(k)
        if m and not any(difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, k, n).ratio() >= UHERSKY_REST_RATIO for n in moravian):
            return m.group(1)
        return None
    first = key(re.split(r"[,;]", okres)[0]) if isinstance(okres, str) else k
    m = _UHERSKY_FULL_RE.match(first)
    if not m:
        return None
    lead = " ".join(first.split()[:2])
    if any(difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, x, n).ratio() >= UHERSKY_REST_RATIO for x in (lead, first) for n in moravian):
        return None
    return m.group(1)


def close_okres(k: str, g: Gazetteer) -> tuple[str, set]:
    """F6 (0.7.0): ``("czech", ids)`` of the okres whose backbone name is closest to *k* (difflib
    ratio >= :data:`OKRES_FUZZY_CUTOFF`) when it beats the next okres's best by
    :data:`OKRES_FUZZY_MARGIN` (*Valšské Meziříčí*: Valašské Meziříčí 0.97 against Velké Meziříčí
    0.87), else ``("none", set())``. Neither *k* nor the name it reaches may be shorter than
    :data:`OKRES_FUZZY_MIN_LEN` letters (*Plzań* must not become *Plan*, Planá; *Brmo* stays
    unresolved).

    0.8.0 (D-b): the foreign district names are scored too (:attr:`Gazetteer.foreign_okres` and
    :data:`FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_LOWER_AUSTRIA`, each also without its qualifier: *Turňa nad Bodvou* →
    *turna*); when the best foreign ratio is at least the best Czech one the string is ``("foreign",
    set())`` (*Turňa* is not Turnau, *Senice* not Jesenice, *Sečany* not Sedlčany)."""
    if len(nospace(k)) < OKRES_FUZZY_MIN_LEN:
        return "none", set()
    best: dict[frozenset, float] = {}
    sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher()
    sm.set_seq2(k)
    for n, ids in g.okres_by_name.items():
        if len(nospace(n)) < OKRES_FUZZY_MIN_LEN:
            continue
        sm.set_seq1(n)
        if (sm.real_quick_ratio() >= OKRES_FUZZY_CUTOFF and sm.quick_ratio() >= OKRES_FUZZY_CUTOFF
                and sm.ratio() >= OKRES_FUZZY_CUTOFF):
            fs = frozenset(ids)
            best[fs] = max(best.get(fs, 0.0), sm.ratio())
    if not best:
        return "none", set()
    ranked = sorted(best.values(), reverse=True)
    top = max(best, key=best.get)
    if _on("Db"):
        near = _closest_foreign(k, g)
        if near and near[0] >= ranked[0]:
            return "foreign", set()
    if len(ranked) == 1 or ranked[0] - ranked[1] >= OKRES_FUZZY_MARGIN:
        return "czech", set(top)
    return "none", set()


def _closest_foreign(k: str, g: Gazetteer) -> tuple[float, str] | None:
    """D-b (0.8.0): ``(ratio, name)`` of the foreign district name (as written or without its
    qualifier) closest to *k* among those within the quick-ratio bound of :data:`OKRES_LOOSE_CUTOFF`,
    else ``None``; memoised on the gazetteer."""
    cache = g.__dict__.setdefault("_closest_foreign_cache", {})
    ck = (k, _on("E7"))                              # the cache follows the E7 switch (measurement)
    if ck in cache:
        return cache[ck]
    sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher()
    sm.set_seq2(k)
    best = None
    names = g.foreign_okres | FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_LOWER_AUSTRIA
    if _on("E7"):                                    # 0.9.0: the Prussian-Silesian towns too
        names = names | FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_PRUSSIA
    for n in names:
        for form in {n, strip_qualifier(n)}:
            sm.set_seq1(form)
            if sm.real_quick_ratio() < OKRES_LOOSE_CUTOFF or sm.quick_ratio() < OKRES_LOOSE_CUTOFF:
                continue
            r = sm.ratio()
            if best is None or r > best[0] or (r == best[0] and n < best[1]):
                best = (r, n)
    cache[ck] = best
    return best


def twin_member(okresy: set, muni, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """The okres ids a candidate reading means when its okres string names a statutory city **and**
    its rural okres (*Opava* → 303011 city, 303010 rural): the city when the municipality is the
    city itself, else the rural member — records_geo's twin rule (D-17), 0.5.0. Without it the city
    okres answers any name with the city (:func:`match_birthplace`'s statutory short-cut), so
    *Tábor, okres Opava* gave {opava:1, tabor:1} and counted as giving nothing."""
    city = {o for o in okresy if o in g.statutory and o != PRAHA_OKRES_ID}
    if not city or len(okresy) < 2:
        return set(okresy)
    k = key(muni) if muni else ""
    own = {o for o in city if k in g.okres_names.get(o, set())}
    return own or set(okresy) - city


def _matches(results) -> tuple[str, object] | None:
    """``("ok", sid)`` / ``("ambiguous", ids)`` from several :func:`match_birthplace` results, else
    ``None``."""
    sids = {r["sid"] for r in results} - {None}
    amb = {c for r in results if r["sid"] is None and str(r["refusal"] or "").startswith("ambiguous")
           for c in (r["candidates"] or ())}
    if len(sids) == 1 and not amb:
        return "ok", next(iter(sids))
    if sids or amb:
        return "ambiguous", tuple(sorted(sids | amb))
    return None


def global_names(muni, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """Every Czech-lands 1910 settlement the name answers to across all okresy (``global_any``): the
    name as written (a qualifier kept: *Lhota u Police nad Metují*), the right piece of a compound
    (*Vráto Brod-Hlinsko* → *Hlinsko*) and :data:`LATER_TOWN_1910` (*Český Těšín* → ``tesin:2``)
    (0.6.0, T1's global-name fallback). 0.7.0 (F1): a Czech-lands settlement with no 1910 okres
    counts too (:func:`unplaced_czech`: *Ruda nad Moravou*), except where :data:`LATER_TOWN_1910`
    names the 1910 settlement the later name stands for (*Nový Bohumín* → ``sunychl:1``)."""
    clean = clean_birthplace(muni)[0] if isinstance(muni, str) else None
    if not clean:
        return set()
    ks = {key(clean)}
    pieces = [p for p in re.split(r"\s*[-–]\s*", clean) if p.strip()]
    if len(pieces) > 1:
        ks.add(key(pieces[-1]))
    pick = _czech_1910 if _on("F1") else _czech
    later = _later_towns(g)
    out = set()
    for k in ks:
        ids = pick(g.global_any.get(k, ()), g)
        if k in later:          # the later name's own row stands for the 1910 settlement
            ids = {s for s in ids if _okres_any(s, g) is not None} | {later[k]}
        out |= ids
    return out


def _later_towns(g: Gazetteer) -> dict:
    """:attr:`Gazetteer.later_town`; with F1 off (measurement) only the 0.6.0 entries."""
    return g.later_town if _on("F1") else {k: s for k, s in g.later_town.items() if k in _LATER_TOWN_060}


def unplaced_in_okres(k: str, okresy, okres_s, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """F1 (0.7.0): the Czech-lands settlements with no 1910 okres (:func:`unplaced_czech`) named *k*,
    or its head without a qualifier, whose ``okres_all`` timeline holds the okres a candidate names
    (*okres_s* or a name of one of *okresy*): *Louky nad Dřevnicí, okres Uherské Hradiště* →
    ``louky:2`` (LOUKY, timeline Uherské Hradiště|…|Zlín)."""
    if not k:
        return set()
    tokens = {okres_token(okres_s)} if isinstance(okres_s, str) else set()
    tokens |= {nospace(n) for o in okresy or () for n in g.okres_names.get(o, ())}
    tokens.discard("")
    ids = set(g.global_any.get(k, ())) | set(g.global_any.get(strip_qualifier(k), ()))
    return {s for s in ids if unplaced_czech(s, g) and g.timeline.get(s, set()) & tokens}


def unanchored_named(k: str, main_sid, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """F1 (0.7.0): the okresy of the register's **unanchored** municipality rows printing the name *k*
    (*Oberlischna, Horní Lištná*, de-silesia 303009) — a 1910 municipality of the name the gazetteer
    holds no settlement for — unless *k* is a name of the link itself (its own unanchored row)."""
    if not k or nospace(k) in (g.forms_of.get(main_sid, set()) | g.pool_forms.get(main_sid, set())):
        return set()
    return set(g.unanchored_munis.get(k, ()))


def candidate_verdicts(cands, stated, oid, g: Gazetteer, main=None, main_sid=None,
                       home=None) -> list[tuple[str, object]]:
    """What each VÚA candidate reading gives on its own: ``("ok", sid)``, ``("ambiguous", ids)``
    (several settlements, in one okres or across the okresy its string may name), ``("global", ids)``
    (0.6.0: it matched nothing in an okres, but its name answers elsewhere in the Czech lands to
    settlements other than *main_sid*), or ``("none", why)`` with *why* one of
    :data:`SILENT_CANDIDATE`.

    0.5.0 (D1) counted every candidate that gave nothing as no evidence. 0.6.0 (T1): a candidate is
    ``(municipality, okres[, text])``; ``no_municipality`` (no name, or a placeholder such as *1.
    díl*); ``foreign`` (its text names a land outside the Czech lands, :func:`foreign_token`); its
    okres is :func:`candidate_okres` of the text, resolved by :func:`resolve_okres` —
    ``okres_foreign`` for a Slovak / Hungarian / Subcarpathian / Hlučín okres, else matched through
    P1–P4 in the okresy it names (:func:`twin_member`), a later okres also through its timeline
    token; a candidate that matches nothing there (``unmatched``), names no okres (``no_okres``) or an
    unresolvable one (``okres_unresolved``) takes the global-name fallback (:func:`global_names`, and
    in a resolved okres :func:`close_names`). The
    candidate that is the record's own reading (*main* = ``(municipality, okres)`` of the record) is
    never checked against the link by name alone.

    0.7.0 (F1): the fallback also counts Czech-lands settlements with no 1910 okres
    (:func:`global_names`, :func:`unplaced_in_okres`), and a candidate whose name only an
    **unanchored** register municipality prints gives ``("unanchored", okres ids)``
    (:func:`unanchored_named`).

    0.13.0 (J4): a candidate is matched as not stated (no I1 reading of its okres) and with the soldier's *home*
    values, so I2's and J1's home exceptions read the same home as the record's own match."""
    out: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
    mhome = home if _on("J4") else None              # 0.13.0 (J4)
    main_key = (key(main[0]) if main and isinstance(main[0], str) else None,
                okres_token(main[1]) if main and isinstance(main[1], str) else "")
    for c in cands:
        muni, okres, text = (tuple(c) + (None, None))[:3]
        if not isinstance(muni, str) or clean_birthplace(muni)[0] is None:
            out.append(("none", "no_municipality"))
            continue
        if isinstance(text, str) and foreign_token(text, exclude=(muni,)):
            out.append(("none", "foreign"))
            continue
        okres_s = candidate_okres(okres, text, g)
        kind, ids = resolve_okres(okres_s, stated, oid, g)
        if kind == "foreign":
            out.append(("none", "okres_foreign"))
            continue
        found = None
        if kind in ("czech", "later"):
            found = _matches([match_birthplace(muni, o, okres_s, None, False, g, vua=True, home=mhome, stated=False)
                              for o in sorted(twin_member(ids, muni, g))])
        if kind == "timeline" or (kind == "later" and found is None):
            found = _matches([match_birthplace(muni, None, okres_s, None, False, g, vua=True, home=mhome,
                                               stated=False)])
        k = key(clean_birthplace(muni)[0])
        if found is None and k in _later_towns(g):
            found = ("ok", _later_towns(g)[k])
        if found is not None:
            out.append(found)
            continue
        why = "no_okres" if not okres_s else "okres_unresolved" if kind == "none" else "unmatched"
        own = (k == main_key[0] or key(muni) == main_key[0]) and (okres_token(okres or "") == main_key[1])
        other, unanchored = set(), set()
        if not own:
            other = global_names(muni, g) - {main_sid}
            if kind in ("czech", "later"):          # a spelling of a settlement of its own okres (Weisbach)
                other |= close_names(k, twin_member(ids, muni, g), g) - {main_sid}
                if _on("F1"):                       # 0.7.0: a later name in the okres it names (Louky)
                    other |= unplaced_in_okres(k, twin_member(ids, muni, g), okres_s, g) - {main_sid}
            if _on("F1"):                           # 0.7.0: a 1910 municipality the register prints unanchored
                unanchored = unanchored_named(k, main_sid, g)
        out.append(("global", tuple(sorted(other))) if other
                   else ("unanchored", tuple(sorted(unanchored))) if unanchored else ("none", why))
    return out


def close_names(k: str, okresy, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """The settlements of *okresy* whose name is a close spelling of *k* (difflib ratio >=
    :data:`NAME_FUZZY_CUTOFF`): a candidate that matched nothing in the okres it names but is one
    letter off a settlement there names that settlement, not nothing (0.6.0, T1: vua 136140
    *Weisbach, okres Frýdland* is *Weissbach* of okres Frýdlant, ``bily-potok:3``)."""
    out: set = set()
    for o in okresy or ():
        names = g.okres_keys.get(o, {})
        for n in difflib.get_close_matches(k, list(names), n=3, cutoff=NAME_FUZZY_CUTOFF):
            out |= set(names[n])
    return out


def candidate_settlements(cands, stated, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> list:
    """The settlement each VÚA candidate reading gives on its own, ``None`` where it gives none or
    several (:func:`candidate_verdicts`; 0.4.0's interface)."""
    return [v if kind == "ok" else None for kind, v in candidate_verdicts(cands, stated, oid, g)]


# ── 0.8.0 (A6): the Habsburg regiment's recruiting region ─────────────────────
UNITS_DIR = ROOT / "reference" / "units"
#: Ehnl (1934) Tabelle I's territorial corps (``corps_territorial``) of a k.u.k. infantry regiment and
#: the region its corps area covered (the 16 Militärterritorialbereiche of 1914, by corps seat: I Krakau,
#: II Wien, III Graz, IV Budapest, V Pozsony, VI Kassa, VII Temesvár, VIII Prag, IX Leitmeritz, X
#: Przemyśl, XI Lemberg, XII Hermannstadt, XIII Agram, XIV Innsbruck, XV Sarajevo, XVI Ragusa — Ehnl
#: pp. 9–10, ``reference/units/ERGAENZUNG.md``). A regiment the table places in the Czech lands
#: (``land`` set) is ``czech`` whatever its corps; corps I and II also covered Silesia and Moravia, so
#: one of their regiments without a Czech district is the corps's other land (I Galicia, II Lower
#: Austria). Checked against ``ergaenzungsbezirk_1914.csv`` and ``sk_megye`` by the tests.
CORPS_REGION = {"I.": "galicia_bukovina", "II.": "austria", "III.": "austria", "IV.": "hungary",
                "V.": "hungary", "VI.": "hungary", "VII.": "hungary", "VIII.": "czech", "IX.": "czech",
                "X.": "galicia_bukovina", "XI.": "galicia_bukovina", "XII.": "hungary", "XIII.": "croatia",
                "XIV.": "austria", "XV.": "other", "XVI.": "other"}
#: the k.k. Landwehr commands of the Landwehr table (key form of ``corps_territorial``'s first command)
LANDWEHR_REGION = {"lwkmdo krakau": "galicia_bukovina", "lwkmdo lemberg": "galicia_bukovina",
                   "lwkmdo przemysl": "galicia_bukovina", "lwkmdo wien": "austria", "lwkmdo graz": "austria",
                   "lvertkmdo innsbruck": "austria", "lwkmdo ragusa": "other", "lwkmdo prag": "czech",
                   "lwkmdo leitmeritz": "czech"}
#: the regions in which a regiment's recruiting district is evidence against a Czech link (A6): every
#: region outside the Czech lands that a VÚA candidate can be placed in (:data:`FOREIGN_WORD_REGION`,
#: :func:`foreign_okres_region`)
REGIMENT_EVIDENCE_REGIONS = frozenset({"hungary", "galicia_bukovina", "austria", "croatia"})
_LEGION_UNIT_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\d+)\s*\.?\s*(\S.*)$")
_VUA_ARMY = {"Common army": "common", "Landwehr": "landwehr", "Honvéd": "honved"}


@lru_cache(maxsize=4)
def regiment_regions(units_dir: str = str(UNITS_DIR)) -> dict:
    """``{(army, reg_no): region}`` for the 1914 infantry of Ehnl's Tabelle I (A6): ``army`` is
    ``common`` (k.u.k., ``ehnl_tabelle1_infantry.csv``), ``landwehr`` (k.k.) or ``honved`` (k.u.); the
    region is ``czech`` where the table resolves the recruiting district to a Czech-lands okres
    (``land``), else the corps area's (:data:`CORPS_REGION`, :data:`LANDWEHR_REGION`); every Honvéd
    regiment ``hungary`` (the Hungarian crown's own army), the Croatian-Slavonian district ``croatia``.
    A regiment the tables do not resolve is absent: no evidence."""
    u, out = Path(units_dir), {}
    for army, name in (("common", "infantry"), ("landwehr", "landwehr"), ("honved", "honved")):
        path = u / f"ehnl_tabelle1_{name}.csv"
        if not path.exists():
            continue
        for r in pd.read_csv(path).itertuples(index=False):
            corps = str(r.corps_territorial) if isinstance(r.corps_territorial, str) else ""
            if isinstance(r.land, str) and r.land.strip():
                region = "czech"
            elif army == "common":
                region = CORPS_REGION.get(corps.strip())
            elif army == "landwehr":
                region = LANDWEHR_REGION.get(key(corps.split(";")[0]))
            else:
                region = "croatia" if corps.lower().startswith("kroat") else "hungary"
            if region:
                out[(army, int(r.reg_no))] = region
    return out


def legion_regiment(unit) -> tuple[str, int] | None:
    """``(army, number)`` of a csol.cz Habsburg infantry unit (``45.p.pl.`` → common 45, ``10.zem.p.pl.``
    → Landwehr 10, ``honv.p.pl.`` → Honvéd; the abbreviations of
    ``utils.docs.build_docs._legion_ah_matched``), else ``None`` (Landsturm ``dom.``, Schützen, other arms,
    a unit written with a ``?``)."""
    m = _LEGION_UNIT_RE.match(unit) if isinstance(unit, str) and "?" not in unit else None
    if not m:
        return None
    n, rest = int(m.group(1)), m.group(2).strip().lower()
    if rest.startswith(("p.pl.", "pp")):
        return "common", n
    if rest.startswith(("zem.p.pl.", "zem.pl.")):
        return "landwehr", n
    if rest.startswith("honv.p.pl."):
        return "honved", n
    return None


def vua_regiment(org, typ, number) -> tuple[str, int] | None:
    """``(army, number)`` of a VÚA Habsburg unit (``ah_unit_org``, ``ah_unit_type``, ``ah_regiment_no``,
    :func:`utils.parsing.habsburg.add_ah_unit_columns`): infantry of the common army, the Landwehr or the
    Honvéd only."""
    army = _VUA_ARMY.get(org) if isinstance(org, str) else None
    if typ != "Infantry" or army is None or number is None or pd.isna(number):
        return None
    return army, int(number)


def regiment_region(units) -> str | None:
    """The one recruiting region of a soldier's regiments (A6): each ``(army, number)`` of *units*
    (``None`` skipped) looked up in :func:`regiment_regions`; ``None`` when none resolves or two
    resolve to different regions (the peacetime and the capture regiment disagree: no evidence)."""
    table = regiment_regions()
    regions = {table.get(u) for u in units if u is not None} - {None}
    return next(iter(regions)) if len(regions) == 1 else None


def regiment_region_column(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """The recruiting region (:func:`regiment_region`) of every row: VÚA from ``ah_unit_org`` /
    ``ah_unit_type`` / ``ah_regiment_no``, csol.cz from ``habsburg_unit_peacetime`` and
    ``habsburg_unit_capture`` (recruitment ≠ field unit: both must agree, ERGAENZUNG.md); ``None`` without
    the columns, and for a VÚA unit written with a ``?`` (*pěší pluk 48 ?*: no evidence) (0.8.0, A6)."""
    units = regiment_units(df)
    if units is None:
        return pd.Series([None] * len(df), index=df.index, dtype=object)
    cache: dict = {}
    vals = [cache.setdefault(u, regiment_region(u)) for u in units]
    return pd.Series(vals, index=df.index, dtype=object)


def regiment_units(df: pd.DataFrame) -> list | None:
    """The ``(army, number)`` units of every row (VÚA one, csol.cz the peacetime and the capture
    regiment), ``None`` without the columns (0.9.0: shared by :func:`regiment_region_column` and
    :func:`regiment_area_column`)."""
    if {"ah_unit_org", "ah_unit_type", "ah_regiment_no"} <= set(df.columns):
        doubt = [isinstance(u, str) and "?" in u for u in _col(df, "ah_unit_primary").astype(object)]
        return [(None if d else vua_regiment(o, t, n),) for o, t, n, d in zip(df["ah_unit_org"].astype(object),
                                                                               df["ah_unit_type"].astype(object),
                                                                               df["ah_regiment_no"].astype(object),
                                                                               doubt)]
    if {"habsburg_unit_peacetime", "habsburg_unit_capture"} & set(df.columns):
        cols = [_col(df, c).astype(object) for c in ("habsburg_unit_peacetime", "habsburg_unit_capture")]
        return [(legion_regiment(a), legion_regiment(b)) for a, b in zip(*cols)]
    return None


def regiment_area_column(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """E2 (0.9.0): the recruiting area (:func:`regiment_area`) of every row, from the units of
    :func:`regiment_units`; ``None`` where none is known."""
    units = regiment_units(df)
    if units is None:
        return pd.Series([None] * len(df), index=df.index, dtype=object)
    cache: dict = {}
    return pd.Series([cache.setdefault(u, regiment_area(u)) for u in units], index=df.index, dtype=object)


def foreign_okres_region(okres_s, g: Gazetteer) -> str | None:
    """The region (A6) of an okres string :func:`resolve_okres` reads as foreign: ``austria`` for a
    Lower Austrian district (or, D-b, a close spelling of one), ``prussia`` for Hlučín, else
    ``hungary`` (the Hungarian frame's district and obec names, the Subcarpathian okresy); ``None``
    when the string is not foreign."""
    if not isinstance(okres_s, str) or not key(okres_s):
        return None
    if resolve_okres(okres_s, None, None, g)[0] != "foreign":
        return None
    k = key(okres_s)
    rural = _RURAL_WORD_RE.sub("", k).strip()
    if "hlucin" in (k, rural):
        return "prussia"
    if _on("E7") and (k in FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_PRUSSIA or rural in FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_PRUSSIA):
        return "prussia"
    if k in FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_LOWER_AUSTRIA or rural in FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_LOWER_AUSTRIA:
        return "austria"
    near = _closest_foreign(rural or k, g)
    if near and near[1] in FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_PRUSSIA:
        return "prussia"
    return "austria" if near and near[1] in FOREIGN_DISTRICTS_LOWER_AUSTRIA else "hungary"


def candidate_region(cand, g: Gazetteer) -> str | None:
    """The region outside the Czech lands one VÚA candidate reading places itself in (A6): a foreign
    word or district of its text (:data:`FOREIGN_WORD_REGION`), else its okres string's
    (:func:`foreign_okres_region`); ``None`` for a Czech-lands or unplaceable candidate."""
    muni, okres, text = (tuple(cand) + (None, None))[:3]
    if isinstance(text, str):
        tok = foreign_token(text, exclude=(muni,) if isinstance(muni, str) else ())
        if tok:
            return FOREIGN_WORD_REGION.get(tok)
    return foreign_okres_region(candidate_okres(okres, text, g), g)


def regiment_candidates(cands, region, g: Gazetteer, area=None) -> list:
    """A6: the candidates of *cands* placed in the regiment's *region* (one of
    :data:`REGIMENT_EVIDENCE_REGIONS`).

    0.9.0 (E2): only a candidate in the regiment's own recruiting county or a county next to it
    (*area*, :func:`regiment_area`; :func:`in_area`), and never one that is only a ``dříve:`` former-name
    list (:func:`former_name_only`): IR 34 Kassa (Abaúj-Torna) is no evidence for *Opava, okres Modrý
    Kameň* (Nógrád); IR 67 Eperjes (Sáros) is for *Tvarožná, okres Kežmarok* (Szepes, next to Sáros). With
    E2 on, a regiment without a known area is no evidence."""
    if region not in REGIMENT_EVIDENCE_REGIONS:
        return []
    out = [c for c in cands if candidate_region(c, g) == region]
    if _on("E2"):
        out = [c for c in out if not former_name_only(c) and in_area(candidate_counties(c, g), area)]
    return out


def _seat_key(seat: str) -> str:
    """E2: the key of one recruiting-district seat as Ehnl prints it (*Kronstadt (Brassó)* → ``kronstadt``,
    *Groß-(Nagy-)Kanizsa* → ``gross kanizsa``, *Wien A* → ``wien``)."""
    s = re.sub(r"\([^()]*\)", " ", str(seat)).replace("ß", "ss")
    return re.sub(r"\s+[ab]$", "", key(s)).strip()


@lru_cache(maxsize=4)
def regiment_areas(units_dir: str = str(UNITS_DIR)) -> dict:
    """E2 (0.9.0): ``{(army, reg_no): frozenset}`` — the recruiting area of each regiment outside the
    Czech lands: the 1910 counties of its Ergänzungsbezirk seats (Ehnl ``ergbez``, every ``;`` piece,
    :data:`ERGBEZ_COUNTY`) for a Hungarian regiment, ``seat:<key>`` of each seat for a Galician, Austrian or
    Croatian one (compared with :data:`DISTRICT_ERGBEZ`); a regiment none of whose seats is known is absent."""
    regions = regiment_regions(units_dir)
    u, out = Path(units_dir), {}
    for army, name in (("common", "infantry"), ("landwehr", "landwehr"), ("honved", "honved")):
        path = u / f"ehnl_tabelle1_{name}.csv"
        if not path.exists():
            continue
        for r in pd.read_csv(path).itertuples(index=False):
            region = regions.get((army, int(r.reg_no)))
            if region not in REGIMENT_EVIDENCE_REGIONS or not isinstance(r.ergbez, str):
                continue
            seats = [s for s in (_seat_key(x) for x in r.ergbez.split(";")) if s]
            area = ({ERGBEZ_COUNTY[s] for s in seats if s in ERGBEZ_COUNTY} if region == "hungary"
                    else {f"seat:{s}" for s in seats})
            if area:
                out[(army, int(r.reg_no))] = frozenset(area)
    return out


def regiment_area(units) -> frozenset | None:
    """E2 (0.9.0): the union of the recruiting areas (:func:`regiment_areas`) of a soldier's regiments,
    ``None`` where none is known."""
    table = regiment_areas()
    out = frozenset().union(*(table.get(u, frozenset()) for u in units if u is not None))
    return out or None


def candidate_counties(cand, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """E2 (0.9.0): where one VÚA candidate reading lies, county by county: its okres string's 1910 counties
    (:attr:`Gazetteer.hu_county`: a Slovak or Subcarpathian okres, a járás or its seat), or ``seat:<key>``
    for a foreign district word that is a recruiting seat (:data:`DISTRICT_ERGBEZ`: *Krakov*); empty where
    the candidate names only a land (*Halič*, *Slovensko*)."""
    muni, okres, text = (tuple(cand) + (None, None))[:3]
    if isinstance(text, str):
        for piece in re.split(r"[,;()/]+", text)[1:]:
            if key(piece) in DISTRICT_ERGBEZ:
                return {f"seat:{DISTRICT_ERGBEZ[key(piece)]}"}
    okres_s = candidate_okres(okres, text, g)
    if not isinstance(okres_s, str):
        return set()
    k = key(okres_s)
    rural = _RURAL_WORD_RE.sub("", k).strip()
    return set(g.hu_county.get(k) or g.hu_county.get(rural) or ())


def in_area(counties, area) -> bool:
    """E2 (0.9.0): one of *counties* is in the regiment's *area* or touches a county of it
    (:data:`COUNTY_NEIGHBOURS`; a ``seat:`` item only as itself)."""
    if not area or not counties:
        return False
    return any(c in area or any(n in area for n in COUNTY_NEIGHBOURS.get(c, ())) for c in counties)


_FORMER_RE = re.compile(r"^\(?\s*d[rř][ií]ve\b", re.IGNORECASE)


def former_name_only(cand) -> bool:
    """E2 (0.9.0): a candidate reading that is only VÚA's ``dříve:`` former-name list — the parenthesis
    of German or former names read as a reading (*(Vezekény - ?; dříve: Végvezekény - ?)*, no name of its
    own), or a reading whose name is itself ``dříve X`` — gives no regiment evidence."""
    muni, _okres, text = (tuple(cand) + (None, None))[:3]
    if isinstance(muni, str) and muni.strip():
        return bool(_FORMER_RE.match(muni.strip()))
    return isinstance(text, str) and "dříve" in text.lower()


def home_names_link(home, head, sid, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """E2 (0.9.0): the soldier's VÚA home cell names the link — its municipality (or a hyphen piece of it:
    *Sedlišťka-Nová Sídla*) is a name of the linked settlement, or its **written** okres string fits the
    link's okres — and is not merely a copy of the written *head* (*Opava*, home *Opava*: no evidence)."""
    hm, _ho, _hl, _hmg, _hj, hok = (tuple(home or ()) + (None,) * 6)[:6]
    hname = clean_birthplace(str(hm).split(",")[0])[0] if isinstance(hm, str) else None
    name = clean_birthplace(re.split(r"[,;]", head)[0])[0] if isinstance(head, str) else None
    if not hname or sid is None or (name and key(hname) == key(name)):
        return False
    keys = {key(hname)} | {key(x) for x in re.split(r"\s*[-–]\s*", hname) if x.strip()}
    if form_set(keys) & (_name_forms(sid, g) | g.forms_1910.get(sid, set())):
        return True
    okr = re.sub(r"[?+]", " ", str(hok).split(",")[0]).strip(" -–.") if isinstance(hok, str) else ""
    return bool(okres_token(okr)) and _okres_fits(okr, sid, g, exact_only=True) is None


def home_names_only_link(home, head, sid, ids, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """G4/G7 (0.10.0): :func:`home_names_link` for the link *sid*, and the home names none of the other candidate
    settlements *ids* — not as written (space-free, the qualifier kept: home *Kralice na Hané* is no name of
    *Kralice* of Třebíč) and not by its written okres (*Podolí Skrýchov, Tábor ?*, home okres Tábor, where both
    candidates lie: nothing decided)."""
    if not home_names_link(home, head, sid, g):
        return False
    hm, _ho, _hl, _hmg, _hj, hok = (tuple(home or ()) + (None,) * 6)[:6]
    hname = clean_birthplace(str(hm).split(",")[0])[0] if isinstance(hm, str) else None
    hk = nospace(key(hname)) if hname else ""
    okr = re.sub(r"[?+]", " ", str(hok).split(",")[0]).strip(" -–.") if isinstance(hok, str) else ""
    for o in (ids or ()):
        if o == sid:
            continue
        if hk and hk in (_name_forms(o, g) | g.forms_1910.get(o, set())):
            return False
        if okres_token(okr) and _okres_fits(okr, o, g, exact_only=True) is None:
            return False
    return True


def modlan_keeps(head, main_sid, glob, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """D-f (0.8.0): a link read off VÚA's first candidate stands beside ``global`` candidates when the
    written *head* (exact key, space-free) is a printed 1910 form of the link — a register form or the
    lexikon's 1910 name — and every other id is an unplaced Czech-lands row (:func:`unplaced_czech`) the
    register does not print and the lexikon gives no 1910 name (*Modlan* = ``modlany:1``, printed
    *Modlan, Modlany*, beside *Nové Modlany*, ``nove-modlany:1``). *Nový Bohumín* (``sunychl:1``, a
    register row) stays refused."""
    if not isinstance(head, str) or not glob:
        return False
    name = clean_birthplace(re.split(r"[,;]", head)[0])[0]
    hk = nospace(key(name)) if name else ""
    printed = g.pool_forms.get(main_sid, set()) | g.forms_1910.get(main_sid, set())
    if not hk or hk not in printed:
        return False
    return all(unplaced_czech(s, g) and not g.pool_forms.get(s) and s not in g.owner and not g.forms_1910.get(s)
               for s in glob)


def vua_candidate_rule(main_sid, cands, stated, oid, g: Gazetteer, main=None,
                       head=None, regiment=None, area=None, home=None, match_home=None) -> tuple[object, tuple, tuple]:
    """D1 (0.5.0, tightened in 0.6.0 by T1): ``(refusal candidates or None, silent reasons, against
    kinds)`` for a reading taken from VÚA's first candidate and matched to *main_sid*.

    Refused when any candidate gives a **different** settlement, is itself ambiguous (an ambiguous
    candidate may name another place: refused even when its ids hold *main_sid* — conservative, the
    0.4.0 extension the author kept), or (0.6.0) names, by the global-name fallback, Czech-lands
    settlements other than *main_sid* (``global``); the refusal candidates are *main_sid* and every
    id the candidates give (at most :data:`GLOBAL_CANDIDATES_SHOWN` from the fallback). A candidate
    giving nothing is no evidence: its reason goes to *silent* (the caller keeps such a link
    ``vua_uncertain``). *main* is the record's own ``(municipality, okres)``.

    0.7.0: a candidate naming a 1910 municipality the register prints unanchored refuses too
    (``unanchored``, F1); and where the link would stand beside silent candidates — the candidates
    disagree — the record's written *head* (:func:`head_text`) is read against it
    (:func:`head_verdict`: ``head_global`` F1; ``head_foreign`` / ``head_land`` / ``head_namesake``
    F2).

    0.8.0: D-f — ``global`` candidates that are only unplaced rows the register does not print stand
    aside when the head is a printed 1910 form of the link (:func:`modlan_keeps`; the link keeps
    ``vua_uncertain`` through the silent reason ``global_unplaced``); A6 — where the link would stand,
    a candidate in the recruiting region of the soldier's *regiment* (:func:`regiment_candidates`)
    refuses it (kind ``regiment``); the regiment never picks a candidate. *match_home* (0.13.0, J4): the home values
    the candidates are matched with (:func:`candidate_verdicts`; the record's own match reads the same)."""
    verdicts = candidate_verdicts(cands, stated, oid, g, main=main, main_sid=main_sid, home=match_home)
    other = {v for kind, v in verdicts if kind == "ok" and v != main_sid}
    amb = {x for kind, v in verdicts if kind == "ambiguous" for x in v}
    glob = {x for kind, v in verdicts if kind == "global" for x in v} - {main_sid}
    unanch = any(kind == "unanchored" for kind, _v in verdicts)
    silent = tuple(v for kind, v in verdicts if kind == "none")
    if glob and not (other or amb or unanch) and _on("Df") and modlan_keeps(head, main_sid, glob, g):
        silent, glob = silent + ("global_unplaced",), set()
    if other or amb or glob or unanch:
        against = tuple(k for k, flag in (("settlement", other), ("ambiguous", amb), ("global", glob),
                                          ("unanchored", unanch)) if flag)
        shown = set(sorted(glob)[:GLOBAL_CANDIDATES_SHOWN])
        return tuple(sorted(other | amb | shown | {main_sid})), silent, against
    if silent and head:
        kind, ids = head_verdict(head, cands, verdicts, main, main_sid, g)
        if kind:
            shown = set(sorted(ids)[:GLOBAL_CANDIDATES_SHOWN])
            return tuple(sorted(shown | {main_sid})), silent, (kind,)
    if silent and regiment and _on("A6") and regiment_candidates(cands, regiment, g, area=area):
        # 0.9.0 (E2): a home cell that names the link (not a copy of the head) outweighs the regiment
        if not (_on("E2") and home_names_link(home, head, main_sid, g)):
            return (main_sid,), silent, ("regiment",)
    return None, silent, ()


def head_text(raw) -> str | None:
    """The record's written head: the raw cell before its first parenthesis (``Eisenberg ?``;
    ``Jeníkov, Nitra ?``), ``None`` where empty (0.7.0)."""
    if not isinstance(raw, str):
        return None
    h = raw.split("(", 1)[0].strip(" ?;,")
    return h or None


def _name_forms(sid, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    return g.forms_of.get(sid, set()) | g.pool_forms.get(sid, set())


def head_verdict(head, cands, verdicts, main, main_sid, g: Gazetteer) -> tuple[str | None, set]:
    """``(kind, ids)`` where the written *head* contradicts a link read off VÚA's first candidate,
    else ``(None, set())`` (0.7.0). In order:

    * F2 ``head_foreign`` — the head names a land, country or district outside the Czech lands
      (:func:`foreign_token`, a Hungarian or other foreign okres among its comma pieces: *Jeníkov,
      Nitra*; Upper Silesia), or the head's name **is** a candidate VÚA placed outside the Czech
      lands and not the linked candidate's name nor any name of the link (*Inzersdorf* = *Inzersdorf,
      Hietzing, Dolní Rakousy*, not *Tolštejn-Innozenzidorf*);
    * F2 ``head_land`` — a land word against the link's land (:func:`land_conflict`: *Markovice,
      Morava* → Chrudim);
    * F2 ``head_namesake`` — a distinguishing word of the head (:data:`MARKER_WORDS`: *Něm.*,
      *Horní*, *Nový* …) that the names of another namesake carry and the link's do not (*Něm.
      Kravaře* → ``kravare:2``, *Deutsch Krawarn*), :func:`marker_namesakes`;
    * F1 ``head_global`` — the head's name is not the linked candidate's own (nor a piece of it, nor a
      spelling of it within :data:`HEAD_SAME_NAME_RATIO`) and answers elsewhere to Czech-lands
      settlements other than the link (:func:`global_names`; within the okres and the land the head
      names, when it names them): *Eisenberg* → ``ruda:4`` beside ``jezeri:1``. 0.8.0 (D-d): a named
      land keeps only the namesakes in exactly that land — the Moravia/Silesia tolerance of
      :func:`land_conflict` refuses a link but creates no competing namesake (*Benešov, Slezsko*: not
      ``benesov:2`` of Boskovice).

    A head naming the link's own okres is no foreign candidate's name (*Dolní Štěpánov, Šternberk*
    beside *Dolní Štepanov, okres Trstená*)."""
    pieces = [p.strip() for p in re.split(r"[,;]", head)]
    name = clean_birthplace(pieces[0])[0] if pieces and pieces[0] else None
    if not name:
        return None, set()
    hk = key(name)
    main_muni = main[0] if main and isinstance(main[0], str) else None
    main_clean = clean_birthplace(main_muni)[0] if main_muni else None
    main_keys = {key(main_clean)} if main_clean else set()
    if main_clean:
        main_keys |= {key(p) for p in re.split(r"\s*[-–]\s*", main_clean) if p.strip()}
    okresy = set().union(*(_written_ids(p, g, exact=True) for p in pieces[1:] if key(p))) if len(pieces) > 1 else set()
    lands = lands_named(head)
    if _on("F2"):
        if foreign_token(head, exclude=(main_muni,) if main_muni else ()) or any(
                key(p) and resolve_okres(p, None, None, g, fuzzy=False, timeline=False)[0] == "foreign"
                for p in pieces[1:]):
            return "head_foreign", set()
        if "foreign" in lands:
            return "head_foreign", set()
        if land_conflict(lands, _land_of(main_sid, g)):
            return "head_land", set()
        mine = form_set([hk])
        names_link_okres = _okres_any(main_sid, g) in okresy      # "Dolní Štěpánov, Šternberk": the link's okres
        for c, (kind, why) in zip(cands, verdicts):
            cm = clean_birthplace(c[0])[0] if c and isinstance(c[0], str) else None
            if (kind == "none" and why in ("foreign", "okres_foreign") and cm and key(cm) == hk
                    and hk not in main_keys and not (mine & _name_forms(main_sid, g)) and not names_link_okres):
                return "head_foreign", set()
        ids = marker_namesakes(hk, main_sid, g)
        if ids:
            return "head_namesake", ids
    # the head's own spelling of the linked candidate's name is that name (Kunova / Kunov)
    near = any(difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, hk, m).ratio() >= HEAD_SAME_NAME_RATIO for m in main_keys)
    if _on("F1") and hk not in main_keys and not near:
        ids = global_names(name, g) - {main_sid}
        if okresy:                                   # the okres the head names (Třítěz, Pelhřimov)
            ids = {s for s in ids if _okres_any(s, g) in okresy}
        numbered = {x for x in lands if x != "foreign"}
        if numbered and _on("Dd"):                   # 0.8.0 (D-d): exactly the land the head names
            ids = {s for s in ids if _land_of(s, g) in numbered}
        elif numbered:                               # the land the head names (Benešov, Slezsko)
            ids = {s for s in ids if not land_conflict(numbered, _land_of(s, g))}
        if ids:
            return "head_global", ids
    return None, set()


#: 0.7.0 (F1): a head this close (difflib ratio) to the linked candidate's name is a spelling of it,
#: not another name (*Kunova* / *Kunov* 0.91, *Zeleny* / *Zelené* 0.83)
HEAD_SAME_NAME_RATIO = 0.8


def marker_namesakes(hk: str, main_sid, g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """F2 (0.7.0): the namesakes a distinguishing word of the head points to. For each word of the
    head key *hk* in :data:`MARKER_WORDS` (*nem* in ``nem kravare``), the settlements of the rest of
    the name (``kravare``, every okres and land: the head may name a place outside the Czech lands)
    whose names — lexikon (1910 and German included) or register — start with one of the word's stems
    (``deutschkrawarn``); returned only when the link's own names carry none of them."""
    words = hk.split()
    out: set = set()
    for i, w in enumerate(words):
        for heads, stems in MARKER_WORDS:
            if w not in heads:
                continue
            base = " ".join(words[:i] + words[i + 1:])
            if not base:
                continue
            carry = lambda s: any(f.startswith(stems) for f in _name_forms(s, g))    # noqa: E731
            if carry(main_sid):
                return set()
            out |= {s for s in g.global_any.get(base, ()) if s != main_sid and carry(s)}
    return out


def obec_over_part(sid, tier, clean, oid, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """D-144 chose a register municipality over a register **part** printing the same name (0.4.0, no
    link change): *Nová Ves* | Kolín → ``nova-ves-i:1`` (cz 301040087/20, 1,375) while the register
    also prints the part *Nová Ves, Neudorf* of Svojšice."""
    table = {"p1_register": g.reg, "p2_register_alt": g.reg_alt}.get(tier or "")
    if table is None or sid is None or oid is None or not clean:
        return False
    ids = table.get((key(clean), oid)) or set()
    # 0.4.1: a competing part the chosen municipality itself owns is no rival (Osek → novy-osek:1,
    # whose own part hrad-osek:1 prints the same name)
    return (len(ids) > 1 and sid in ids and sid in g.reg_municipal
            and any(s not in g.reg_municipal and (g.owner.get(s) or {}).get("muni_sid") != sid
                    for s in ids if s != sid))


_HEAD_KINDS = frozenset({"head_foreign", "head_land", "head_namesake"})
#: every refusal value of the first-candidate rule (:func:`candidate_refusal`)
CANDIDATE_REFUSALS = ("ambiguous:vua_candidates", "vua_head_conflict", "vua_regiment_conflict")


def candidate_refusal(against) -> str:
    """The refusal of the first-candidate rule for the kinds that refused it: ``vua_regiment_conflict``
    (A6, the regiment), ``vua_head_conflict`` (0.8.0, D-g: the written head against the link — F2's
    ``head_foreign`` / ``head_land`` / ``head_namesake``), else ``ambiguous:vua_candidates``."""
    if "regiment" in against:
        return "vua_regiment_conflict"
    if _on("Dg") and set(against) & _HEAD_KINDS:
        return "vua_head_conflict"
    return "ambiguous:vua_candidates"


def stated_okres_alternatives(raw, clean, sid, g: Gazetteer) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, tuple]:
    """D-a (0.8.0, F5 for a stated okres): where the cell gives okres alternatives in parentheses after an
    okres word of the head (:func:`okres_only_alternatives`: *Domoradice, okr. Vysoké Mýto? (Český Krumlov?)*), an
    okres the cell names that the link does not lie in and that holds another namesake of the key
    (:func:`holds_namesake`) refuses the link ``okres_from_name_ambiguous`` — as F5 does for an okres
    inferred from the name; ``(None, None, ())`` otherwise."""
    alts = okres_only_alternatives(raw, g, sid)
    k = key(clean) if clean else ""
    if not alts or not k:
        return None, None, ()
    for name in dict.fromkeys([*okres_names_in(raw), *alts]):
        if _okres_fits(name, sid, g) == "conflict" and holds_namesake(name, k, sid, g):
            return "okres_from_name_ambiguous", "okres_alternative_stated", tuple(sorted(_written_ids(name, g)))
    return None, None, ()


def czech_looking_okres(okres, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """D-a (0.8.0): an unresolved okres string is a misspelt Czech-lands okres — some backbone okres or
    court name within :data:`OKRES_LOOSE_CUTOFF` of it (``venkov`` / ``okolí`` dropped) and no foreign
    district name at least as close (:func:`_closest_foreign`)."""
    k = key(okres) if isinstance(okres, str) else ""
    rural = _RURAL_WORD_RE.sub("", k).strip() or k
    if not rural:
        return False
    close = difflib.get_close_matches(rural, [n for n in g.okres_by_name if len(nospace(n)) >= 3], n=1,
                                      cutoff=OKRES_LOOSE_CUTOFF)
    if not close:
        return False
    best = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, rural, close[0]).ratio()
    near = _closest_foreign(rural, g)
    return not (near and near[0] >= best)


def _foreign_string(s, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """D-a (0.8.0): an okres string that is itself a foreign district or names a foreign land
    (:data:`FOREIGN_DISTRICTS`, :data:`FOREIGN_WORDS`, the Hungarian frame's names; *Lvov*)."""
    k = key(s) if isinstance(s, str) else ""
    rural = _RURAL_WORD_RE.sub("", k).strip()
    return bool(k) and (k in FOREIGN_DISTRICTS or rural in FOREIGN_DISTRICTS or k in g.foreign_okres
                        or any(w in FOREIGN_WORDS for w in k.split()))


def okres_string_consistent(s, sid, g: Gazetteer) -> bool:
    """D-a (0.8.0): the unresolved okres string *s* is a spelling of the okres the name inference reached
    — within :data:`OKRES_LOOSE_CUTOFF` (space-free, ``venkov`` dropped) of a name of the settlement's 1910
    okres or of a token of its ``okres_all`` timeline (*Preha venkov* / Praha-venkov for Točná, 1910
    Smíchov)."""
    k = key(s) if isinstance(s, str) else ""
    forms = {nospace(_RURAL_WORD_RE.sub("", k).strip() or k), nospace(k)} - {""}
    targets = {nospace(n) for n in g.okres_names.get(_okres_any(sid, g), ())} | set(g.timeline.get(sid, ()))
    return any(difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, f, t).ratio() >= OKRES_LOOSE_CUTOFF for f in forms for t in targets if t)


def unresolved_okres_link(m, s, ger, unc: bool, raw, g: Gazetteer, gforms=None,
                          home_land=None, vua_cell: bool = False, home=None) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None]:
    """D-a (0.8.0, F6 in the re-parsed frame): a record whose okres string records_geo left unresolved
    (no ``okres_id``) — before it is refused ``no_okres_1910``:

    * ``"string"`` — :func:`resolve_okres` reads the string as one Czech-lands okres (a backbone, court
      or later name, an alias, a close spelling: *Kroměíž venkov*, *Žlužice*; city/rural twins by
      :func:`twin_member`) and the name is matched there, as under a stated okres;
    * ``"name"`` — else, for a Czech-looking string (:func:`czech_looking_okres`: *Brmo*, *Plzań*,
      *Šrenberk*, *Znijmo venkov*, *Preha venkov*) that is a spelling of the okres the name leads to
      (:func:`okres_string_consistent`), or — in a VÚA cell (*vua_cell*) — one that repeats the
      municipality (*Brandýs nad Orlicí, okr. Brandýs nad Orlicí*; csol.cz's two fields repeating one name
      are often a foreign town: *Dubno*, *Brody*, *Landshut*), the okres is inferred from the name as the as-is run does it (D-144 across
      okresy, :func:`d2_decide`) and the caller runs the inferred-okres rule on the record (the string is
      then no evidence, F6; the link carries ``okres_inferred``) — never for a home outside the Czech lands
      (*home_land*: legion *Dubno, okres Dubno*, home in Volhynia);
    * ``(None, None)`` — a foreign cell or string (a land word, a foreign district, the string itself:
      *Lvov*; D-b, no fuzzy reading of *Senica, Slovensko*), a later-okres timeline token (P4 already reads
      it), no single okres or settlement.

    0.13.0 (J4): every match here runs in an okres the string or the name supplied, not a stated one — no I1 reading
    (``stated=False``) — and with the soldier's *home* values (I2's and J1's home exceptions).

    0.14.0 (K2): a name no 1910 settlement carries as written but exactly one carries abbreviated
    (:func:`abbreviated_settlement`) is read in that settlement's okres where the string is a later-okres token of its
    timeline (``"string"``: the string named the okres, *Brandýs n. L.* | *Brandýs n. L.*) or, as any name (``"name"``),
    a spelling of its okres."""
    mhome = home if _on("J4") else None
    text = ", ".join(x for x in ("x", s, raw if isinstance(raw, str) else None) if isinstance(x, str))
    if (foreign_token(text, exclude=(m,) if isinstance(m, str) else ()) or "foreign" in lands_named(text)
            or _foreign_string(s, g)):
        return None, None
    kind, ids, how = okres_resolution(s, None, None, g)
    if kind == "timeline" and _on("E9") and ids in multi_okres_tokens(g):
        res = timeline_okres_link(m, s, ids, ger, unc, g, gforms, vua=vua_cell, home=mhome)
        return (res, "timeline") if res is not None else (None, None)
    if kind == "timeline" and _on("K2"):
        # 0.14.0 (K2): a name the 1910 settlements hold only abbreviated (*Brandýs n. L.*), under a later-okres token
        # its one settlement's timeline carries (*Brandýs n. L.* read as the okres Brandýs nad Labem)
        clean = clean_birthplace(m)[0] if isinstance(m, str) else None
        one = abbreviated_settlement(key(clean), g) if clean else None
        if one is not None and ids in g.timeline.get(one, set()) and _okres_any(one, g) is not None:
            return (match_birthplace(m, _okres_any(one, g), None, ger, unc, g, german_forms=gforms, vua=vua_cell,
                                     home=mhome, stated=False), "string")
    if kind in ("foreign", "timeline"):
        return None, None
    if kind in ("czech", "later"):
        found = [match_birthplace(m, o2, s, ger, unc, g, german_forms=gforms, vua=vua_cell, home=mhome, stated=False)
                 for o2 in sorted(twin_member(set(ids), m, g))]
        for r in found:
            r["okres_how"] = how                   # 0.9.0 (E10): exact / alias / later / hyphen / fuzzy
        if len(found) == 1:
            return found[0], "string"
        linked = [r for r in found if r["sid"] is not None]
        if len(linked) == 1 and not any(str(r["refusal"] or "").startswith("ambiguous") for r in found):
            return linked[0], "string"
        return None, None
    if isinstance(home_land, str) and home_land.strip() and home_land.strip() != "Czech lands":
        return None, None
    clean = clean_birthplace(m)[0] if isinstance(m, str) else None
    repeated = bool(clean) and vua_cell and key(s) == key(clean)
    if not clean or not (repeated or czech_looking_okres(s, g)):
        return None, None
    v, one = d2_decide(key(clean), g)
    if v == "ambiguous" and not one and _on("K2"):    # 0.14.0 (K2): no 1910 settlement as written; abbreviated?
        abbreviated = abbreviated_settlement(key(clean), g)
        if abbreviated is not None:
            v, one = "ok", abbreviated
            repeated = repeated or okres_token(s) == okres_token(clean)
    if v != "ok" or _okres_any(one, g) is None or not (repeated or okres_string_consistent(s, one, g)):
        return None, None
    return (match_birthplace(m, _okres_any(one, g), None, ger, unc, g, german_forms=gforms, vua=vua_cell, home=mhome,
                             stated=False), "name")


def multi_okres_tokens(g: Gazetteer) -> set:
    """E9 (0.9.0): the okres_all tokens of the later okresy that span several 1910 okresy — those of
    :data:`LATER_OKRES_1910` (:attr:`Gazetteer.later_token`) and the capital's countryside
    (*prahavenkov*, *prahazapad* …)."""
    out = set(g.later_token.values())
    out |= {t for t in g.timeline_tokens if _PRAHA_RURAL_RE.match(re.sub(r"^(praha)", r"\1 ", t))}
    return out


def timeline_okres_link(m, s, tok, ger, unc: bool, g: Gazetteer, gforms=None, vua: bool = False,
                        home=None) -> dict | None:
    """E9 (0.9.0): a name under a later okres that spans several 1910 okresy (*Kralupy*: Slaný, Smíchov,
    Mělník; *Praha-venkov*: Smíchov, Karlín, Královské Vinohrady), read as P4 reads a timeline okres but
    through every tier: the name matched in each 1910 okres that formed it (:func:`timeline_okresy`) and in
    its seat okresy (:func:`timeline_seat_okresy`) — one settlement across them links (in its own 1910
    okres), namesakes in several are refused ``ambiguous:p4_okres_timeline`` (no okres set), none gives
    ``None`` (P4 as before). In a seat okres the settlement need not carry the later okres in its own
    ``okres_all`` — the lexikon's timeline misses it on villages the records place there (*Koleč, okres
    Kralupy*: Slaný, Kladno; *Butovice, okres Praha venkov*: Smíchov) — elsewhere it must (*Vokovice* of
    Smíchov is no village of okres Kralupy, and nor are *Letky* and *Tursko* of Smíchov: their lexikon timeline is
    Smíchov|Praha-venkov|Praha-západ, without Kralupy — 0.9.0's docstring said they were; corrected in 0.10.0, F8,
    behaviour unchanged, so legion *Letky* | *Kralupy nad Vltavou* stays ``no_okres_1910``). As P4, a statutory city answers only to its own name and a qualifier is not stripped off a
    name that exists as written elsewhere (*Kamýk nad Vltavou*)."""
    clean = clean_birthplace(m)[0] if isinstance(m, str) else None
    k = key(clean) if clean else ""
    found = []
    seats = timeline_seat_okresy(tok, g)
    okresy = timeline_okresy(tok, g) | seats
    for o2 in sorted(okresy):
        r = match_birthplace(m, o2, s, ger, unc, g, german_forms=gforms, vua=vua, home=home,
                             stated=False)    # 0.13.0 (J4): not a stated okres (the flag is read only with J4 on)
        # as P4: no statutory city for a name that is not the city's, no qualifier stripped off a name that
        # exists as written elsewhere (Kamýk nad Vltavou is not Kamýk of Velké Přílepy), and no settlement
        # the Prague pool finds outside the okresy that formed the later okres
        if r["tier"] == "statutory_city" and k not in g.okres_names.get(o2, set()):
            continue
        if r["tier"] == "p2_qualifier" and g.global_name.get(k):
            continue
        # outside the seat okres the settlement must carry the later okres in its own timeline (Vokovice of
        # Smíchov is no village of okres Kralupy, nor are Letky and Tursko of Smíchov: no Kralupy in their timeline)
        if r["sid"] is not None and _okres_any(r["sid"], g) not in seats and tok not in g.timeline.get(r["sid"], set()):
            continue
        found.append(r)
