def _insert_after(text: str, anchor: str, addition: str) -> str:
    if text.count(anchor) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"schema.py anchor not found exactly once: {anchor!r}")
    return text.replace(anchor, anchor + addition)


def schema_patch(schema_path: Path = ROOT / "utils" / "parsing" / "schema.py") -> str:
    """A unified diff (not applied) adding to ``schema.py``: the ``locations`` 1.2 columns to
    ``HABSBURG_RENAME`` / ``HABSBURG_FINAL`` / ``_DESCRIPTIONS`` (both place roles; the legionnaire
    frame has no ``locations`` columns — csol.cz gives obec and okres as two fields), and the
    birth-settlement columns as a ``_BIRTH_SETTLEMENT`` block documented by
    :func:`schema.write_data_dictionary` for both datasets — they are added in notebook 02 §4 after
    ``to_english`` (they need ``birth_okres_id``), like ``_GEO_DERIVED``, so no ``*_FINAL`` entry.

    Empty once ``schema.py`` carries the block (applied 2026-11-16, ``schema`` 1.14.0); the test then
    checks the applied schema against :data:`SETTLEMENT_DESCRIPTIONS` instead."""
    old = Path(schema_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if "_BIRTH_SETTLEMENT: dict[str, str] = {" in old:
        return ""
    new = old.replace(
        '__version__ = "1.13.0"  # date precision, death_date_raw, note_register_ref, §4 columns documented (audit 2026-09-22)',
        '__version__ = "1.14.0"  # locations 1.2 columns + birth_settlement columns documented (birth_settlement 0.5.0)')
    roles = {"birth": "birth", "home": "home (domicile)"}
    for role, anchor_rename, anchor_final in (
            ("birth", '    "birth_loc_uncertain": "birth_loc_uncertain",\n',
             '    "birth_land", "birth_cisleithanian", "birth_loc_uncertain",\n'),
            ("home", '    "home_cisleithanian": "home_cisleithanian",\n',
             '    "home_municipality", "home_okres", "home_land", "home_cisleithanian",\n')):
        cols = [f"{role}{s}" for s in LOCATIONS_12_DESCRIPTIONS]
        new = _insert_after(new, anchor_rename,
                            f"    # locations.py 1.2 (statutory-city quarter, the VÚA candidate list)\n"
                            + "".join(f'    "{c}": "{c}",\n' for c in cols))
        new = _insert_after(new, anchor_final, "    " + ", ".join(f'"{c}"' for c in cols) + ",\n")
        desc = "".join(f'    "{role}{s}": "{d.format(role=roles[role], prefix=role)}",\n'
                       for s, d in LOCATIONS_12_DESCRIPTIONS.items())
        new = _insert_after(new, '    "home_cisleithanian": "As birth_cisleithanian, for the home (domicile) '
                                 'place — derived from the corrected home_land",\n' if role == "home" else
                            '    "birth_loc_uncertain": "True if birthplace parse was uncertain",\n', desc)
    block = ("\n# Birth-settlement link columns added in notebook §4 by\n"
             "# utils.parsing.birth_settlement.add_birth_settlement_columns (birth role, both datasets),\n"
             "# after records_geo has set birth_okres_id. {role} is substituted per prefix.\n"
             "_BIRTH_SETTLEMENT: dict[str, str] = {\n"
             + "".join(f'    "{s}": "{d}",\n' for s, d in SETTLEMENT_DESCRIPTIONS.items()) + "}\n")
    new = _insert_after(new, '_GEO_PREFIXES = {"birth": "birth", "home": "home (domicile)"}\n', block)
    loop = ('        for suffix, desc in _BIRTH_SETTLEMENT.items():\n'
            '            rows.append({"dataset": ds, "final_name": f"birth{suffix}",\n'
            '                         "source_name": "birth_municipality / birth_okres_id (utils.parsing.birth_settlement)",\n'
            '                         "description": desc.format(role="birth")})\n')
    new = _insert_after(new, '                             "description": desc.format(role=role)})\n'
                             '\n    dd = pd.DataFrame', "")
    new = new.replace('                             "description": desc.format(role=role)})\n'
                      '\n    dd = pd.DataFrame',
                      '                             "description": desc.format(role=role)})\n' + loop
                      + '\n    dd = pd.DataFrame')
    return "".join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(keepends=True), new.splitlines(keepends=True),
                                        "a/utils/parsing/schema.py", "b/utils/parsing/schema.py"))


# ── T3 (0.6.0): the census key follows the corrected okres ───────────────────
# schema.py documents this column with the _BIRTH_SETTLEMENT block ({role} = birth)
CENSUS_KEY_DESCRIPTIONS: dict[str, str] = {
    "_census_okres_id_stated": "The census-merge key of the record's own {role}_okres_id (the pooled census unit, D-18), on every row that has one; {role}_census_okres_id differs from it only where {role}_okres_corrected, being then the key of {role}_okres_id_1910 (birth_settlement 0.6.0, T3), and where {role}_okres_id is missing but the link supplies {role}_okres_id_1910, whose key it then is while this column stays <NA> (0.7.0, A2)",
}


def correct_census_okres_id(df: pd.DataFrame, districts: pd.DataFrame, prefix: str = "birth") -> pd.DataFrame:
    """T3 (0.6.0): ``{prefix}_census_okres_id`` follows the corrected okres. Where
    ``{prefix}_okres_corrected`` is True the key becomes the census unit of
    ``{prefix}_okres_id_1910`` through the same crosswalk notebook 02 §4 uses
    (:func:`utils.parsing.census.okres_census_crosswalk`: the identity, except that both members of a
    city/rural twin pair point at the rural member, D-17/D-18; a P3 move into a ring okres is the
    identity, as any other okres); elsewhere it is unchanged. The written key is kept in
    ``{prefix}_census_okres_id_stated``. ``{prefix}_okres_id`` is never changed. Counts go to
    ``attrs["census_key"]``.

    0.7.0: **A2** (the author) — where ``{prefix}_okres_id`` is missing but the link supplies
    ``{prefix}_okres_id_1910`` (a Prague string with no okres, a later-okres string records_geo could
    not resolve), the key is that okres's census unit too; the stated key stays missing. **F7** —
    idempotent: the stated key is always the census unit of ``{prefix}_okres_id`` (what
    :func:`utils.parsing.census.add_census_okres_id` writes), never read back from a key this function
    may already have corrected, so running notebook 02 §4a twice changes nothing."""
    from utils.parsing import census as cz
    xw = cz.okres_census_crosswalk(districts).set_index("okres_id")["census_okres_id"]
    out = df.copy()
    col = f"{prefix}_census_okres_id"
    stated = out[f"{prefix}_okres_id"].astype("Int64").map(xw).astype("Int64")
    corr = out[f"{prefix}_okres_corrected"].fillna(False).astype(bool)
    o1910 = out[f"{prefix}_okres_id_1910"].astype("Int64")
    target = o1910.map(xw).astype("Int64")
    unstated = (out[f"{prefix}_okres_id"].isna() & o1910.notna()).astype(bool)
    if not _on("A2"):
        unstated = pd.Series(False, index=out.index)
    take = corr | unstated
    out[f"{prefix}_census_okres_id_stated"] = stated
    out[col] = stated.where(~take, target).astype("Int64")
    changed = corr & (target.astype("Int64").fillna(-1) != stated.fillna(-1))
    out.attrs["census_key"] = {"okres_corrected": int(corr.sum()), "census_key_changed": int(changed.sum()),
                               "corrected_same_census_unit": int((corr & ~changed).sum()),
                               "corrected_without_census_unit": int((corr & target.isna()).sum()),
                               # 0.7.0 (A2)
                               "unstated_okres_from_link": int(unstated.sum()),
                               "unstated_okres_with_census_unit": int((unstated & target.notna()).sum())}
    return out


# ── the build ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LINK_COLUMNS = tuple(f"birth_{c}" for c in COLUMNS)
#: the refusal values 0.8.0 adds (A6, D-g, D-h): listed row by row in the report
REFUSALS_080 = ("vua_regiment_conflict", "okres_from_name_regiment_conflict", "home_name_conflict")


def refusals_080(runs: dict, prefix: str = "birth") -> dict:
    """Every row a 0.8.0 refusal value (:data:`REFUSALS_080`) refused, per run, with its raw text, the
    refused settlement and the regiment; and the D-a counts (links through an unresolved okres string,
    by reading)."""
    p = f"{prefix}_"
    out: dict = {}
    for run, df in runs.items():
        idc = "legion_id" if "legion_id" in df.columns else "vua_id"
        sel = df[df[p + "link_refusal"].isin(REFUSALS_080).fillna(False)]
        unit = ("ah_unit_primary" if "ah_unit_primary" in df.columns else
                "habsburg_unit_peacetime" if "habsburg_unit_peacetime" in df.columns else None)
        out[run] = {"rows": [{"id": int(r[idc]), "refusal": str(r[p + "link_refusal"]),
                              "raw": str(r.get(p + "raw", "") if pd.notna(r.get(p + "raw", None)) else
                                         f"{r[p + 'municipality']}, {r.get(p + 'okres', '')}"),
                              "refused": str(r[p + "settlement_id_refused"]) if pd.notna(r[p + "settlement_id_refused"])
                              else str(r[p + "settlement_candidates"]),
                              "unit": str(r[unit]) if unit and pd.notna(r[unit]) else "",
                              "home": str(r["home_municipality"]) if "home_municipality" in df.columns
                              and pd.notna(r["home_municipality"]) else ""}
                             for _i, r in sel.iterrows()]}
        out[run]["by_refusal"] = _vc(sel, p + "link_refusal")
        out[run]["okres_string_links"] = df.attrs.get("okres_string_rule", {})
    return out


def fix_a_effect(asis: pd.DataFrame, reparsed: pd.DataFrame, prefix: str = "birth") -> dict:
    """What re-parsing VÚA with ``locations`` 1.2.x changes, record by record (joined on ``vua_id``)."""
    p = f"{prefix}_"
    cols = ["vua_id", p + "municipality", p + "okres", p + "settlement_id", p + "link_unit",
            p + "municipality_settlement_id", p + "link_refusal"]
    m = asis[cols].merge(reparsed[cols], on="vua_id", suffixes=("_v11", "_v12"), validate="1:1")
    a, b = m[p + "settlement_id_v11"], m[p + "settlement_id_v12"]
    changed = m[(a.fillna("") != b.fillna(""))]
    top = (changed[[p + "municipality_v11", p + "settlement_id_v11", p + "municipality_v12",
                    p + "settlement_id_v12"]].astype(str).value_counts().head(30))
    unit = lambda s: _vc(m, s)
    return {"records": int(len(m)), "settlement_changed": int(len(changed)),
            "gained": int((a.isna() & b.notna()).sum()), "lost": int((a.notna() & b.isna()).sum()),
            "switched": int((a.notna() & b.notna() & (a != b)).sum()),
            "link_unit_v11": unit(p + "link_unit_v11"), "link_unit_v12": unit(p + "link_unit_v12"),
            "top_changes": [{"v11_municipality": k[0], "v11_settlement": k[1], "v12_municipality": k[2],
                             "v12_settlement": k[3], "n": int(n)} for k, n in top.items()]}


def rulings_dependence(default_runs: dict, evidence_runs: dict, rulings: pd.DataFrame,
                       prefix: str = "birth") -> list[dict]:
    """How many links rest on each **unconfirmed** anchor ruling: per ruling, the links whose
    register row (``register_row_key``) or, for a municipality row, whose municipality
    (``register_key``) is the ruled row — in the run with the evidence rulings applied and in the
    default (confirmed-only) run — per dataset."""
    from utils.recheck import anchor_overrides as ao
    p = f"{prefix}_"
    out = []
    unconf = ao.unconfirmed_rulings(rulings) if len(rulings) else rulings
    for r in unconf.itertuples(index=False):
        row_key = f"{r.edition}|{r.court_key}|{int(r.muni_seq)}|{int(r.settlement_seq)}"
        muni_key = f"{r.edition}|{r.court_key}|{int(r.muni_seq)}"
        entry = {"ruling": row_key, "printed_name": r.printed_name, "action": r.action,
                 "old_settlement_id": r.old_settlement_id if isinstance(r.old_settlement_id, str) else "",
                 "settlement_id": r.settlement_id if isinstance(r.settlement_id, str) else "",
                 "ruled_by": r.ruled_by}
        for mode, runs in (("evidence", evidence_runs), ("default", default_runs)):
            for name, df in runs.items():
                hit = df[p + "register_row_key"].eq(row_key).fillna(False)
                if int(r.settlement_seq) == 0:
                    hit |= df[p + "register_key"].eq(muni_key).fillna(False)
                # 0.4.0: links only (a refused row kept its row key in 0.3.0)
                entry[f"{name}_{mode}"] = int((hit & df[p + "link_unit"].ne("none")).sum())
        out.append(entry)
    return out


def rulings_changes(default_runs: dict, evidence_runs: dict, prefix: str = "birth") -> dict:
    """Records whose link differs between the default run and the run with the evidence rulings
    (settlement, municipality, refusal or register reach), per dataset, with the top pairs."""
    p = f"{prefix}_"
    cols = [p + c for c in ("settlement_id", "municipality_settlement_id", "link_refusal",
                            "in_register_municipalities")]
    out = {}
    for name in evidence_runs:
        a = default_runs[name][cols].astype("string").fillna("")
        b = evidence_runs[name][cols].astype("string").fillna("")
        diff = (a != b).any(axis=1)
        pairs = pd.DataFrame({"municipality": default_runs[name].loc[diff, p + "municipality"],
                              "default": a.loc[diff, cols[0]] + " / " + a.loc[diff, cols[2]],
                              "evidence": b.loc[diff, cols[0]] + " / " + b.loc[diff, cols[2]]})
        out[name] = {"records_changed": int(diff.sum()),
                     "linked_default": int(default_runs[name][p + "link_unit"].ne("none").sum()),
                     "linked_evidence": int(evidence_runs[name][p + "link_unit"].ne("none").sum()),
                     "reachable_default": int(default_runs[name][p + "in_register_municipalities"]
                                              .fillna(False).astype(bool).sum()),
                     "reachable_evidence": int(evidence_runs[name][p + "in_register_municipalities"]
                                               .fillna(False).astype(bool).sum()),
                     "top": [{"municipality": k[0], "default": k[1], "evidence": k[2], "n": int(n)}
                             for k, n in pairs.value_counts().head(25).items()]}
    return out


def headline(cov: dict) -> dict:
    """The few numbers both rulings modes are compared on."""
    keys = ("records", "scope", "settlement_linked", "linked_unit", "in_register_municipalities",
            "okres_corrected", "greater_prague_1922", "settlement_refused_with_candidate")
    out = {k: cov[k] for k in keys}
    out["refusal"] = cov["refusal"]
    out["owner_differs"] = (cov.get("register_reach") or {}).get("owner_differs")
    out["table_lacks_municipality"] = (cov.get("register_reach") or {}).get("table_lacks_municipality")
    return out


def d1_kept(df: pd.DataFrame, g: Gazetteer, prefix: str = "birth") -> list[dict]:
    """The links read off VÚA's first candidate that stand while another candidate gave nothing
    (0.6.0, T1's residual), one row per record with why each silent candidate is silent — a place
    outside the Czech lands (``foreign`` / ``okres_foreign``) or a name the gazetteer does not hold
    anywhere else (``unmatched`` / ``no_okres`` / ``okres_unresolved`` / ``no_municipality``)."""
    p = f"{prefix}_"
    cands = candidates_column(df, prefix)
    linked = df[p + "link_unit"].ne("none").fillna(False).astype(bool)
    out = []
    for i in df.index[linked & cands.notna()]:
        oid, okres = df.at[i, p + "okres_id"], df.at[i, p + "okres"]
        okres = okres if isinstance(okres, str) else None
        v = candidate_verdicts(cands[i], okres, int(oid) if pd.notna(oid) else None, g,
                               main=(df.at[i, p + "municipality"], okres), main_sid=df.at[i, p + "settlement_id"])
        silent = [f"{c[0]} / {c[1]}: {why}" for c, (kind, why) in zip(cands[i], v) if kind == "none"]
        if silent:
            out.append({"id": int(df.at[i, "vua_id"]) if "vua_id" in df.columns else int(i),
                        "raw": str(df.at[i, p + "raw"]) if p + "raw" in df.columns else "",
                        "settlement_id": str(df.at[i, p + "settlement_id"]), "silent": "; ".join(silent),
                        "outside_czech_lands_only": all(s.endswith(("foreign", "okres_foreign")) for s in silent)})
    return out


def checker_cases(runs: dict, prefix: str = "birth", cases: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """What each named case of *cases* (``{run: {decision: (ids)}}``) gets now:
    ``{run: {decision: {id: refusal or settlement}}}``. 0.9.0 (E13): the case lists are review material,
    not part of the module — they live in ``utils/reference_tools/places/measure_birth_settlement.py``,
    which prints them."""
    p = f"{prefix}_"
    out: dict = {}
    for run, by in (cases or {}).items():
        df = runs.get(run)
        if df is None:
            continue
        idc = "legion_id" if "legion_id" in df.columns else "vua_id"
        sub = df.set_index(idc)
        out[run] = {}
        for dec, ids in by.items():
            out[run][dec] = {int(i): (str(sub.at[i, p + "link_refusal"]) if pd.notna(sub.at[i, p + "link_refusal"])
                                      else f"LINKED {sub.at[i, p + 'settlement_id']}")
                             for i in ids if i in sub.index}
    return out


def _links(df: pd.DataFrame, id_col: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    keep = [id_col, "birth_municipality", "birth_okres", "birth_okres_id", "birth_okres_match", *LINK_COLUMNS,
            "birth_census_okres_id", "birth_census_okres_id_stated",
            "birth_refusal_detail", "birth_refusal_okres_ids",            # 0.7.0: build() diagnostics
            "birth_okres_source"]                                          # 0.9.0 (E10)
    return df[[c for c in keep if c in df.columns]].reset_index(drop=True)


def okres_adjacency() -> dict | None:
    """``{okres_id: {okres_id whose MPIDR outline touches it}}``
    (:meth:`utils.recheck.anchor_overrides.Courts.okres_adjacency`, 250 m), ``None`` without the
    shapefile (0.7.0, A3)."""
    from utils.recheck import anchor_overrides as ao
    if not Path(f"{ao.MPIDR}.shp").exists():
        return None
    return ao.Courts().okres_adjacency()


def link_inputs(final_dir: Path = FINAL, raw_vua: Path = ROOT / "data" / "raw" / "habsburg" / "habsburg_fallen.csv",
                parsed_vua: pd.DataFrame | None = None, vua_reparsed: pd.DataFrame | None = None) -> dict:
    """The frames :func:`build` links (0.7.0: one function, shared with the measurement):
    ``{"frames": {"legion", "vua_asis", "vua_reparsed"}, "districts", "settlements"}``. Legionnaires as
    they are; VÚA (i) as in ``data/final`` with the re-parse's candidate flags and raw cell, and (ii)
    re-parsed from the raw ``Místo narození`` with ``locations`` 1.2.x (:func:`reparse_vua_births`).
    *parsed_vua* / *vua_reparsed* may be passed in to skip the slow steps."""
    from utils.parsing import records_geo as rg
    final_dir = Path(final_dir)
    settlements = pd.read_parquet(final_dir / "geo" / "settlements_1910.parquet")
    districts = pd.read_parquet(final_dir / "geo" / "districts_1910.parquet")
    legion = pd.read_parquet(final_dir / "persons" / "legionnaires_clean.parquet")
    habs = pd.read_parquet(final_dir / "persons" / "habsburg_clean.parquet")
    parsed = (parse_vua_raw(pd.read_csv(raw_vua, usecols=["vua_id", "Místo narození"], dtype=str))
              if parsed_vua is None else parsed_vua)
    flag_cols = ["vua_id", "birth_candidates_agree", "birth_candidates_agree_place",
                 "birth_n_candidates", "birth_n_readings", "birth_raw"]
    vua_i = habs.merge(parsed[[c for c in flag_cols if c in parsed.columns]], on="vua_id", how="left",
                       validate="1:1")
    if vua_reparsed is None:
        sk_names = rg.settlement_name_set(pd.read_parquet(final_dir / "geo" / "settlements_hu_1910.parquet"),
                                          cols=("obec_sk",))
        vua_reparsed = reparse_vua_births(habs, parsed, districts, settlements, sk_names)
    return {"frames": {"legion": legion, "vua_asis": vua_i, "vua_reparsed": vua_reparsed},
            "districts": districts, "settlements": settlements}


def link_runs(frames: dict, g: Gazetteer, districts: pd.DataFrame, accept_prague_later_okres: bool | None = None,
              census: bool = True, diagnostics: bool = True) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    """``(runs, census_key)``: each frame through :func:`add_birth_settlement_columns`, then (with
    *census*) the census key of the corrected okres as notebook 02 §4a sets it
    (:func:`correct_census_okres_id`; the re-parsed VÚA frame's key is rebuilt from its own okres id
    first, as §4 does). Shared by :func:`build` and the measurement (0.7.0)."""
    from utils.parsing import census as cz
    runs = {k: add_birth_settlement_columns(df, g, accept_prague_later_okres=accept_prague_later_okres,
                                            diagnostics=diagnostics) for k, df in frames.items()}
    census_key = {}
    if census:
        for k in runs:
            base = runs[k].drop(columns=["birth_census_okres_id"], errors="ignore") if k == "vua_reparsed" else runs[k]
            if "birth_census_okres_id" not in base.columns:
                base = cz.add_census_okres_id(base, districts, prefix="birth")
            runs[k] = correct_census_okres_id(base, districts)
            census_key[k] = runs[k].attrs["census_key"]
    return runs, census_key


def build(final_dir: Path = FINAL, out_dir: Path = OUT, heals: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
          raw_vua: Path = ROOT / "data" / "raw" / "habsburg" / "habsburg_fallen.csv",
          heals_evidence: pd.DataFrame | None = None, vua_reparsed: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
          parsed_vua: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
          accept_prague_later_okres: bool | None = None) -> dict:
    """Both datasets through the matcher; report, link files and the rulings queue in *out_dir*.

    Legionnaires as they are; VÚA (i) as in ``data/final`` and (ii) re-parsed from the raw
    ``Místo narození`` with ``locations`` 1.2.x (the link file carries (ii)). Two rulings modes
    (0.3.0): the **default** gazetteer applies only the author's confirmed anchor rulings — the
    link files and the queue come from it; the **evidence** gazetteer adds the unconfirmed
    (``evidence``) rulings, and only its counts go to the report, with the links resting on each
    unconfirmed ruling. *heals* / *heals_evidence* / *parsed_vua* / *vua_reparsed* may be passed in
    to skip the slow steps. Writes nothing in ``data/final``; every file is LF. Since 0.7.0 the inputs
    and the linking are :func:`link_inputs` and :func:`link_runs` (shared with the measurement), the
    links carry the ``diagnostics`` columns, and the queue its blocks (:func:`queue_blocks`).
    """
    from utils.recheck import anchor_overrides as ao
    final_dir, out_dir = Path(final_dir), Path(out_dir)
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    g = load_gazetteer(final_dir, heals=heals, include_unconfirmed=False)
    g_ev = load_gazetteer(final_dir, heals=heals_evidence, include_unconfirmed=True)
    inputs = link_inputs(final_dir, raw_vua, parsed_vua, vua_reparsed)
    settlements, districts = inputs["settlements"], inputs["districts"]
    okres_cs = okres_cs_names(districts)
    runs, census_key = link_runs(inputs["frames"], g, districts, accept_prague_later_okres)
    runs_ev, _ck = link_runs({k: inputs["frames"][k] for k in ("legion", "vua_reparsed")}, g_ev, districts,
                             accept_prague_later_okres, census=False)
    keyed = today_keyed_pick(settlements)
    cov = {k: coverage(v, okres_cs, g=g) for k, v in runs.items()}
    cov_ev = {k: coverage(v, okres_cs, g=g_ev) for k, v in runs_ev.items()}
    rulings = ao.load_rulings()
    report = {"module": f"birth_settlement {__version__}",
              "accept_prague_later_okres": bool(runs["legion"].attrs.get("accept_prague_later_okres")),
              "gazetteer": {"two_owners": sorted(g.two_owners), "quarters": g.quarters,
                            "statutory": g.statutory, "greater_prague": greater_prague_check(g),
                            "anchor_rulings_refused": g.rulings_refused,
                            "anchor_rulings_applied_default": len(g.rulings_applied),
                            "anchor_rulings_unconfirmed_default": len(g.rulings_unconfirmed),
                            "anchor_rulings_applied_evidence": len(g_ev.rulings_applied),
                            "municipality_rows_contradicted": {s: sorted(k) for s, k in
                                                               sorted(g.muni_keys_contradicted.items())},
                            "municipality_rows_contradicted_evidence": {
                                s: sorted(k) for s, k in sorted(g_ev.muni_keys_contradicted.items())},
                            # 0.4.0: settlements the contradicted rule would have freed (kept two_owners)
                            "contradicted_freed_default": g.contradicted_freed,
                            "contradicted_freed_evidence": g_ev.contradicted_freed,
                            "xref_on_every_row": g.xref_both,
                            "xref_on_every_row_evidence": g_ev.xref_both,
                            "register_municipalities_keyed": len(g.register_muni_key),
                            # 0.12.0 (I5): H1's evidence, settlements with a modern (RÚIAN) municipality
                            "modern_obec": len(g.modern_obec)},
              "headline": {"default": {k: headline(v) for k, v in cov.items()},
                           "with_evidence_rulings": {k: headline(v) for k, v in cov_ev.items()}},
              "coverage": cov,
              "coverage_with_evidence_rulings": cov_ev,
              "rulings_dependence": rulings_dependence(
                  {k: runs[k] for k in runs_ev}, runs_ev, rulings),
              "rulings_changes": rulings_changes({k: runs[k] for k in runs_ev}, runs_ev),
              "vs_today_pick": {k: compare_with_today(v, keyed, g) for k, v in runs.items()},
              "fix_a_effect": fix_a_effect(runs["vua_asis"], runs["vua_reparsed"]),
              "census_key": census_key,
              "refusals_080": refusals_080(runs),
              # 0.9.0 (E10): where the okres of each link came from
              "okres_source_linked": {k: _vc(v[v["birth_link_unit"].ne("none")], "birth_okres_source")
                                      for k, v in runs.items() if "birth_okres_source" in v.columns},
              "refusal_detail": {k: _vc(v[v["birth_link_refusal"].notna()].assign(
                  _d=lambda d: d["birth_link_refusal"].astype(str) + " / " + d["birth_refusal_detail"].fillna("-")), "_d")
                  for k, v in runs.items()},
              "d1_kept_with_silent_candidates": d1_kept(runs["vua_reparsed"], g)}
    frames_q = {"legion": runs["legion"], "vua": runs["vua_reparsed"]}
    queue = rulings_queue(frames_q, g, okres_cs)
    blocks = queue_blocks(frames_q, g, okres_cs, okres_adjacency())          # 0.7.0 (A3)
    report["rulings_queue"] = {"strings": int(len(queue)), "soldiers": int(queue["n"].sum()),
                               "by_status": _vc(queue, "status"),
                               "soldiers_by_status": {str(k): int(v) for k, v in
                                                      queue.groupby("status")["n"].sum().items()},
                               "with_register_prefix_rows": int(queue["register_rows"].ne("").sum()),
                               "blocks": ({b: {"strings": int(len(x)), "soldiers": int(x["n"].sum()),
                                               **({"borders": _vc(x, "okres_borders", dropna=False)}
                                                  if b == "conflict_unique" else {}),
                                               # 0.9.0 (E12): the D-h refusals by shape, soldiers
                                               **({"soldiers_by_shape": {str(k): int(v) for k, v in
                                                                         x.groupby("shape")["n"].sum().items()},
                                                   "soldiers_by_home_okres": {str(k): int(v) for k, v in
                                                                              x.groupby("home_okres")["n"].sum().items()}}
                                                  if b == "home_name_conflict" else {})}
                                           for b, x in blocks.groupby("block")} if len(blocks) else {})}
    queue = pd.concat([queue.assign(block=""), blocks], ignore_index=True) if len(blocks) else queue.assign(block="")
    asis_cols = {"birth_settlement_id": "birth_settlement_id_asis", "birth_link_unit": "birth_link_unit_asis",
                 # 0.7.0: the as-is run's refusal and reach, so a later round can measure it row by row
                 "birth_link_refusal": "birth_link_refusal_asis", "birth_refusal_detail": "birth_refusal_detail_asis",
                 "birth_in_register_municipalities": "birth_in_register_municipalities_asis"}
    vua_links = _links(runs["vua_reparsed"], "vua_id").merge(
        runs["vua_asis"][["vua_id", *asis_cols]].rename(columns=asis_cols), on="vua_id", how="left", validate="1:1")
    write_outputs(out_dir, _links(runs["legion"], "legion_id"), vua_links, queue, report)
    return {"report": report, "queue": queue, "runs": runs, "runs_evidence": runs_ev,
            "gazetteer": g, "gazetteer_evidence": g_ev}


def write_outputs(out_dir: Path, legion_links: pd.DataFrame, vua_links: pd.DataFrame,
                  queue: pd.DataFrame, report: dict) -> list[Path]:
    """Every file :func:`build` writes, each text file LF (0.4.0: one place, tested): the two link
    parquets, the rulings queue (csv), the schema proposal (diff) and the report (json + md)."""
    out_dir = Path(out_dir)
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    paths = [out_dir / n for n in ("birth_settlement_links_legion.parquet", "birth_settlement_links_vua.parquet",
                                   "birthplace_rulings_queue.csv", "schema_patch.diff",
                                   "birth_settlement_report.json", "birth_settlement_report.md")]
    legion_links.to_parquet(paths[0], index=False)
    vua_links.to_parquet(paths[1], index=False)
    queue.to_csv(paths[2], index=False, encoding="utf-8", lineterminator="\n")
    paths[3].write_text(schema_patch(), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    with open(paths[4], "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh:
        json.dump(report, fh, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=str)
    paths[5].write_text(report_markdown(report, queue), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    return paths


# ── the markdown report ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def _table(rows: list[dict], cols: list[str]) -> str:
    if not rows:
        return "_none_\n"
    head = "| " + " | ".join(cols) + " |\n|" + "---|" * len(cols) + "\n"
    return head + "".join("| " + " | ".join(str(r.get(c, "")) for c in cols) + " |\n" for r in rows)


def _dict_table(d: dict, name: str) -> str:
    return _table([{name: k, "n": f"{v:,}"} for k, v in d.items()], [name, "n"])


def _headline_table(heads: dict) -> str:
    return _table([{"run": r, "records": f"{h['records']:,}", "scope": f"{h['scope']:,}",
                    "settlement": f"{h['settlement_linked']:,}", "linked unit": f"{h['linked_unit']:,}",
                    "register reachable": f"{h['in_register_municipalities']:,}",
                    "owner key differs": f"{h['owner_differs'] or 0:,}",
                    "table lacks municipality": f"{h['table_lacks_municipality'] or 0:,}",
                    "okres corrected": f"{h['okres_corrected']:,}",
                    "refused with candidate": f"{h['settlement_refused_with_candidate']:,}"}
                   for r, h in heads.items()],
                  ["run", "records", "scope", "settlement", "linked unit", "register reachable",
                   "owner key differs", "table lacks municipality", "okres corrected",
                   "refused with candidate"])


def report_markdown(report: dict, queue: pd.DataFrame) -> str:
    """The report as Markdown (every number from :func:`build`; nothing typed by hand)."""
    cov, vs = report["coverage"], report["vs_today_pick"]
    runs = list(cov)
    gz = report["gazetteer"]
    lines = [f"# Birth-settlement link — {report['module']}\n",
             "Generated by `utils/parsing/birth_settlement.py::build`. Scope = records with a stated "
             "1910 okres, a settlement reached through the Prague pass, or a refused candidate.\n",
             f"\nAnchor rulings: {gz['anchor_rulings_applied_default']} applied by default (confirmed by the "
             f"author), {gz['anchor_rulings_unconfirmed_default']} unconfirmed and left out; "
             f"{gz['anchor_rulings_applied_evidence']} applied in the *with evidence rulings* run. "
             f"`accept_prague_later_okres` = {report['accept_prague_later_okres']}. "
             f"register_municipalities keyed rows: {gz['register_municipalities_keyed']:,}. "
             f"Settlements with a modern municipality (settlements_1910_geo, H1): {gz.get('modern_obec', 0):,}.\n",
             "\n## Headline — default (confirmed rulings only; the link files)\n",
             _headline_table(report["headline"]["default"]),
             "\n## Headline — with evidence rulings (counts only)\n",
             _headline_table(report["headline"]["with_evidence_rulings"]),
             "\n## Coverage\n",
             _table([{"run": r, "records": f"{cov[r]['records']:,}", "scope": f"{cov[r]['scope']:,}",
                      "settlement": f"{cov[r]['settlement_linked']:,}",
                      "linked unit": f"{cov[r]['linked_unit']:,}",
                      "register reachable": f"{cov[r]['in_register_municipalities']:,}",
                      "okres corrected": f"{cov[r]['okres_corrected']:,}",
                      "Greater Prague 1922": f"{cov[r]['greater_prague_1922']:,}",
                      "Prague city 1910": f"{cov[r]['prague_city_1910']:,}",
                      "muni = okres name": f"{cov[r]['settlement_is_okres_name']:,}",
                      "VÚA uncertain": f"{cov[r]['vua_uncertain']:,}"} for r in runs],
                    ["run", "records", "scope", "settlement", "linked unit", "register reachable",
                     "okres corrected", "Greater Prague 1922", "Prague city 1910", "muni = okres name",
                     "VÚA uncertain"])]
    for r in runs:
        c = cov[r]
        reach = c["register_reach"] or {}
        unc = c["uncertainty"]
        lines += [f"\n### {r}\n", "**Linked by tier**\n", _dict_table(c["linked_by_tier"], "tier"),
                  "\n**Refusals**\n", _dict_table(c["refusal"], "refusal"),
                  "\n**Municipality source**\n", _dict_table(c["municipality_source"], "source"),
                  "\n**Court source**\n", _dict_table(c["court_source"], "source"),
                  "\n**Register reach** (key comparison with register_municipalities)\n",
                  _dict_table({k: v for k, v in reach.items() if isinstance(v, int)}, "count"),
                  "\nOwner key differs (top): " + "; ".join(reach.get("owner_differs_top", [])) + "\n",
                  "\nTable lacks the municipality (top): " + "; ".join(reach.get("table_lacks_top", [])) + "\n",
                  "\n0.2.0 membership but not reachable (top): "
                  + "; ".join(reach.get("membership_but_not_reachable_top", [])) + "\n",
                  "\n**Okres corrections by rule**\n", _dict_table(c["okres_corrected_by_rule"], "rule"),
                  "\n**Okres corrections (top)**\n",
                  _table(c["okres_corrections_top"][:15], ["from", "to", "tier", "n"]),
                  "\n**P3 refusals** (candidate in settlement_id_refused, okres not moved)\n",
                  _table([{"refusal": k, "n": v["n"], "settlements": v["settlements"],
                           "top": "; ".join(v["top"][:15])} for k, v in (c["p3_refused"] or {}).items()],
                         ["refusal", "n", "settlements", "top"]),
                  "\n**P3 moves that stand: Greater Prague 1922 × Prague-named okres in the timeline**\n",
                  _table([{"cell": k, "n": v["n"], "settlements": v["settlements"],
                           "top": "; ".join(v["top"][:8])}
                          for k, v in (c["p3_moves"] or {}).get("cells", {}).items()],
                         ["cell", "n", "settlements", "top"]),
                  "\n**Prague pool tie-breaks** (in the rulings queue)\n",
                  _dict_table(c["prague_pool_tie_breaks"], "settlement"),
                  "\n**Uncertainty components**\n",
                  _table([{"component": k, "all": f"{v:,}", "linked": f"{unc['linked'][k]:,}"}
                          for k, v in unc["all"].items()], ["component", "all", "linked"]),
                  "\nPiece tiers: " + ", ".join(f"{k} {v:,}" for k, v in unc["piece_tier"].items()) + "\n",
                  "\nVÚA first-candidate rule (D1): "
                  + (lambda d: "n/a" if not d else
                     f"{d['linked_with_silent_candidates']:,} linked with candidates that gave nothing "
                     f"({', '.join(f'{k} {v:,}' for k, v in d['silent_reason'].items()) or 'none'}); "
                     f"{d['refused']:,} refused ambiguous:vua_candidates in scope "
                     f"({', '.join(f'{k} {v:,}' for k, v in d['refused_by'].items()) or 'none'}; "
                     f"{d.get('refused_all_rows', d['refused']):,} on every row)")(
                      c.get("vua_candidate_rule")) + "\n",
                  f"\nOwner check: {c['owner_mismatch']:,} mismatches "
                  f"({c['owner_mismatch_linked']:,} still linked), "
                  f"{c['owner_name_conflict']:,} refused owner_name_conflict "
                  f"({'; '.join(c['owner_name_conflict_settlements'] or [])}), "
                  f"{(c['owner_disjoint_unrefused'] or {}).get('births', 0):,} on disjoint names kept. "
                  f"Prague quarter filled from locations: {c['prague_quarter_filled_from_locations']:,}.\n"]
    lines += ["\n## Links resting on each unconfirmed anchor ruling\n",
              "Links whose register row (or, for a municipality row, whose municipality) is the ruled "
              "row, with the evidence rulings applied and in the default run.\n\n",
              _table(report["rulings_dependence"],
                     ["ruling", "printed_name", "action", "old_settlement_id", "settlement_id",
                      "legion_evidence", "vua_reparsed_evidence", "legion_default", "vua_reparsed_default"]),
              "\n**Records whose link changes with the evidence rulings**\n",
              _table([{"run": k, **{c: v[c] for c in ("records_changed", "linked_default", "linked_evidence",
                                                      "reachable_default", "reachable_evidence")}}
                      for k, v in report["rulings_changes"].items()],
                     ["run", "records_changed", "linked_default", "linked_evidence", "reachable_default",
                      "reachable_evidence"])]
    for k, v in report["rulings_changes"].items():
        lines += [f"\n{k}: top changes\n", _table(v["top"][:15], ["municipality", "default", "evidence", "n"])]
    lines += ["\n## Against today's pick (records_geo.add_settlement_attrs)\n",
              _table([{"run": r, **{k: vs[r][k] for k in ("today_linked", "now_linked", "both", "agree",
                                                            "disagree", "today_only", "now_only")},
                       "name replication": vs[r]["replication_name_agreement"]} for r in runs],
                     ["run", "today_linked", "now_linked", "both", "agree", "disagree", "today_only",
                      "now_only", "name replication"])]
    for r in runs:
        lines += [f"\n**{r}: top disagreements**\n",
                  _table(vs[r]["top_disagreements"][:12], ["municipality", "today", "now", "tier", "n"])]
    ck = report.get("census_key") or {}
    lines += ["\n## The census key follows the corrected okres (T3)\n",
              _table([{"run": r, **v} for r, v in ck.items()],
                     ["run", "okres_corrected", "census_key_changed", "corrected_same_census_unit",
                      "corrected_without_census_unit"])]
    lines += ["\n## Where each link's okres came from (0.9.0, E10)\n"]
    for run, d in (report.get("okres_source_linked") or {}).items():
        lines.append(f"\n{run}: " + ", ".join(f"{k} {v:,}" for k, v in d.items()) + "\n")
    blocks = queue[queue["block"].fillna("").ne("")] if "block" in queue.columns else queue.iloc[0:0]
    lines += ["\n## Rulings queue blocks (0.7.0, A3)\n\n",
              _table(blocks.to_dict("records"),
                     ["block", "dataset", "municipality", "settlement_id", "settlement_okres", "written_okres",
                      "okres_borders", "shape", "home_okres", "n", "ids", "refusal"])]
    kept = report.get("d1_kept_with_silent_candidates") or []
    other = [r for r in kept if not r["outside_czech_lands_only"]]
    lines += [f"\n## First-candidate links kept with candidates that gave nothing (T1)\n\n{len(kept):,} VÚA "
              f"re-parsed links: {len(kept) - len(other):,} whose silent candidates all name a place outside "
              f"the Czech lands, {len(other):,} with a candidate the gazetteer holds nowhere else (listed):\n\n",
              _table(other, ["id", "settlement_id", "silent", "raw"])]
    fa = report["fix_a_effect"]
    lines += ["\n## Effect of fix A (VÚA re-parsed with locations 1.2.x)\n",
              f"{fa['settlement_changed']:,} of {fa['records']:,} records change settlement "
              f"({fa['gained']:,} gained, {fa['lost']:,} lost, {fa['switched']:,} switched).\n\n",
              _table(fa["top_changes"][:20], ["v11_municipality", "v11_settlement", "v12_municipality",
                                              "v12_settlement", "n"]),
              "\n## Greater Prague 1922\n", "```\n" + json.dumps(gz["greater_prague"],
                                                               ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + "\n```\n",
              f"\nSettlements two register municipalities hold (refused): "
              f"{', '.join(gz['two_owners'])}\n",
              "\nMunicipality rows the other edition contradicts on name and population (not a "
              "register join; default run): "
              + "; ".join(f"{s} {k}" for s, k in gz["municipality_rows_contradicted"].items()) + "\n",
              "\nSettlements the contradicted rule would have taken out of two_owners (kept there; "
              f"default / evidence): {gz.get('contradicted_freed_default') or 'none'} / "
              f"{gz.get('contradicted_freed_evidence') or 'none'}\n",
              "\nSettlements whose every register row prints 'viz' (municipality row kept, part rows "
              "of 10 % or less of it dropped): "
              + ("; ".join(f"{x['settlement_id']} kept {x['kept']} ({x['kept_pop']:g}), dropped "
                           f"{', '.join(x['dropped'])}" for x in gz.get("xref_on_every_row") or [])
                 or "none") + "\n",
              f"\n## Rulings queue\n\n{report['rulings_queue']['strings']:,} strings, "
              f"{report['rulings_queue']['soldiers']:,} soldiers "
              f"(`output/places/birthplace_rulings_queue.csv`); by status "
              + ", ".join(f"{k} {v:,}" for k, v in report["rulings_queue"]["by_status"].items())
              + ". Top 30:\n\n",
              _table((queue[queue["block"].fillna("").eq("")] if "block" in queue.columns else queue).head(30).to_dict("records"),
                     ["municipality", "okres_stated", "okres_cs", "n", "n_legion", "n_vua", "status",
                      "refusal", "candidate_detail", "register_rows"])]
    return "".join(lines)


if __name__ == "__main__":      # python -m utils.parsing.birth_settlement
    res = build()
    print(json.dumps(res["report"]["headline"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=str)[:4000])
